sku gsung thugs la mos gus skyes pa'i yon tan yin/ mos gus zer nas kyang thang chung zhig gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal yang phyi/ yang phyi/ phyag gu re gu re skyabs su mchi'o yi cong skad gcig pu yang mos gus min/ mos gus kyi go ba bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang bdag nyid dbyer med par gyur nas/ sku'i rnam par thar pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang*/ gsung gi rnam par thar pas chos ston/ thugs kyi rnam par thar pas gzhan gyi rgyud byin gyis rlob/ dbyer med kyi rnam par thar pas rang don dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs na mos gus yin/ mos gus de lta bu dang ldan pa dus dang rnam pa thams cad du nyes pa'i dri mas mi gos/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams/ nyes 'khrul gyi skyon med pas gong du bshad pa'i yon tan de rnams brtan cing rgyun chad med par 'ong ste/ shi tshig gsang gtam du rang yang 'chi ba yin/ thub pa'i bstan pa yang yun ring por mi gnas/ skyob pa bla ma dam pa dang rtag tu 'phrad par dka'/ 'jig rten gyi zang zing 'di la yang dgos pa med/ da ltar chos nyams su blang ba'i ngo yang shes/ sems can gyi don yang sangs rgyas nas chung du mi 'gro cher 'gro/ sangs rgyas thob pa la sgrub pa byed dgos/ sgrub pa la g.yeng ba spong dgos pas/ gcig pu gnyis su med par shin tu dben pa'i gnas su dman pa'i sa gzung*/ hrul po'i gos gon/ sngo rngad

sngo tshod la sogs pa gyi na tsam gyis 'tsho bar bya zhing*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya'o// 'di'i dus su yang*// ༈ //dgon par gnas pa'i nga rgyal gyis// chos dang bral ba ga na yod// bu dgon par gnas pa'i srog chags ltos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// legs par gsungs pa dam pa'i chos// 'dul ba'i rgya mtsho las byung ba// lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yis// sku rgyan drang srong chen po ni// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// zla ba sgra gcan las rgyal ltar// shin tu mdzes shing lham me ste// shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la// gtso bo thub pa'i rjes zhugs te// bcas pa dang ni rang bzhin gyi// kha na ma tho phra rnams la// phra ba'i tshul gyis mi bsrung na// dben pa'i gnas su rten bcas nas// shākya'i bstan pa 'jig par byed// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa yi// lta sgom bzang po de dag gis// rang la phan nam gzhan la phan// gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg par yang*// tshul khrims spong bar su zhig bshad// de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las// tshul khrims 'chal la sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// gzhan yang ta la'i mgo bcad ltar// tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur pa la// gsang sngags yon tan mi skye zhes// shin tu gces par gsungs nas 'dug /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rnal 'byor bla med rgyud rnams su// 'og ma tshul khrims ma brtan par// gong ma yon tan mi skye ba// mkhar gyi rmang dang bral ba la// sku mkhar mthon po mi 'grub ltar// tshul khrims rmang dang bral ba la// gsang sngags yon tan mi skye zhing*// gsang sngags ming dang bral bar gsung*// kye rang la sems pa'i dam pa rnams// gsang sngags yon tan 'byung 'dod na// dgon par tshul khrims ma spang mdzod// nges 'byung tshul khrims gzhir bzhag nas// nges par 'byung bar byed pa la// mdo sde'i sde snod rgya mtsho las// don gyi snying po bcud phyung ba// lhag pa skyon med rnam dag sems// ting 'dzin bslab pa rin po che// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi man ngag sgom// de yang bla ma'i mos gus yin// sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje dang*// 'bral ba med pa ngo mtshar che// sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje la// sa bcu mchog la gnas pa yi// mgon po byams pas byang chub bzhed// byang chub 'di las 'khor 'das kyi// yon tan rgya mtsho nges 'byung zhes// skyob pa 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs// de yang yon tan gang zhe na// ji tsam lus dang bral ba las// byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs su// lus kyi yon tan mang po 'am// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku yi bkod pa dpag med pa// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams// sems can khams dang mnyam pa yang*// lus dang bral ba'i yon tan yin// ji tsam ngag dang sems kyi yang*// sgrib pa'i dri ma zhes bya ba// ngag dang yid kyi 'dzin pa dag

/bral bar gyur pa de tsam du// snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// bral ba'i yon tan dpag med pa// 'byung bar 'gyur ba chos nyid yin// bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyi// gnad kyi man ngag zab mo 'di// sangs rgyas rnams dang gong ma yis// nyams blang myong ba'i rtogs chos 'di// bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis go ba las// tshu rol mthong ba'i rigs pa las// 'thad par 'gyur ba ga la srid// rang sems dngos dang dngos med dang*// don dang don min gang du yang*// grub pa med pas gnyis med yin// de ltar gnas skabs kyi yon tan/ 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba/ dngos grub dang bar chad ma phyed pa de las/ gcig pu gnyis su med par bros nas/ dgon par bslab pa rin po che gsum gyi tshul du nyams su blangs pas/ sems nyid rdo rje ji tsam du sgrib pa spangs pa'i kha mtshon du/ snang sems gnyis su med pa'i yon tan 'char yang*/ yon tan de dag la rang gi bsam pa ji ltar 'dug pa de/ phyi ngos su snang ba yin par ma shes na/ rang gi grib ma la skrag pas bde zhing skyid pa mi srid de/ yon tan la bdud du byas shing spang blang dang re dogs bskyed na/ re dogs chags sdang yin/ chags sdang bdud yin/ chags sdang dang ma bral na bdud dang mi 'bral ba chos nyid yin/ tshul de dang 'dra bar/ dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mthu dang*/ rtags dang*/ nus pa dang*/ grub chen brgyad la sogs pa byung yang rang gi yon tan dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems nyid rdo rje yin zhing*/ sems nyid rdo rje las yon tan 'byung bar ma go nas/ re dogs chags sdang bskyed na rang snang phan gnod byed pa gnyis su song nas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por lhung dogs yod pas/ dang po nas gnyis med kyi don dang ma bral bar bya/ rtags dang yon tan ci byung yang*/ nga rgyal dang rlom pa mi bya/

sems bskyed dang po'i bsam pa dran par bya/ dang po'i bsam pa ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can ma lus pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che la 'god pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor bsgrub par dam bcas nas/ da lta gling bzhi pa'i sems can yang 'god mi nus pa'i rtags dang*/ mtshan ma 'di 'dra ba zhig gis chog par 'dzin cing*/ 'di 'dra ba zhig la ngo mtshar du 'dzin na/ sngon tha mal pa'i bsam pa de bas kyang ngan du song*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sems can thams cad bslus par gyur pas/ 'di 'dra ba zhig gis chog cing ngo mtshar du mi gzung ngo snyam pa'i go cha bgos nas/ rtsa ba dang po'i rjes su zhugs te/ sgrub pa la nan tan cher bya'o// yang na rtsa ba gnyis pa'i don dran par bya ste/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad skyon dang yon tan du snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin/ sems nyid la che chung dang bzang ngan ci yang med/ rang sems kyi de bzhin nyid las mi g.yo bar bya'o// de ltar byas pas skyon dag yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur pa la tshegs med do// mdor na gegs dang bar chad sel lugs rnam par bzhag pa/ rtsa ba mos gus dang rang sems bsgom pa las/ rtsa rlung dang thig le mgo dang 'phongs su sgom pa'i rnam gzhag mang po dang*/ a ya gsas mkhar la mo dang bon gyi bya lugs mang po dang*/ mchod gnas rgyal ba skyabs la gsung rab rigs mi gcig pa mang po'i 'don lugs dang*/ bla mkhyen dkon mchog skyabs la ju yag dang rtsis 'ding lugs dang*/ yul che ge mo dang mang ge mo'i bla ma rje btsun ming 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba yod bya ba la sogs pa bya rgyu mang yang*/ thag rul gyi sna 'breng rul gyis mthud pa yul tha 'khob du rmongs pa mgo bskor ba la phan pa srid kyang*/

nyams rtogs dang yon tan gyi bar chad rtsa ba bsam pa la skyon byung bas/ rang sems gnad du ma bskyal na cis kyang mi phan par nges so// de ltar lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs dang bar chad bsal nas/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gar ngos 'dzin snyam na/ rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur pa la bya ste/ sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje las// gnyis su med pa'i rgyu 'bras rnams// spros pa med pa'i ngang tshul gyis// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis ston// 'ching grol med pa ngo mtshar che// 'di lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin// bslab pa gsum dang sde snod gsum// rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa zhes// dpal ldan bla ma dam pas gsungs/ kyai/ rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// 'ching byed 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi las// zhen pa btang la sgrub pa bya// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// 'khor ba'i bde skyid 'di dag la// chags pas sgrub pa mi byed na// ra yi o srong tshil gru+ug la// dman pa'i byis pa chags dang mtshungs// rtag tu khyi rgan rus pa mur// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// 'jig rten mgon gyis lung bstan pa// 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang*// nus pa mchog brnyes 'bir wa pa// brgyud pa'i bla ma rje btsun pa// til+li nā ro la sogs rnams// zang zing spros pa'i 'du 'dzi yis// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don rnams kun// cis kyang 'grub par ma gzigs shing*// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de// bsgom pas 'byung bar dgongs pa yin// rdzu 'phrul nus pa sna tshogs kyis// gdul bya smin par mdzad nas kyang*// dben par bzhugs pa'i tshul ston pa// rjes zhugs rnams la bstan pa yin// go 'am rtogs sam rnal 'byor pa// grub thob rje btsun gong ma rnams// 'du 'dzi spros pa sna tshogs kyis// gzhan don 'grub par dgongs lags na// nged kyi tsam re sus ma 'grub// thar pa 'dod na dam pa rnams// rang la rang phye ma gtor dang*// mu ge byung la snyad btags nas// snam bu bor tshong ma byed cig

/gzhan don nyid la snyad btags nas// rnyed pas rnyed pa ma 'tshol dang*// zang zing grong gi mo chog dang*// mthu chen nad pa gso ba 'di// sma babs rin gyis nyo ba yin// rang nyid ngan sar skyur ba yin// brgyud pa gong ma'i rnam thar yang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis snubs pa yin// bu rang la sems pa'i slob ma rnams// gong ma'i rnam thar rjes snyegs te// dang po ri dwags lta bu yi// spyod pa nyams su blangs nas kyang*// gcig pu gnyis su med par bsgom// gnyis pa seng ge lta bu yi// nyam nga med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// ngam ngam shugs kyis 'gyur ba yin// gsum pa nam mkha'i 'brug lta bu// 'gran zla med pa'i rnal 'byor gtso// 'jig rten gsum du grags par 'gyur// 'di yi dus su rnal 'byor pa// lus kyi 'bad rtsol mi 'tshal te// sems can rnams kyi don chen yang*// sems can rnams kyi don ched du// sgrub pa tshul bzhin byas pa des// mtshan tsam thos par gyur pas kyang*// sems can dpag tu med pa rnams// smin cing grol bar 'gyur ro zhes// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsungs// des na sgrub la nan tan bskyed// rang don gzhan don phun tshogs pa// chos rje sgom las 'byung zhes gsung*// de sgrub pa snying por byas pa las// sa dang lam gyi yon tan dang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas yon tan rnams// 'byung bar 'gyur ba nges pa yin// des na sgrub pa snying por bya// gal bo che la lan gsum ste// yang bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad dang*// srung ba mchog tu gyur ba yang*// rang gi dge sbyor gcig pu yin// sgom log sgom gyis sel ba yin// bogs kyang de rang bsgoms pas 'don// yon tan sgom gyis bskyed pa yin// mthar thug chos sku sangs rgyas kyang*// bsgom pas mthong bar 'gyur ba yin// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// ma rig 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa las// rig par byed pa'i mig gcig bla ma dam pa ste// de la mos gus byas pas rgyu lam 'bras bur yang*// skyon dag yon tan thams cad nges par rdzogs 'gyur zhes// thub pa'i gsung rab kun gyi mdo don rtogs gyur pa// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsung las rnyed pa 'di// lam zab bla ma'i lam la zhugs pa'i mos gus can// sgrub pa snying por byed cing zang zing rab spangs nas// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa la// bla ma dam pa'i gsung 'di nye bar mkho bar gnas// rdo rje 'dzin gyis byin gyis rlabs las byung ba'i tshig 'di dag

/rdo rje 'dzin pas byin gyis brlabs pas bskul bar gyur pa yis// rdo rje'i tshig rnams bdag gis yi ger bkod pa las// byung ba'i dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas thob shog /bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal dum dum khrigs su bris pa gces pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 8) ༄// phar phyin drug gi rnam bzhag dpag bsam gyi ljon shing*// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bdag nyid sems nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i sku// gnyis med lhun gyis grub pa bde chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// 'gro ba ma lus smin mdzad bla ma mchog la 'dud// 'dir rten gyi gang zag 'chi ba dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las yid phyung ba/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pas/ nges par sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur rang nyid kyis 'khur ba/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor bzhugs nas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad mo la gtugs te/ smin par bya ba dbang gis smin par ni byas/ grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pa'i dbang du byas na/ gang zag gi rigs cig car ba dang*/ rim gyis pa gnyis su shes par byas nas/ lam nyams su len lugs kyang so sor ma 'dres par/ rim gyis pa slob dpon chen po 'phags pa'i lam rim pa lnga ltar nyams su blang bar bya ba dang*/ cig car ba slob dpon bram ze chen po ltar cig chod du nyams su blang ba gnyis so sor ma 'dres par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ cig car ba yi sman chen de// rim gyis pa yi dug du 'gyur// rim gyis pa yi sman chen de// cig car pa yi dug du 'gyur// zhes pas ma 'dres pa gal che'o// de ltar lam gnyis po gang nyams su blangs kyang rung ste/

rang gzhan gnyis med/ 'khor 'das gnyis med/ snang sems gnyis med/ gnyis med 'ba' zhig tu song ba'i rnal 'byor pa des/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes na/ de rnams kyi don bya bar 'dod pa'i blo byung nas/ mnyam par bzhag pa de nyid la rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs pa 'ba' zhig gis/ rang gzhan gnyis dbye ba med pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mnyam gzhag de nyid kyis/ sems can thams cad smin pa dang 'grol bar 'gyur te/ de ltar 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i blo byung na/ sor mo bcu brang thog du bkram nas/ ga re sems can gyi don rang gi dge sbyor gyis byed dam/ dge sbyor ma yin pas byed/ bden pas byed dam brdzun pas byed/ mnyam gzhag gis byed dam/ rjes kyis byed snyam pa la sogs pa'i bsam pa lung dang rigs pa mang pos khong du chud par byas nas/ gnyis su med pa'i rang gi dge sbyor rgyun chad med par bskyang bar bya'o// 'o na 'di 'ba' zhig yin gyi/ gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub par mi bya'am zhe na/ 'di ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum na gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis kyang*/ mnyam par bzhag pa zhi ba'i gnas su bsam gtan 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par ma gsungs te/ phal cher rang gi lus dang srog la chags pa dang*/ rang gi dge sbyor dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ro la chags nas bogs thon pa shin tu dka' bar dgongs nas/ spyod pa bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' me tog zla mdzes kun tu bzang po'i nags tshal dam pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' khri'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam gtan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rnam par thar pas brtse zhing bzhugs pa la/ sems can dpag tu med pa khong rang nyid kyi rkyen dang 'phrad na ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog cing sangs rgyas/

khong rang gi rkyen dang ma 'phrad na ni/ ngan song gsum du 'gro ba mngon bar shes pas gzigs shing*/ thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas/ bsam gtan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' bde dang*/ dgon pa dang*/ 'khor dang bcas pa bor te/ rgyal pos gsod par shes kyang*/ rgyal po dpa' ba sbyin gyi pho brang rin chen ldan du bdag nyid chen po de chas pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de rnams zhabs kyi drung du so bya bzhin 'gre ldog cing ngud mo'i sgras gdong mchi ma dang bcas pas gsod kyis dogs nas 'jigs nas/ grong khyer du mi gshegs par gsol ba btab pa la/ 'di ltar yang lus dang srog la chags pa rnams kyis ni brtul zhugs 'grub par sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa rang nyid la bab par mthong ba dang*/ snying rje chen pos gdul bya'i don mthong ba dang*/ bdag med pa'i shes rab zab mo thugs su chud pas sems can dpag tu med pa smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa ltar/ sems can gyi don bya bar gsungs so// 'o na de kun sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi spyod pa rlabs po che yin gyi/ nged kyi dus la ma bab/ nged kyis mi nus sam snyam na/ de lta shin tu mad/ byang chub mchog tu sems ni ma bskyed/ byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa phan pa dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas ni gzhan ga na yod/ rang gis 'bad pa ma byas kyang gzhan gyis byas pas chog ste mchi/ 'di bzhin du ma byas na 'chi

'khor ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa ba ni mi 'ong bas/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams ltar 'bad pa mi dgos pa'i gdeng zhig khyod la byung ba yin te mchi/ de ltar ma yin na sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams pas brtson pa drag par byed dgos par go /de yang shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa 'di la mi rnams tshe thung*/ nad mang*/ nyon mongs pa che/ dbang po shin tu rno bas brtson 'grus kyi shugs mgo la me 'bar ba'am/ pang du sbrul 'ongs pa bzhin du bya dgos te/ de ltar sems can gyi don bya ba yang thabs mkhas pa dang shes rab zab mo rnam pa gnyis kyis thams cad sgrub dgos te/ de ltar ma song na/ rtag tu rang nyid glen pa yus kyis brgyal nas/ ngas lta 'di rnams la phan bde 'di snyed cig bsgrubs te/ nga'i kha la yang mi nyan dka' bar 'dug snyam nas/ phan sems 'chor ba yang yod pas thabs mkhas pa la nan tan bya'o// thabs mkhas pa de yang gang zhe na/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga ni thabs mkhas pa/ de'i don rtogs pa ni shes rab zab mo/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni thabs mkhas pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni shes rab zab mo/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang byed pa don yod pa ni thabs mkhas pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed kyis ma reg pa ni shes rab zab mo/ mi chos kyi bya ba dang byed pa rnam gzhag la mkhas pa ni thabs mkhas pa/ de la zhen pa dang chags pa dang bral ba ni shes rab zab mo ste/ mdor na gdul bya'i khams dang*/ bag la nyal dang*/ bsam pa'i tshogs dang mthun par zhugs shing*/ gdul bya dang shes pa gcig tu phru+ugs lhan cig kyis 'dres nas/ da ngas ci bya zer nas ci bcol yang bsgrub pa'i dus su/ ji ltar 'tshams pa'i chos sam/ yang na zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyis gdul bya de smin pa dang grol bar byas nas/ rang la zhe 'dod kyi rnam pa sgrub rgyu mi 'dug na/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug du 'gro ba'i don la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/

lta ba dang grub pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ gzhan phan zhen med kyi snying rje rang thog tu phyin na/ lta sgom gyi spyod pa gcig tu 'dres pa'i byar med chen po'i spyod pas/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dkar po'i phyogs kyi bya ba dang byed pa shin tu phra ba'i dngos po gcig kyang*/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang*/ sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa'i dngos po bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal ba dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i dngos po 'phrin las can gyi de lta bur 'gyur na/ de ci'i phyir 'bad pas sems can gyi don mi byed de/ shin tu yang bya bar rigs te/ de ni spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa tsam mo// ༈ //pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga thabs mkhas pa'i dbang du byas nas sbyin pa lta bu zhig sbyin par byed na/ sbyin par bya ba'i yul gang la dngos po ci lta bu tshul lam thabs ji ltar sbyin nas/ zhe 'dod ci lta bu zhig sgrub shes par gyur na/ dngos po rags pa dang phra ba gang sbyin yang chud zos par mi 'gyur bas/ 'di la nan tan chen pos brtag par bya'o// de la dang po kho na yul lam zhing*/ 'phags pa dang sems can gnyis su brtag par bya ste/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin na ni zhing thams cad kyang 'phags pa/ 'phags pa'i nang gi yang 'phags pa gong na med par byas shing mthong bas dngos po dang bsam pa yang de dang bdag gcig tu gyur pa yod/ yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i dbang du byas na/ snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can 'du shes med/ ces pas/ sems can 'di dag nye bar zhi bar yin yang*/ de ma shes pa'i sems can thabs kyis smin par byed pa/ chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ sbyin pa gang dang gang gtong yang*/ dngos po de dang de nyid la/ rang nyid kyis gces par byed/ phangs par byed/ snying por byed/ smar tshad dang ched ka chen por byas nas/

gdul bya de la sbyin par byed pa ni sbyin pa/ sbyin pa de yang rang gi bsam pa la bltas nas/ 'dod chags kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'am/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ phrag dog dang*/ rnyed pas rnyed pa tshol ba dang*/ mdor na 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi bsam pa dang bral ba ni sbyin pa de sbyin pa'i tshul khrims/ de la gzhan dag na re/ sbyin pa 'di ltar sbyin pa de chos brgyad sgrub pa yin/ rnyed pas rnyed pa tshol ba yin/ smyon pa yin/ 'khor 'dod pa yin/ pho bzo 'dod pa yin/ nga che dang nga bzang 'dod pa yin/ zhe 'dod chen po zhig khong na 'chang ba yin/ sbyin pa'i zhing bdam mi shes pa zhig 'dug /ces bya ba la sogs pa kha snyer dang zhe snyer/ ma 'thad pa dang ma nyan pa mang po lung rigs dang bcas nas 'thab pa dang*/ 'bar ba dang*/ 'khon du 'dzin pa dang*/ mgo dang rkang pa dang lag pa dang*/ mi 'tshams pa slong du byung ba la bzod par byed cing*/ yid mi skyo bar me phar la bus na rma ra tshur bshur ba dang 'dra bar/ ci tsam du slong ba kham che ba tsam du de bas kyang zhe 'dod kyi gtsigs par bzung ste/ gal te rab tu 'byung na'o// tshangs par spyad pa spyod na'o/ bu 'bul na'o// chung ma gtong na'o// lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'dag char byed na'o// rgad po nga'i g.yog byed na'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pas byed na/ de yang bsgrub par byed na ni bzod pa'o// yang sbyin rgyu'i dngos po tshong dang*/ khe dang zhing las kyi mtha' dang*/ rtsol sgrub sna tshogs kyis bsgrub par byed pa la ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu 'tsho ba ma dag par gsungs shing*/ de byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i skabs kyang gsungs pa de yang rigs pas rtogs par byas la spyad par bya ba'am/ 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ni/ rab tu byung ba'i bya bas bsod snyoms yin par gsungs te/

bsod snyoms de ni slong ba la zer ba yin pas/ 'tshams pa dang 'os pa dang*/ tshod zin pa slong ba dang*/ dad pas byin pa blang bar bya ste/ len pa'i thabs byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po ltar/ des sems ma bskyed na mi len pa dang*/ rang nyid chas su ma zhugs par mi len pa dang*/ dngos po des don chen po mi 'grub na mi len pa dang*/ sdums dang*/ bar dang*/ g.yon dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug dang*/ dmag dang 'khrugs pa la sogs pa chos dang mi mthun pa'i zhe 'dod phan tshun du yod na mi len pa dang*/ mdor na dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo sha stag rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i rgyu sha stag nyon mongs pa dang nyes pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba sha stag du 'bad par bya ba ni sbyin pa de'i brtson 'grus so// de la/ la la dag na re ci zer/ lung lung dag na ci zer/ rigs mi gcig pa mang po'i lung rigs dang*/ gsung rab mang po'i dgongs pa dang*/ bla ma mang po'i gsung sgros/ cal col mang po'i zer mchu mang yang*/ snying po che brang 'og tu gzhug ra lnga med par 'brog la gar 'gro /sbyin pa'i gtong lugs cig kyang ngas shes/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du yang sbyin pa 'di kho na gtong ba la bslab/ gang gis gang la tshul dang thabs ji ltar sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu ji lta bu 'byung ba shes pa'i gnyer kha khyed la med/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sbyin pa 'di ltar byin na ni/ mi rnams kyi nang du skye 'o// sbyin pa 'di ltar byin na ni/ khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams su skye ba nas lha rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sbyin pa 'di ltar byin na ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya'o// zhes gsungs pa 'di la yang nga rang mkhas/ nga'i sbyin pa 'di zhing dang*/ bsam pa dang*/

dngos po dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ thabs dang*/ shes rab dang*/ don che chung ji ltar 'byung ba nga rang gi bsam pa 'di'i thog nas shes pa zhig yod snyam nas/ gzhan gyi tshig gi rjes su mi 'brang zhing*/ 'gyur ba med par sems rtse gcig tu gyur pa de ni sbyin pa de'i bsam gtan/ sbyin pa gcig pu la pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga tshang ba'i thabs mkhas pa de lta bus gdul bya smin pa dang grol bar byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mtha' dag khong du chud par byas nas/ gdul bya thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa de lta bu la spyad par bya ba dang*/ rang gi rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyang 'di lta bu la 'god pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams sam/ da ltar yul gang na sbyin pa 'di ltar gtong ba 'di rnams la 'gram chu ldang ba dang*/ rkan sgra btog pa dang*/ snyan pa dang legs pa brjod pas/ rang dang 'khor dang nye du gnyen 'brel phyogs ris dang bcas pa'i phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa'i gter chen por 'gyur ba la 'bad par bya'o// de ltar yang*/ sbyin pa sbyin par bya ba'i yul 'phags pa dang*/ sems can la rten gyi gang zag 'gro ba smin cing grol bar byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul lam thabs pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga thabs mkhas pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin shes pa shes rab zab mo'i tshul gyis/ rang gi zhe 'dod sngar dam bcas pa'i sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed pa ni sbyin pa gcig pu'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o// yang 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi thabs mkhas pas/ sems can smin pa dang grol bar bya ba'i dbang du byas na/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ni dge ba chos sdud/ sems can gyi don byed/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum ste/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'am dam tshig kyang de nyid yin pas/ de ltar yang*/

dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams su/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi// zhes gsungs pas/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig kyang de nyid yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa 'di/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul yin pas/ 'di la bslab par bya ba'i tshul lugs spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis kyi tshul du bstan par bya ste/ spyi gong du bstan pa gsum po de nyid yin la/ bye brag ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dge ba'i chos gcig gi nang du dge ba'i chos thams cad 'dus par nyams su blang bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ go cha sum cu so drug gsungs pa lta bu yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' srog gcod pa spong pa'i sdom pa gcig pu gcig bsrung na/ sems can gyi don du bya ba ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ srog gcod pa spong ba de nyid dge bar gyur pas na/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ de sdom par gyur pa ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims te/ gcig la tshang bar 'gyur bar shes par bya ba dang*/ de ltar shes par dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ stobs bcu 'byung ba'i gnas/ nyon mongs pa dang nyes pa thams cad 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gter mdzod/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ lus can thams cad kyi mgon dang*/ skyabs dang*/ gnas dang*/ dpung gnyen du gyur pa/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom par gsungs pa 'dis rang gi rgyud kyang smin par dang grol bar byas shing*/ gzhan gyi rgyud kyang smin pa dang grol bar bya ste/

de ltar yang*/ brgal nas bsgral bar bya ba dang*/ grol nas dgrol bar bya ba dang*/ dbugs phyungs nas dbyung bar bya ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das nas mya ngan las 'da' bar dam bcas pa'i dbang gis so// de ltar dam bcas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mthong bas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu mngon sum du gyur pa/ tshul khrims rin po che 'di ma gtogs pa nyams su blang rgyu med pa rnams ni rang gi lus dum bu brgya'am/ stong du gtub kyang ston pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal bar mi byed de// nyes pa chung shos sha kham gcig gi dbang du byas kyang*/ mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ nyes pa med pa'am/ chung ba'i lung rigs dpag tu med pa bshad pa mang yang*/ nged glen pas bltas pas/ da ltar mi dang mi ma yin pas srog chags dud 'gro la sogs pa'i sha zhim po za 'dod pa mang bar 'dug des srog chags mang po za zhing srog gcod pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug /srog gcod pa rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa dmyal bar skye bar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs na/ brgya la'am gal te thams cad mkhyen pa de mi bden re e yod/ bden no zhe na rang la rang snying yang mi rje'am/ dus da lta ni ka ra dang*/ bu ram dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ zho dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ mar dang*/ thud dang*/ phye dang*/ zan dang*/ chab tshas kyang ltor mi btub/ bza' ba ni sha/ btung ba ni chang*/ skyo rogs ni bud med la byas pa 'dis kyang*/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba/ rgyu mi dge ba ma zad kyi bar du 'bras bu sdug bsngal zad par mi 'gyur ram yang bsam/ sha nyes pa chung shos su yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gsungs te/ nyes pa dpag tu med pa'i gzhir dgongs shing gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ mya ngan 'das dang sor phreng dang*// glang po rtsal dang sprin chen dang*// lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo 'di las// ngas ni sha ni rnam par bkag

/ces gsungs so// de ltar nyes pa chung shos su byed pa sha kham gcig kyang 'di 'dra na/ gzhan rang bzhin gyi sdig tu gyur pa/ sems can rnams ngan song gsum du ltung bar byed pa/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur pa/ byang chub rnam pa gsum la sgrib pa chen por gyur pa/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i gshis su gnas pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gces pa'i sras rnams la mi bya ba dgag pa'i bslab par bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rang gi lus sam yan lag sbrul gdug pa'i khar bcug pa ni bla yi// brtul zhugs nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no// zhes thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas bka' stsal gsungs pa lta bu rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni bla yi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar rang nyid nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i thabs mkhas pa la gnas shing*/ 'gro ba gzhan yang thabs mkhas pa 'di la bskul zhing ar nan tha byas te/ de ltar yang*/ dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen dang*// sna 'ga' sna gcig nyin mtshan gyi// cha shas bsrung ba'i sdom pa yang*// ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// 'dul ba lung du gsungs pa dang*// bsnyen gnas gso sbyong ral pos kyang*// lha yi gnas su skye bar gsungs// da ltar 'gro ba gzhan dag kun// tshul khrims bzang la bkod pa yis// sdom brtson 'chal bar gyur rnams dang*// ngan song gsum du lhan cig tu// 'gro bar mi 'gyur ram snyam na// ngan song gsum du skye ba'i rgyu// tshul khrims btang ba ma yin nam// sdom pa btang ba ltung gyur na// nged kyis sdom pa 'bog pa yis// lhan cig ngan song ltung pa yi// rgyu lam 'bras bu mi mtshungs pas// gnas dang dus kyi bskal par nges// de ltar gyur na ci phyir sdang*// yang na sems can thams cad la// gshis su yod pa'i mi dge ba// spong ba'i sdom pa blang ba la// sdig pa zad dang srab pa'am// nyes pa chung ngun spangs pa yi// dge bas thar ba'i sa bon bzhag

/mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob par nges// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas nged kyang yin// da lta'i sangs rgyas khyod kyang min// 'gro don byed na de ltar byed// 'di yang gong du bshad pa bzhin// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa la// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan thabs su bstan// thabs mkhas 'di la spyod pa yi// skyes chen bdag nyid chen po rnams// rang nyid tshul khrims bsrungs ba rnams// gzhan rnams tshul khrims mchog la 'god// gang dang gang na tshul khrims can// bzhugs par gyur pa de dag gi /zhabs rdul spyi bos len byed cing*// yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba brjod// chos kyis thob pa'i zang zing gi /bgo bsha' mnyam du spyad pa yis// tshul khrims ldan pas gang ba dang*// tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa// dpa' bo rnams kyi spyod pa yin// 'di yang byas na 'byung ba yin// ma byas sa bon med pa la// 'bras bu 'byung ba ga la yod// 'di lta bu yi spyod 'gros de// pho rgod po gcig gi las ka yin// mi 'ding can gcig gi spyod 'gros yin// sus 'byung ba med pa'i las ka yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bu gcig yin// bla ma dam pa'i gces se yin// bstan pa 'di yi bdag po yin// yin lugs mang ste brjod mi lang*// 'di ltar yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa la gnas nas/ sems can gyi don bsgrub ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ bya dka' ba dpag tu med pa bzod par mdzad cing*/ myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par gsungs pa la/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ khro ba spangs pas phyir mi ldog pa nyid// 'thob par 'gyur ba thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ nged rang gis bltas pas kyang*/ sngon gyi lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de rnams dang*/

pho 'bring po gang yin pa de rnams thams cad kyang tsha bzod/ grang bzod/ skyid bzod/ sdug bzod/ sdug bsngal thams cad khyad du bsad pas pho 'bring po yan chod byung ba yin mod/ nged kyang pho 'bring po yan chad cig bsgrub pa la bzod pa chung bas 'ong ba ga la srid/ 'di na kha cig bslab pa rin po che gsum gyis rgyud kyang ma sbyangs/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rjes su yang ma bslabs/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa dang ma phrad/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi spyod 'gros kyang ma mthong*/ yon tan khrab khrob cig la brten nas/ rje btsun nam/ bla ma'am/ rin po che zhes brjod pa'i tshig gam/ 'khor ram/ grags pa'am/ bkur bsti bag tsam gyis dregs nas/ mthon dman gyi tshig gam ma legs pa la bzod pa chung bas/ rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa ga la srid pas gzhan gyi gnod pa bzod pa shin tu gal che/ de yang yul mi nye ring dang phyogs gzhan gyi gnod pa gang yin yang bzod pa sla bar 'dug /rdzas dang yo byad sbyin pa'am rang nyid gzhan du song bas kyang chog par 'dug pa la/ rang nyid kyi 'khor du gyur pa/ lhan cig gnas pa/ 'brel ba shin tu zab par gyur pa rnams phan cher btags na gnod pa cher skyel ba/ rang gis mi re dgu re nas/ ma rtsis dgu rtsis pa/ re ba sna gcig kyang ma byung nas/ gnod pa sna tshogs thabs sna tshogs kyis byed pa 'ong*/ de la bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems can rnams 'di 'dra srid dgos pa yin mod snyam du bsams nas go cha gyon pa gal che gsung*/ nga rang gis ni dang po su la yang re ba chen po ma byas nas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' med pa las chos nyid gcig gam/ zhag gcig tsam byas pas kyang bsngo bas zin na chud mi za ba tsam la bsams nas/ re ba chung bar byas pas 'khon pa dang sgyid lug pa nyung bar byung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po don mo ri ba'i mkhan bu ston pa dge slong zhig gis/

dge 'dun gyi lug rkus nas 'byin pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zhal nas/ 'di ma 'byin/ 'di bzang po yin/ 'di'i blo la 'phags pa sdud pa yod gsung skad pa 'di rang gi shes pa la bab pa byung*/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gis sems can thams cad kyi yon tan brjod pa la/ re shig sprang po yon tan sna gcig kyang med pa btsog pa skyug bro ba zhig la/ a ti sha 'di la yon tan ci yod dris pas/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bzhugs pa yin mod gsung skad/ lar 'gro ba'i 'dren pa chen po gzhan gyi yon tan la rtsis chung zhing cir yang mi mthong*/ kham po che mang po zhig rdzun gyi gshor rgyugs la hab shi hub shir len 'dod/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gam/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi yon tan shin tu phra ba yod pa rnams la mgu zhing*/ chos phra ba nas so nam lug 'gros su shes na bsam sa chen por 'ong*/ phal cher mi mgu ba de rang gi rdzas dang yo byad 'jig rten gyi bya ba la zhen drags pa'i skyon yin/ de 'dras phan btags nas re ba gzhan du byas na go ba 'dzol zhing 'thab mo'i rgyur 'gro/ blo drang por bzhag nas nges par byas nas yi ge drug pa tshar gcig brjod pa'i rin ji tsam yin/ tshul khrims nyin gcig bsrungs pa dang*/ mdo tshar gcig bton pa dang*/ bcos ma'i sems bskyed lan gcig byas pa dang*/ ku re'i sems bskyed lan gcig byas pa'i rin ji tsam yin te/ de tshod la yang mgu bar bya dgos/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis gnod pa byas pa'i lan mi ldon pa'i bzod pa de tshod tsam zhig byi bo dbyig pa thogs pa la yang yod/ 'gro ba'i 'dren par gyur ba'i bla ma rnams ni gnod pa byas pa de nyid phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas so// de bde bar ji ltar 'brel snyam nas/

rang la gnod pa ji ltar byas kyang de nyid lam du btang*/ de ni tshad med pa'i snying rje chen pos dbang byas shing*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis btsir gyis bzung*/ bla ma dam pa'am lhag pa'i lhar mos shing*/ sus smras sus thos gang gis gang zhig gang gi phyir// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin mchog ldan pa mdzangs pa yin// zhes pa'i don yul dang yul can gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ skye med ston pa'i slob dpon du// lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnod pa shar// dgra gnyen du chod pa'i dpa' bo dang*// gnyen stong par rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis// sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// dus rgyun chad med par sga ra ra// rdo rje'i gdan dang dpal gyi ri// u rgyan gnas dang ti se'i gangs// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams su// 'di las lhag pa'i dngos grub ni// lhag pa gtan du mi srid snyam// ku re kyal ka ma lags te// rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma dpang*// rang la skyes pa'i nyon mongs 'di// ji tsam rang gis thul ba'i tshe// bral dang rnam smin yon tan la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gror btags par nges// 'di yang bzod pa gzhir bzhag nas// bzod pa'i sbyin pa tshul khrims dang*// bzod dang brtson 'grus bsam gtan rnams// thabs la mkhas pa'i mchog tu gsungs// bzod pa zur tsam bstan pa'o// ༈ //'di ltar bzod pa bsgoms shing gnod par byed pa 'di zhe thag pa nas snying rus pa'i gting nas ci bzang*/ ci yag ci rgyal/ ji ltar byas na dngos dang brgyud pa phyogs dang ris su bcad pa thams cad ji ltar du rgyal snyam du bsams shing*/ lag len la de ltar du gdab/ 'di'i dus su kho rang gis gting ma rtogs shing phyag 'tshal du ma byung gi bar du ngas byas dang*/ drin brtsi dang*/ lan bgrang dang*/ de byas dang 'di byas kyi lo rgyus rtsa na 'dug pa tshun chad la ye mi bya/ de ltar rang gi bsam sbyor bzang po de yang shes/

gsol ba ma btab pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du yang go /byang chub sems dpa' chen por thag chod nas 'dud pa dang*/ gus 'dud byed pa'i dus su bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par byas nas/ rdzas dang yo byad dam 'jig rten gyi zhe 'dod phul gang yang mi sgrub pa gal che ste/ sngar byas pa thams cad kyi 'bras bu dge bshes mi chos pa zab mo zhig tu ma shor bar bya ba'i phyir ro// 'di yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo ste// dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// srod la bdud kyi sde btul nas// tho rangs byang chub mngon sangs rgyas// bzod pa'i thabs la mkhas pa yis// 'gro ba smin par bya ba'o// brtson 'grus kyis sems can smin par bya ba'i dbang du bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mgo'am/ gos la me shor ba bzhin du brtson 'grus brtsam par bya ste/ brtson 'grus de yang gang zhe na/ slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal snga nas/ brtson gang dge la spro ba'o// zhes gsungs pas dang po kho nar bya ba byed pa gang byed kyang*/ sor mo bcu brang thog tu bkram/ snying gis bsams/ gom pas gzhal/ ma tshor ba mkhas pa la dris nas/ nga'i bya ba dang byed pa 'di rnams byas zin pa'i rjes la/ bya ba'i yul de dang*/ bya ba de dang*/ rjes la bsams nas/ byas pa don med par mi 'gyur ram/ yang yul dang bsam pa dang rjes la bsam nas/ phyed dang sum cha tsam don du 'gyur ram/ yang na thams cad don du 'gyur ram snyam du brtag par bya ste/ phal cher mya ngan las 'das pa'i nye bar zhi ba la gzhol ba/ 'bab pa/ bab pa ma gtogs par phal cher don med yin/ don chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'ong snyam nas/ sa mtha' gyang bskor ba dang*/ mkhar len bya byed mang po dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshe 'di dang 'dres pa'i bya byed mang po gang ci byas kyang*/ gzhan gyi bsam pa dang 'thad par mi 'ong*/

nged lta a cang che ste/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i yang dgon skor/ sems can dpag tu med pa smin pa dang grol ba'i rten cing 'brel ba dpag tu med pas ni sgrub/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas ni yin nges/ bu tsha bo de snyed cig la bsam sa de las med par thugs ni mthun par gyur pa yin pa la yang*/ mi re re rang rang gi rtog pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi yul du yang mi 'gyur bar gtong bar 'dug na/ nged kyis rtog pa'i rjes su 'brangs pas/ byas pa la mi rtag pas khyab pa/ chu'i chu bur lta bu rnams la don 'byung ba lta ga la yang srid de/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ko'u shi ka'i mdo las/ skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*// rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta// zhes gsungs pas so// 'o na thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba'i chos gang yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod gang yin/ pha las bus byed na pha jo gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa gang yin snyam du bsams pas/ sems can smin grol byed pa gcig tu nges/ sems can smin cing grol ba la rang smin cing grol ba zhig dgos/ de yang rang la med par gzhan la sbyin pa mi srid pa'i chos yin/ des na rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa brtson 'grus kyi bya ba'i lugs ni/ nang par snga thun dang po la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thun che ba zhig bsgom/ ro myong zhing nges pa'i shes pa skyes par bya/ de nas tshad med pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs nas byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ rgyud byang chub sems su gyur pas/ thugs dam gnyug ma bzlas pa dang bcas pa nan tan che bar bya/

dro gong phan chad du mtshams ci dam du bya/ snga dro dge sbyor byas nas srod dam nam phyed tshun chad du khrid dam bya ba ci byed kyang*/ myong ba'i ngang nas byas par bla lhag tu phan che bar 'ong bar 'dug lar gyis chos ci dang ci bshad kyang myong ba med na mkha' 'gro ma ngus pa'i gtam rgyud yod/ byin rlabs med na blo sna mi 'gyur ba chos nyid yin/ rgyu mtshan 'di la dgongs nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas chos gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de nyid yin pas/ bya byed sna tshogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rgyu 'di la ni 'di lta bu zhig 'byung ngo zhes bya ba shes pa'i shes rab bcu/ chos kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'khor bya ba dang ji ltar 'gyur ba dang*/ bzang ngan rgyu 'bras gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mos gegs sel ba dang*/ bogs 'don pa dang*/ brtul zhugs grub par bsgrub pa la nan tan bya'o// 'di yang pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga ma 'dres par so sor shes par bya ste/ de shes par gyur na/ phra ba dang*/ gtsang ba dang*/ mkhas pa dang*/ chud ma zos par 'gyur ro// 'di dang rgya cher byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rnams nas/ brtson 'grus kyi thabs mkhas par byung ba nan tan chen pos 'bad par bya'o// bsam gtan gyi thabs mkhas pas 'gro ba smin par bya ba'i dbang du byas nas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan bla ma rin po che'i de zhal snga nas/ yid 'jug yul brtag ces gsungs pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo nas kyang*/ rnam par rtog pa re re la sems gnas pa bsam gtan yin zhes gsungs pa la/ de ltar gyur na sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan can du 'gyur ro zhes zhus pas/ sems can rnams kyis de ltar shes na ni de nyid bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi/

khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal// ma lus ji snyed yod pa dang*// 'phags pa rnams kyi ting 'dzin dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las tshogs// 'gro ldog gcig tu nges pas na// spang bya gnyen po'i bye brag dang*// dwangs snyigs phye ba'i rim pa dang*// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye ba yis// mkhas pa rnams ni nges par 'jug /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i rjes su 'brang*// 'phags pa mngon par shes pas 'jug /nged kyang ston pa thugs rje can// yab gcig thams cad mkhyen pa yi// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rjes su 'jug /mngon shes the pra med na yang*// bde gshegs gsung gi man ngag la// nges shes skyes pa mkhas par mchi// mkhas pa'i gdams ngag gang zhe na// tshe rabs snga ma phan chad du// goms shing sbyangs pa gang che ba// da ltar de la 'jug par 'gyur// de nyid lam du slong shes na// bde gshegs sras po mkhas pa yin// de yang 'phags pa legs 'ongs dang*// slob dpon klu yi byang chub sogs// bla ma mkhas pas smin par mdzad// a a ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// nged kyis logs su ma btsal bar// gdul bya rnams la dgos dgu rnyed// nor bu rin chen ma lags sam// skyon med yon tan rdzogs byed cing*// gegs sel bogs 'don mkhas pa'i gnad// nor bu ras mdog chu mdog bsgyur// chu yi dngos po gcig pu la// ja dang chang la sogs pa yi// tsha grang kha dog ro la sogs// kha dog sna tshogs cir yang 'gyur// mkhas pas de ltar shes par bya// rdo rje 'dzin chen bla ma rnams// skyabs su song dang bslab pa'i gzhi// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma rang bzhin lhan cig skyes// 'di dag thabs kyis bsgrub pa yis// tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang*// lag pa brkyang bskum bar tsam gyis// don kun 'grub par byed pa lags// bsam gtan 'di la sbyin pa dang*// tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan thabs la mkhas pa yis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshul// gong ma bzhin du shes par bya// bsam gtan phyogs gcig bstan pa'o// shes rab phyogs gcig bstan pa ni// nyin dang mtshan mo thams cad du// kha zad gre ba ral ral du// rtag tu smras par gyur pa 'di// da yang khyed la snyan du gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// rten cing 'brel 'byung gang gsungs pa// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa 'di// shes rab pha rol phyin par gsungs// 'di yi 'dug lugs ma go na// byas pa thams cad don med cing*// gzhan rnams dmus long 'dra bar gsungs// kye kye rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// rang gi bsam pa zhig tu nges// sa bon rnam par shes pa la// de dang 'dra ba'i rnam smin lus// rgya dang rgya yi 'bur bzhin du// tshe 'di 'di 'og skye gzhan du// ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i tshul// mthong chos skyes nas myong 'gyur dang*// lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur zhes// yongs su grags pa 'di re bden// shan pa nya pa rngon pa zhig

/thub pa'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas// bsam pa bzang pos sbyangs pa la// che dgus mchod cing brjid pa mthong*// dman par gyur pa'i skye bo zhig /bsam pa bzang po nar son nas// lus kyis sprul sgyur byed pa dang*// ngag gi nus pa thob pa dang*// sangs rgyas mang po blta ba dang*// 'jig rten khams rnams bskor ba ni// mthong ba'i chos kyi 'bras bu zhes// bcom ldan 'das kyis lung du gsungs// rang sems 'di las ma gtogs pa// mtho dman 'bring gsum chos gzhan med// des na gzhan la mi 'dri bar// rang gi bsam pa'i 'gro ldog ltos// kye ma rang gi bsam pa 'di// nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can gyi// khams dang mnyam par 'jug gyur cing*// sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba dang*// bde ba thams cad sgrub pa'i blos// byang chub mchog la 'god byed cing*// bsam pa dri ma med pa 'dis// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsdus te// 'di lta bu yi sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la mi 'god cing*// 'gro ba kun dang mnyam pa'i lus// gal te 'thob par mi 'gyur na// sa bon rnam par shes pa la// 'bras bu lus su mi 'grub cing*// yang na rgyu med skye ba 'am// yang na sa bon gzhan zhig la// 'bras bu gzhan zhig skye 'gyur ram// sa bon rgyu rkyen las skyes phyir// rtag par gyur pa yod pa min// de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems// sems can kun dang mnyam pa yis// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'di// med na mi 'byung nges pa ste// rten 'brel lugs las 'byung ba'o// lugs las ldog pa bstan pa 'di// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi ltar// rtsa ba'i gnas la mi blta ste// da lta skye bzhin grub bzhin pa'i// rang sems kun rdzob byang chub sems// gdod nas yod dang med pa dang*// zhi dang ma zhi spros pa yi// mtha' dang bral bar gang gis rtogs// de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs ni shes rab pha rol phyin// chos kyi sku zhes grags pa yin// e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyis chos// da lta'i shes pa rang sems 'di// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa yis// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dang*// chad lhag med par mnyam pa 'dis// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// don kun mi 'grub mi srid snyam// rang sems skye med rdo rje dang*// 'di nas shi bar gyur pa yis// 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol dang*// chos sku gcig tu skye ste 'ong*// snyam pa'i shes pa nga la med// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dang*// gnyis med mnyam par gyur ba'i sems// skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' yas kyang*// myong dang myong byed myong mkhan rnams// gnyis med nye bar zhi ba nyid// smra dang bsam dang brjod pa dang*// shes pa'i yul las 'das pa 'di// shes rab pha rol phyin pa ste// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa yi// shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'dis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par bya// pha rol phyin pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yis// 'gro ba smin pa'i tshul bstan nas// theg pa chen po gsang sngags mchog

/rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas te// gsang sngags 'phrin las zab mo yis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshul// skyob mdzad mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// bcom ldan thugs rje chen po yis// 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed// rten 'brel gnad kyi tshul bstan pa// sngags dang rdzas la sogs pa yi// re re'i che ba gang yin yang*// drang srong mngon shes ldan pa 'am// tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug rnams// bred cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba la// lhar bcas 'jig rten gzhan ci smos// rdo rje 'chang chen dgongs pa 'di// khyad du ma gsod rnal 'byor pa// rdo rje dmyal bar skye las che// mthar thug 'khrul 'khor zab mo 'di// rten 'brel ji bzhin nyams su blang*// snang srid dbang du bsdus la bzhag /nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// thams cad myur du zhi bar bya// tshe dang dbang phyug bsod nams dang*// phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par bya// drag po bcom ldan 'jigs byed kyi// cung zad bsgyings pa'i lta stangs kyis// tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang*// chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyang*// bred cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba la// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams// gzhan du 'gyur ba smos ci dgos// 'di yang 'gro ba sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i thabs// bcom ldan thugs rje can gyis gsungs// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni// kye ho 'di dang 'di dag rnams// 'di dang 'di dag thams cad du// 'byung zhing 'jug par 'gyur ba'i gnad// dpal ldan 'dus pa la sogs par// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yis// sems can smin par byed pa'i thabs// nye bar zhi ba 'od gsal ba// skyob pa thugs rje chen pos gsungs// zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa yis// 'gro ba smin pa'i thabs bstan nas// yang gcig gdams ngag bstan pa ni// tshe 'dir skyes pa'i lus ngag yid// skyes pa'i lus dang bsag pa'i nor// bslab pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// rigs rgyud cho 'brang che thabs rnams// ltos pa med par rgyab du dor// nyams myong can gyi ku sā li// ri khrod dbang phyug drung du phyin// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs byas shing*// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa des// 'di la pho tshod zur tsam yod// nyams su myong ba'i dum gcig skyes// lag pa'i changs su 'di nyid bcangs// snying gi rdig

phugs nor tu 'di la byas// lus ngag yid gsum bya byed rnams// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor bsgrubs// rin chen gling du phyin pa bzhin// ngan cing bor rgyu sna gcig med// ci byas chos su song ba 'dis// ched du byas ba'i sgrub rgyu med// gang dang gang du phyin na yang*// phan zhing dge ba bsgrub pa las// nyes pa'i rgya mtshor mi gnas pas// kun gyis bkur bas brod par gda'// 'di yang thabs la mkhas pa'i gshis// lhun grub rgyun chad med pa yis// 'gro don lhun gyis grub pa yin// ji ltar nam mkha'i rang bzhin ni// rdul gyis reg par mi nus ltar// don dam blo yis ma reg pa// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gshis sam babs su 'dug pa 'di// rang gi blo yis mi bsgom par// bya byed med pas nga re skyid// lhun gyis grub pas gsod re dal// 'bral ba med pas sha re tsha// dgos 'dod 'byung gnas nor re che// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che// rgyun chad med pa'i bla ma 'di// 'bral ba med pas 'tshol mi dgos// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad la// sba gsang med par ston mdzad pa// thugs rje chen po 'gro ba'i mgon// rang sems bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// 'di yang mgon po rin chen mchog /mnyam med bla ma dam pa yin// bkra shis bde legs yon tan gyis// 'gro ba smin par 'gyur pa'o// ༈ //yang mi chos kyi bya ba dang byed pa rnam par bzhag pa la mkhas pa ni/ thabs mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i go ba ni/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'dul bar byed pa la/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa dang*/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la shin tu mkhas dgos/ de yang*/ mkhas pa de gang yin na/ thams cad mkhyen pa stobs bcu mnga' ba de gcig pu yin/ stobs bcu rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khor lo bskor ba dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sde snod gcig pu yin/

'dul ba de nyid la shin tu legs par sbyangs pa ni/ bya ba dang byed pa thams cad la shin tu mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur zhing*/ mdo sde'i sde snod la mkhas pas ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen bsgrub pa dang*/ 'gal ba'i rkyen sel ba dang*/ bogs 'don pa dang*/ gegs sel ba la sogs pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod la mkhas pa ni/ snod dang bcud dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ gnas par byed pa'i gzhi/ 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen mtha' dag la mkhas par 'gyur ro// de thams cad kyang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dag kyang*/ rten gyi gang zag gcig gis lam nyams su blang ba'i rim pa gcig pu yin gsungs pas/ lar gang la yang mkhas pa zhig ma byung na/ rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i rim pa dang*/ gzhan nyams su blangs pa'i lag len du btub pa mi 'byung bas/ gang la yang mkhas dgos pas/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i nyan thos rnams ni shin tu mkhas pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'jig rten gyi bzo'i gnas dang*/ las kyi gnas la mkhas pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di la yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po gong ma de rnams sam/ rgyal po me long gdong can nam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sha ra ba ltar 'gro ba mang po'i blo gros dang mdun ma 'dri ba'i gnas su gyur pa zhig dgos/ de ltar ma gyur na 'jig rten gyi mi mang po zhig dang*/ rang la brtse zhing gus pa mang po zhig /'di la pho tshod gcig yod de 'ong snyam nas mdun phugs su byas/

gros dris/ rang nyid bsam ba babs la mi gnas par byas shing*/ gzu lum tshul 'chos dang*/ ras gcod snang chung la dga'/ blo nyes kyi mdun ma gcig pu zhig gis/ rang skad cig ma gcig gis nag hrul gyis 'gro ba la tshegs med de/ dper na/ spre'u dpon po zhig la/ spre'u g.yog lnga brgya yod pa la/ dpon pos zla ba'i gzugs brnyan chu nang du shar ba mthong bas/ de la phan sems dang snying stobs chen po byung nas/ zla ba mtsho'i nang du lhung gi 'jig rten thams cad mun par bya'o zhes/ spre'u gcig gis gcig gi mjug ma la 'jus nas/ mtsho'i nang du dpyang thag byas nas song ba la/ dpyang thag chad nas dus gcig tu shi ba la/ nam mkha'i lhas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ 'di na blun po gang zhig la// 'dren pa blun po yod pa ni// gnyis ka phung bar 'gyur ba ste// zla ba 'byin pa'i spre'u dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ mi mkhas pa'i rten gyi gang zag ni phyogs 'ga' zhig la brten nas grags pa che bar 'byung*/ 'o na bden nam snyam nas dam pa 'ga' zhig gi drung du phyin pa la/ yon tan gyi rnam par bzhag pa sna gcig kyang mi 'dug /za na za mi shes/ 'gro na 'gro mi shes/ ci dang ci byed pa la 'di byas dogs chen po zhig tu song*/ bya byed ma legs pa sna gcig gis nag hrul gyis gtong ba la tshegs med pas/ mkhas par bslab pa dang*/ mkhas par bya ba dang*/ mkhas pa la brten nas bya ba thams cad la legs par brtag ste/ khong du chud par byas nas/ legs pa'i rjes su 'jug par bya'o// des dgos pa ji lta bu zhig sgrub na/ thabs de lta bus gdul bya'i yid tshims par byas nas byang chub la 'god pa bshad zin to// shes rab chags pa med pa gang zhe na/ mi chos kyi bya ba de dang de rnams kyi nang du gnas pa ltar 'dug kyang*/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos pa'am/ nor bu rin po che chu 'dag rnyog gseb tu bcug pa'am/ dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa ltar/

nyes pa'i skyon dang bral nas dgos pa'i don 'grub pa sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis gdul bya sna tshogs thabs sna tshogs kyis 'dul bar byed pa dbang chen po thob pa rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pa dang*/ yang nged rang gi dbang du byas na/ 'di rnams thams cad gting khong du chud par byas nas/ bsam pa rgya mtsho chen po ltar gyur pas/ su la yang skur yul mi brtsi ba dang*/ kha gtsod ru'i rwa bas dog par byas nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis nyes pa'i skyon spu'i rtse mo tsam gyis kyang ma gos par dka' thub dang*/ brtul zhugs dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pas/ 'di yod na yod/ med na med/ phyogs gcig tu 'then pas/ rang nyid gnas brtan rgyal po lta bur gyur pa dang*/ re rag 'jig gsum yod pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos dper na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po spas/ byang chub sems dpa' ltar sdig pa spong ba dge ba nyams su len pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rlabs po che'i zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog byed pas thugs mnyes pa dang*/ ngo so che ba dang zhabs tog du 'gror re nas ngo so nyi zla tsam du 'gro ba dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba spyod pa rnams ni/ dpong gi sar kha bzhin du thag ring por bskrad par 'gyur ba'am/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzi brjid mig gis blta bar mi bzod pa bzhin du 'gyur bas/ ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa dgon par sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs 'di lta bus/ rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa 'di la ni/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che de nyid dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgyes shing bsngags pa chen po gsung zhing*/ bstod pa dang*/ bsngags pa dang*/ bkur bar mdzad do// ༈ //drang srong chen po mi shigs brtul zhugs 'dzin// mi yi seng ge mtshungs med dbang phyug gtso// 'gro ba 'dren pa kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// bstan pa'i khur bsnam rab brtan glang chen bzhin// ri bo'i sul dang gangs dang nags na gnas bcas pa/

kye ho/ bde dang skyid pa 'di 'dra 'jig rten khams na med// zas dang gos la zhen pa spangs nas ngan ngon tsam gyis chog byed cing*// phun sum tshogs pa rnyed kyang ro myang med par spyod byed cing*// bar snang rlung bzhin rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor pa 'di bde// dpag med 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gyur 'khor gyi dbus nyid du// nyi ma lta bur mdzes shing lham mer gyur na yang*// zhe 'dod re dogs med pas zhum pa med gyur pa'i// mi yi seng ge de ni je skyid je dgar 'ong*// yon tan tshogs kyis brgyags par gyur nas rang dgas zhugs pa'i blo med par// bla ma dam pa'i gsung rab tshogs las legs par bsdus pa 'di// yi ger bkod par gyur las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yis// 'gro ba ma lus thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /rang gzhan thams cad kyi don grub par byed pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lta bu bya ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 9) ༄// sde snod gsum gyi nyams len bsil byed tsan dan gyi phreng ba// oṃ swasti/ dpa' bo bdud las rnam rgyal bde chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// rtag pa'i rgyal po nam yang mya ngan mi 'da' ba// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// 'gro rnams smin mdzad rin po che yi zhabs pad 'dud// thub pa rnams kyi bstan pa rin po che// thog ma bar dang tha ma kun tu dge /mi shes mun sel 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gcig /skyabs mchog dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir thub pa chen po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/ dang por tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med pa rnam pa gsum du dka' ba dpag tu med pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tha mar rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du srod la bdud btul/

tho rangs ye shes kyi mes shes bya'i bud shing thams cad bsregs nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i bcom ldan 'das des/ rigs can rnam pa gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum bskor/ chos de yang chos kyi phung po'am sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs te/ de yang 'dod chags kyi gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ gti mug gi gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ cha mnyam pa'i gnyen por nyi khri chig stong ste brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo*// de bsdu na gsum ste/ 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ mdo sde'i sde snod/ mngon pa'i sde snod de/ sde snod rin po rnam pa gsum du 'dus so// de thams cad nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas na lam bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'dus te/ de ltar yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lam ni/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum 'di kho na'o// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pas nges so// 'o na theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di sde snod gsum gang du 'dus ji ltar yin snyam na/ kha cig gis gsang sngags sde snod bzhi par 'dod pa lags skad/ kha cig gis mdo sde'i sde snod du 'dod de/ gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du ngas bshad nyon/ zhes pa dang*/ kha cig gis ni 'dul bar 'dod de ma bla na med pa'i rgyud nas/ chos 'dul ba zab mo 'di zhes gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig gis mngon par 'dod de/ snod dang bcud gzung ba dang 'dzin pa/ phung po khams dang skye mched kyi dag pa ston pa'i phyir zhes gsungs so// de thams cad kyang don gcig ste/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas pas bslab pa gsum du 'dus pa kho nar nges so// de nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi bsdom pas legs par bsdams pa/

lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa nyams su blangs pa las/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skyes pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ de ji bzhin du sgom pa lhag mthong gi shes rab spyi dang*/ bye brag rang gi mtshan nyid shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad chags thogs med par mngon du gyur pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis sde snod gsum char du/ 'di la rigs pa dang zhabs su ldan pa zhes rgya cher bsngags pa mdzad cing bstod par gyur pa ste/ lam rim gyis pa'i dbang du bgyis pa'o// yang 'di 'ba' zhig tu nges gzhan du ma yin no snyam na/ dang po kho nar lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro ba yod de/ lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'am/ sde snod gsum la byang zhing mkhas par bslabs pas/ dang po nyon mongs pa ngo shes de nas de'i don bsam pas nyon mongs pa 'go gnon/ gdams ngag gzhan la rag ma las/ de bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa rtsa ba nas 'dag ste/ de ltar yang*/ thos pas mya ngan las 'das pa thob/ ces pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab tu thos pas grol ba dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro ba yod de/ sems rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa nye bar zhi ba lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ zhi zhing mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba thams cad nye bar zhi ba lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ lhag mthong gi shes rab shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mngon du gyur pa'am/ rgyu mthun pa ci rigs pa rgyud la skyes pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ de ltar yang ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ting 'dzin rgyal po 'di ni sgom byed pa// sbyin la mi sred tshul khrims sred ma yin// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ bslab pa rin po che gsum char sngon du gang 'gro ba ma nges pa sna tshogs su bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so// de ltar gyur na mi mthun pa sna tshogs rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pa 'dis ci zhig bya snyam na/

gong du ji skad smos pa bzhin du/ chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa sgo de la zhugs nas phug tu phyin pa ma lags sam/ sgo bsam pa'i 'jug sgo ma lags sam/ bsam pa'i 'jug sgo gang yin pa de la zhugs pas/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa rnam par spong ba ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ sgo de la zhugs pas sgo de'i nang rnam par grol pa'i khyim du phyin pa ni lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ sgo de'i phug 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rnam par grol ba'i ngor ro gcig pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ma lags sam/ de ltar lags na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa gsum la skyabs su song nas/ nyams len gyi bye brag mi gcig pa tha dad pa nyams su len pa kun yang chos yin par 'dra ba la/ nga'i 'di kho na chos yin/ kho'i de kho na chos min/ gsang sngags rnying ma chos min/ phyag na rdo rje chos min/ a ma na se

yid la mi byed pa chos min bya ba la sogs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la skur ba btab/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rgyu byas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'bras bur smin pa rang nyid snying rje ba yin pas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyi mig gis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mang po zhig mthong ba dang*/ thos na gang la yang skur ba mi 'debs shing*/ mig rnyed pa dang*/ mkhas pa dang go ba rnyed nas yongs su 'dzin pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por 'gyur ba yin te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa nas/ zhi gnas la gnas pa rnams ni lhag mthong gis rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// lhag mthong la gnas pa rnams ni zhi gnas kyis rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// cha mnyam par gnas pa ni khams kyis rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don/ zhes gsungs pas/ gang zag blo'i 'jug sgo tha dad pa la/ chos kyi tshul lugs tha dad pa nyams su blangs pas/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por 'gyur te/ rnam par grol ba dang rnam par grol ba'i rgya mtsho chen por chos thams cad ro gcig tu gyur ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab thams cad kyi mdo 'gag sde snod gsum gyi brjod bya/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ mkhas pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pa/ rmongs pa rnams mgo 'khor bar byed pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rtogs pa rnams kyi spyod yul 'di kho na khong du chud par bya'o// 'dir rnal 'byor pa ku sā lir ni khas blangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab thams cad kyi don ni khong du chud/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad la ni mkhas/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che rnams kyi gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas ni rgyud gtams/

sangs rgyas kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi nyams myong dang*/ mngon par rtogs pas ni sems tshims/ tshig dang yi ge'i rjes su 'brangs nas bya khwa ltar mu cor ni mi smra/ tshe phyi ma la dus ni mi 'debs/ nam mkha' stong pa la mtshan ma ni mi 'dzugs/ da lta nyams su blangs na da lta 'bras bu 'byung ba 'di/ rnal 'byor pa ku sā li'i gnyer yin pas/ ma bu sdug ngo sprod pa'i gdams ngag glen gtam rkyang pa zur cig smra bar bya ste/ bu 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// yod par nges sam med par nges// yod med gang du'ang ma nges pa// phung po gsum pa mi srid de// med pa'ang mi srid myong bas grub// yod par nges pa'i tshul lugs 'di// mkhas par gyur kyang ma go na// blun po byis pa mgo skor mkhan// rmongs pa rang nyid bslu bar zad// 'khor ba skye dang gnas pa dang*// 'gag pa'i tshul lugs shes pa ni// zhing sa gshin dang sa bon dang*// chu lud dus kyi rten 'brel gyis// mkhas pas ston thog thob pa ltar// dge dang mi dge'i bsam pa yis// mthun rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las// bde sdug 'bras bu sna tshogs pa// yun ring yun thung 'grub pa'i tshul// rang gis da lta byas pas chog /mtho ris ngan song gar 'gro ba// rig pa'i rgyal po rang dbang che// bu kha rog ma sdod rigs kyi bu// legs par soms dang bsam gzhig can// gnyer kha ma chung chen po khyod// brtson 'grus ma chung bsags pa can// 'dod yon spongs shigs rnal 'byor pa// snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /brgyud pa gong ma'i nyams len ni// sde snod gsum gyi bcud phyung ba// bu gcig chos 'di thugs la zhog /'jig rten du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byung ba'i dgos pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes kyi nyi ma shar bas/ gti mug gi mun pa sel ba yin te/

de yang ston pas gti mug gi gnyen po rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs la/ rten 'brel 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dus par bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde dran pa nye bar bzhag par gsungs pa dang*/ 'di shin tu zab cing gnad che ba yin te/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi// gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste// 'di ni gang gis yang dag mthong ba des// sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnam mchog mthong*// zhes gsungs pas so// 'di la spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa ston pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ rgyu drug 'bras bu drug tu 'dod pa dang*/ rgyu lnga 'bras bu bdun du 'dod pa dang*/ rgyu bcu 'bras bu gnyis su 'dod pa dang*/ 'dod lugs shin tu mang yang rtsa ba ma rig pa 'di yin/ 'di yod na bcu gcig po 'di 'byung la/ 'di 'gags na bcu gcig po 'di 'gag par gsungs pas/ rtsa ba ma rig pa ngos zin pa shin tu dka'/ de yang sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ rten 'brel gyi bdag po mkhas pa nga rgyal can zhig rten 'brel bshad pa la/ slob dpon ma rig pa 'di ci la zer ba yin zhus pas/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ ma rig pa la 'dod lugs mang*/ 'di 'dra ba yin bzhag tu mi gtub gsung skad/ de shin tu mad/ ma rig pa de mi shes pa'am mi rig pa yin mod/ bya ba de tsam pa las sus kyang shes pa dka' ste/ 'on kyang 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang bla ma dam pa'i lung gnyis kyis rtogs par bya ste/ 'di ngos ma zin na gnyen po bsten mi shes/ ngos zin na gnyen po bsten shes pas/ rkun ma ngos zin na rku mi nus/ 'dre ngos zin na gdon mi nus bya ba yin te/

bcom ldan 'das kyis sa lu ljang pa de nyid nas/ de la ma rig pa gang zhe na/ phung po lnga po 'di nyid la bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ rtag par 'dzin pa dang*/ chad par 'dzin pa la sogs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ltung byed yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ ma rig pas ma rig pa ste sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam pa dag pa 'di kho na ngo ma shes pa la/ ma rig pa zer ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa rgya che rol par yang de nyid rgya cher gsungs pa rnams kyis shes par bya ste/ mdor na phung po khams dang skye mched yor yor tur tur po/ rig rig po 'di gzhan gyi g.yar po ma yin/ rang nyid kyi 'di kho na la ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang*/ 'di dang 'di'i sngon gyi mtha' dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha' rtag pa dang chad par 'dzin pa ni ma rig pa yin la/ da lta'i phung po lnga po de ma rig pa gzhi bzhag tu gyur pa de'i rkyen gyis/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las 'du byed/ 'du byed de'i rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa dang*/ rga shi'i bar du rgyun ma chad par 'khor te/ de yang slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ bcu gnyis chos ni gsum du 'dus// gsum po dag las gnyis 'byung ste// gnyis las bdun 'byung bdun las kyang*// gsum 'byung srid pa'i 'khor lo ni// nyid ni yang dang yang du 'khor// zhes gsungs so// yang bcom ldan 'das kyis sa bcu'i mdor/ sa drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i skabs su/ de ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis po 'di ni sems gcig pu ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad sems so// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdor bdag tu 'dzin pa ma rig pa zhes gsungs pa'i don/ nga dang bdag med pa la nga dang bdag ces pa phyin ci log tu gyur ba'i rtog pa'am/

sems 'di ma rig par gsungs la/ ma rig pa'am sems sam yid de las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa yab sras mjal bar/ yid kyi nye bar spyod pa bco brgyad dbang po drug yul drug la chags pa dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ gsum gsum du skyes pas bco brgyad do// nged rang pha spad kyi shi tshig gsang gtam la/ dus deng sang thub pa'i bstan pa ni nub tu nye/ snyigs ma rnam pa lnga'i dus la ni babs/ chos byed lo byed pa rnams kyang lo tsam gyi rnam par gzhag pa las kyang med/ mkhas par gsol ba rnams kyang rna bas thos pa'i tshig khas bshad pa ma gtogs pa/ ci la zer shes pa yang dka' bar 'dug pas/ de yang dang po mig lta bu gcig la mtshon na/ yi ger bris pa'i mig ces bya ba dang*/ ri mor mig gi gzugs bris pa dang*/ gzhan dang gzhan dag gi mig gi rnam grangs khyi mig dang*/ bya mig dang*/ phag mig dang*/ byi'u mig gi bshad pa dang*/ bye brag gi rnam gzhag mang po yud tsam bzhag la/ rang gi mig 'dis gzugs rab 'bring gsum la cer gyis bltas pas/ snying du sdug pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba dang*/ shes pa chags pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ de skye na de la 'dod chags zer/ de kun nas bslang zhing rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus kyi byas tshad/ ngag gis smras tshad/ yid kyis bsam tshad/ nyon mongs de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa de kho na'i rigs 'dra ba 'byung ba ma gtogs pa gzhan du mi srid pas/ 'gro ba thams cad las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa'o// zhes gsungs so// yang mig gis gzugs mthong ba de yid du mi 'ong ba dang*/ mi sdug pa dang*/ mi dga' ba zhig skye bar 'dug gam mi 'dug 'di yang pha bsad pa'i lag dmar po lta bu mthong ba la zhe sdang de skye na/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi las des/ de dang 'dra ba'i rnam par smin pa 'byung ba dang*/ yang chags sdang gang yang ma skyes pa btang snyoms su gyur pa de la rmongs pa zhes zer bas/

rmongs pa de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi las byas pa des/ de dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 'byung bar gsungs pa dang*/ yang rna bas sgra/ mi chen po skyes bu dam pa zhes brjod pa la sogs pa la chags pa skye ba dang*/ mi ngan yul phung tshe ma phyid tshe ma 'khyol ba pa zhes pas zhe sdang skye ba dang*/ bar pa la rmongs pa skye ba dang*/ snas tsan dan dang ga pur dang gla rtsi'i dri tshor nas bla ma dang dkon mchog la bsngos pa'i dkor yin yang chags pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang rul pa dang mnam pa'i dri tshor na ni mi 'dod cing zhe sdang ba dang*/ lces ro mngar ba la chags pa dang*/ kha ba la sdang ba dang*/ lus kyi reg bya 'khrig pa la sogs pa'i bde ba la chags pa dang*/ na tsha dang mtshon gyis phog pa la sogs pa la zhe sdang ba dang*/ yid kyis chos bzang po'o zhes pa la chags pa dang*/ ngan pa'o zhes pa la zhe sdang ba dang*/ chags pa dang sdang ba ma skyes pa'i bar pa de ni rmongs pa ste/ de ltar yul drug la chags sdang rmongs gsum/ gsum gsum bco brgyad po de dag la yid kyi nye bar spyod pa bco brgyad ces bya ste/ chags sdang rmongs gsum po de ni nyon mongs pa/ des kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi byed tshad ni las/ las de'i 'bras bu de ni 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ste/ 'di gsum 'ba' zhig tu 'khor bar bzhed do// de ltar gyur na/ thos pa che zhing mkhas pa dang*// bsam pas don rnams rtogs pa dang*// chos byed dam par grags pa dang*// rgyu tshod bzang po'i sgom chen rnams// dbang po drug gi yul rnams la// chags sdang rmongs gsum skye mi skye// nyon mongs gsum po mi skye na// yongs su grags pa shin tu mad// bdag kyang rjes su yi rangs 'bul// brgya la gal te skye na ko /rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis// rang gzhan thams cad mi phung ngam// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal rnams// bdag gis bzod par cang nus sam// rang gis byas pa'i las ngan rnams// gzhan la smin pa mi srid pas// 'di las thar pa'i thabs rnams soms//

༈ //de ltar ma rig pa bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam pa 'di las yul drug mthong ba las nyon mongs pa gsum skyes/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las rnam par smin pa 'di la 'khor ba zer ba yin pas/ bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o// 'di las ji ltar bzlog na/ bzlog pa'i rgyu 'gro ba dang*/ dngos su bzlog pa dang gnyis/ bzlog pa'i rgyur 'gro ba ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba nas bzung ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lngas bzlog pa'i rgyu yin/ sher rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas dngos su bzlog pa yin/ shes rab de gang yin na/ sgom pa'i shes rab de gang las skye zhe na/ zhi gnas las skye/ tshul lugs ji ltar skye na/ slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal nas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas la// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces pa'i don gong du ji ltar smos pa bzhin du/ dbang po drug yul drug la chags sdang rmongs gsum skye ba de/ 'khor ba'i babs su song bas mi skye ni kha med/ skye na ni sdug bsngal min pa bde ba skad cig kyang mi srid pas/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten du byon nas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar bar byed pa yin/ rgyu mtshan des na bstan pa mtha' dag gi brjod bya zhi gnas lhag mthong rnam pa gnyis/ de'i grogs sam skyed byed kyi rgyu tshul khrims gsum la bslab pa gsum zer ba yin/ gnad ka dang rgyu mtshan des na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig tu nges pa yin/ bstan pa'i rim pa lag len du 'debs pa bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa zer ba yin/ ci rigs pa rgyud la skyes pa la rnal 'byor pa zer ba yin/ bstan pa'i rang thog tu phyin pa la sangs rgyas zer ba yin/

bu tshul khrims rin po che nyes byas shin tu phra ba'i phra ba gcig kyang*/ rang gi srog dang brje phod par bya/ gzhan lta ci smos kyang ci dgos/ dper na rnal 'byor pa gcig la slob ma gnyis kyis tshod ma lhan cig btus nas/ gcig gis lag tu phul nas grogs kyi ming ma smos/ phyis rnal 'byor pa de na re/ khyod kyis nyes pa chen po byas zer nas 'bar sha byed/ khyod la nga dang dam pa rnams kyis glo mi gtod/ grogs po gong 'og thams cad kyis kyang nged kyi rdzas dang yo byad kho rang gi bdag gir byed par 'dug snyam nas/ tshod ma changs shig gi yang glo gtad byed mi nus/ 'di byi po chen po yin snyam nas/ rang la yon tan dang chos ci yod kyang*/ mi 'og tu sre/ sdug gis 'gro ba yin zer/ mad par 'dug nyams su myong bas grub pa yin/ dbang po drug gi yul du gyur tshad 'dod pa'i yon tan 'di spang bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so// spong ba 'di kho na 'khor 'das kyi yon tan mtha' dag bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba yin/ ma spangs shing 'dod yon bsten pa las/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag byung ba yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phags pa sdud pa nas kyang*/ sems dmyal dud 'gro gshin rje'i 'jig rten sdug bsngal mang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan rgyu yis dbang med gnod myong na// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang 'dod yon spong ba 'di bstan pa rang gi ngo bo'am bstan pa bsrung bar yang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po nas/ gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro// reg bya spong ba de ni bstan pa srung*// zhes pa dang*/ lus dang srog la chags pa rnams kyi ni brtul zhugs 'grub bo// zhes sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gsungs so// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'dod pa la bsten pa rnams kyis ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba la yang bar du gcod na/ byang chub lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes pa dang*/

chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste// thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed// ces pa la sogs pa sde snod gsum gyis theg pa gsum la dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa mtha' dag dbang po drug /yul drug la 'dod chags la chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang la chags pa dang*/ gti mug la chags pa 'di bkag cing gnang ba'i skabs gtan mi srid pa dang*/ bu nga 'bu la ni chags sdang rmongs gsum mi skye ba ma byung na/ bu khyod ci 'dra/ rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di kho na nges pas na mi skyer ni mi btub/ skye ni skye bar 'dug pas 'gog dgos/ 'dod yon ji tsam du thag bsrings pa tsam du 'khor ba thag bsrings pa yin/ spangs pa tsam du 'khor ba spangs pa yin pas/ bu nged rang pha spad sngon rab tu byung ba'i dus su dkon mchog gsum dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mdun du shākya'i rgyal po'i rjes su ni slob/ rten sa 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa zas bsod snyoms/ gos phyag dar khrod/ sman bkus te bor ba/ gnas mal shing drung dang bzhi po 'di la dam bcas pa yin pas/ dam bca' brtan po bya dgos/ pho 'bring po gcig kyang yi dwags dpang por btsugs pa'i mna' skyel ba la yang 'dzem na/ pho rab don po gcig dkon mchog dpang por btsugs pa'i mna' za ba dpe yod dam/ ga la gcig pho tshig chad na chad pa yin/ sga rgyun chad na 'jig pa yin/ srog dang bsdos nas khas blangs pa/ dam bcas pa nyams 'og tu chud par byas nas/ mig gis gzugs ye mi blta/ chags sdang rmongs gsum skye bar 'dug /yid kyis chos bsam mno dang gzhig long bya ba dang*/ brtag dpyad la sogs pa'i bar du yul drug la ye mi bya/ byas na chags sdang rmongs gsum skye bar 'dug pas/ ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du 'dod yon la bros par bya/ spang bar bya/ skyon du bya/ de ltar byas pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu po 'di la/
