dge slong nyid dang a cang yang ches te/ rten dge tshul du yod kyang*/ 'di mtha' dag gi nyams len/ nad pas sman pa mthong ba'am/ bsags pa can dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba bzhin du/ dga' bas nyams su len pa nyams su blangs pas/ skyo ba med pa bslab pa mtha' dag la skom pa chus gdungs pa lta bus/ nyams su len pa la skyo dub mi 'ong ste/ 'dod yon 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag pa'i phyir ro// de ltar 'dod yon nam/ yul drug po 'di la chags sdang rmongs gsum skye ba de/ 'khor ba sngar 'dris goms btsan pas tshul khrims 'di gcig pus kyang mtha' dag spang dka' bar byung*/ 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs chen po ni shes nas shes pa sdug skam gyis song*/ ci bya thabs brlag pa zhig 'ong*/ 'di'i dus su bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin zhi gnas sems rtse gcig pa la rtse gcig tu bzhag pas/ dbang po drug yul drug la chags sdang rmongs gsum rgyun chad nas/ sems rtse gcig tu ji tsam gnas kyi bar du nyon mongs dang rnam rtog zhi nus/ 'di'i dus su sngon tshul khrims rkyang pas kyang nyon mongs pa gsum po spang dka' bar byung*/ da 'dir ting nge 'dzin dang gnyid log pas legs par 'ong 'ong 'dra/ 'bung dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa skye/ dper na 'jigs sa chen por phyin pa'i mgron po skyel ma zhig rnyed pa la/ skyel ma de yul du phyir 'bros pa'i zon dgos pa dang 'dra bar/ sems rtse gcig pa la bag tsam mig phye btsums tsam mam/ zan kham cig tsam za ba'i bar tsam mam/ ja sun cig 'thung ba'i bar tsam du thams cad la ting nge 'dzin 'di tsam re yod pa yin pas de skyong ba yin/ hab shi hub shi thag ring po ga shed cig nas sus kyang blang sa mi rnyed/ sngon ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di khab na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ zhing pa'i grong ltar gshegs pa'i tshe na zhing pa dang glang sdug bsngal gyi gzir ba ni mthong*/ rgas pa dang na ba dang 'chi ba mthong nas 'dod pa la skyo ba skyes/

rab tu byung ba la thar pa'i sems bzhag pas/ shing 'dzam bu'i drung du skyil mo krung legs par bcas/ sku drang por bsrang ste bzhugs pas/ bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin yud tsam zhig 'khrungs pa lags par gda'/ phyis rab tu gshegs nas bsam gtan nam mkha' khyab pa la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa la lo drug gi bar du mnyam par bzhag kyang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes lta a cang yang che ste/ yon tan gang yang ma skyes nas ting nge 'dzin des sangs mi rgya/ yon tan mi skye bar go /'o na gang gis skye snyam du bsams pas/ sngon shing 'dzam bu'i drung gi bsam gtan des 'tshang rgya bar dgongs nas/ byang chub kyi shing drung du de rgyun bsrings pas/ sangs rgyas pa yin zhes gsungs pas/ de rang la yod pa dang byung ba'i sgom de skyong ma shes nas/ gzhan du btsal na shin tu dka' ba yin pas/ rang la skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin bag tsam de bskyang*/ de la gsum/ sngon gyi 'dod pa rnams spangs pa dang*/ chags sdang rmongs gsum las dang bcas pa'i bsam pa tshul khrims rin po che dang bcas pas/ thag bcad rgyang bsrings pa 'di la 'dod pa rnams kyis dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa zhes zer ba de ltar nyams su blangs pa dang gcig dbang po lnga yul lnga'i rjes su ma 'brangs par dbang pos dbang po sdom/ yul gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par nan tan chen po byed pa dang gnyis/ sngar nyams su myong ba'i sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin de skyong ba dang rnam pa gsum nyams su blangs pas/ sngar gyi dbang po drug gi 'dod pa dang chags sdang rmongs gsum las dben pa/ de las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin dben pa las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin de yun ring du bskyang ste/ yun ring ba'i thabs rtog dpyod rnam pa gnyis kyis grogs byed de/ rtog pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin 'di la 'di ltar byas na gnod par 'dug ji ltar byas na bar du gcod/

sgom mi skye ba'i bar du gcod pa la rtog pa'i phyir na rtog pa dang bcas pa'o// dpyod pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin de yun ring du skye ba'i thabs la dpyod pa ste/ mthun pa'i rkyen mtha' dag bsgrubs pas na dpyod pa dang bcas pa'o// de ltar yun ring du nyams su blangs pas 'dod pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos las dben pa la dga' zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin yun ring du skye bas bde/ kha na ma tho ba med pa dang bcas pas/ 'di la 'dod pa rnams kyis dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po zhes bya'o// 'phags pa'i tshul khrims dang dbang po sdom pa dang ting nge 'dzin gong ma ltar nyams su blangs pas nang yongs su dwangs ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa'o// de yun ring du goms pas dga' ba la 'dod chags dang bral nas/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de la bde ba la rnam par dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba med pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa'o// bsam gtan de'i bde ba yang spangs/ snga nas sdug bsngal yang spangs nas/ dga' ba dang bde dang sdug bsngal ba thams cad kyang spangs pa/ btang snyoms yongs su dag pa'i dran pa dag pa/ 'od gsal ba/ byang ba/ las su rung ba/ drang por gyur pa/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ sgrib pa lnga po gong du nas ci rigs par spangs kyang*/ 'dir rnam par spangs pas/ dper na/ 'dag chal shin tu bzang pos/ ras bzang po dri ma med par shin tu legs par bkrus nas bskams pa tshos kyi bye brag gang du btsos kyang*/ len pa la tshegs med pa lta bu ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'o// ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas nas mu stegs byed kyi drang srong rnams kyis mngon par shes pa lnga bsgrub/

nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mngon par shes pa drug bsgrubs nas 'phags pa'i sa la gnas/ sangs rgyas kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag nas/ sangs rgyas pa dang*/ chos dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa mdzad nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa'o// des na bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin 'di shin tu gal che bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phags pa sdud pa nas/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par bsgrub// ces gsungs pas/ bsam gtan 'di shin tu gal che/ 'o na 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'am/ gsang sngags pa'am/ rgyud tshod mthon po zhig gi lag rjes yin/ rtogs pa mchog dang ldan pa rnams la 'di lta bu mi dgos/ khams gsum gyi bsam gtan 'khor ba bsgrub pa'i rgyu yin/ chu phar kar phyin nas zam pa 'khur nas 'gro dgos pa min/ mya ngan las 'das zin nas 'khor ba 'khur 'gro dgos pa med snyam na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa rgyud tshod mthon po nyid kyis 'di shin tu dgos pa yin soms dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyis tshogs gsog /bsod nams kyi tshogs pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa lnga/ ye shes kyi tshogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du so sor ma 'dres par bsags nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'bras bu ma 'dres par 'byung ba ma lags sam/ yang byang chub sems dpa' snyoms par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par mi 'jog pa dang*/ gsang sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par du ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin med pa nged kyis ma thos pa dang*/ ma shes pa dang*/ shes bya la mi srid snyam na/ 'o na 'jig rten pa dang khyad par ci yod snyam na/ khyad shin tu che ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis/

ting nge 'dzin 'di la zag pa zad pa'i gzhi rten du byas nas zag pa 'dzad/ zag pa zad pa'i las thob nas sa de la gzhi rten du byas/ ting nge 'dzin zag pa dang bcas pas bsdus pa rnams gnas 'gyur/ sems la dbang thob pas ting nge 'dzin de rnams kyis de'i dgos pa mtha' dag bsgrubs nas/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dgos pa yod/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud tshod mthon po yin kyang ting nge 'dzin de rnams don dam pa'i bden pas dbang byas pas/ zhi zhing ma skyes pa 'ba' zhig yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang byas pas 'khor ba 'ba' zhig gnyis su med par rtogs pas srid pa dang zhi bar ro mnyam pa kun rdzob mtha' dag dang*/ don dam pa mtha' dag mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen por 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ gsang sngags pa yin na de'i khyad par gyi chos/ rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags kyi dbang thob nas snang ba thams cad rdo rje'i sku/ grags pa thams cad rdo rje'i gsung*/ rig pa thams cad rdo rje'i thugs/ thams cad 'bras bu rdo rje sha stag /mgon po dpal ldan til+li pa'i zhal snga nas/ rgyu yi dus su 'bras bu nyid// gsungs pa ltar snang srid 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad la spang bya dang*/ gnyen po'am rang ngam gzhan nam/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'am/ chos can nam/ chos nyid med pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen por 'gyur pa'i dgos pa yod/ de rnams thams cad kyang mdor bsdus na/ thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba nyi ma 'jig rten du shar bas/ spang bya gti mug gi mun pa sel ba yin/ gti mug gi gnyen po rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rnam pa bcu gnyis yin/ de lugs su 'byung ba'i dbang du byas na/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad ma rig bag chags kyi sa la gnas pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad/ skye na skye tshad/ srid na srid tshad/ 'khor na 'khor tshad/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bus bsdus pa/

zhing dang bsam pa dngos pos bsdus pa/ bde ba dang skyid pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis bsdus pa/ sdug bsngal dang bsod nams kyi tshogs ma yin pas bsdus pa/ sna tshogs khra bo snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ ji snyed pa mkhyen cing gsungs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs las 'byung ba'o// lugs las ldog pa'i dbang du byas pas 'di 'gag pa/ ma rig pa mi shes pa 'gag pas srid pa mtha' dag 'gag pa/ ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med pa nas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad gzhi skye med/ lam skye med/ 'bras bu skye med/ thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis mkhyen cing*/ thugs su chud nas gsungs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag ni/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lugs las ldog par gsungs so// gsung rab de thams cad kyi brjod bya nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rnam pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin/ skyed byed kyi rgyu'am grogs tshul khrims dang bcas pa/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum/ thun gcig gi nang du nyams su blang pa'i rim pa/ sde snod mtha' dag gi bcud bsdus pa 'di/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu gnas skabs thams cad du nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la mkho bar gnas pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo'i tshul lugs/ cung zad cig yi ger bkod pa 'dis 'gro ba rnams la phan par gyur cig /thos dang bsam dang sgom pa'i shes rab kyis// rang rgyud sbyangs shing mkhas pa min pa'i blos// kun la phan zhing tshim pa dam pa'i chos// rin chen lta bus smin par mi nus kyang*// rgyal srid lta bu'i sbyor ba rab spangs shing*// 'khor ba'i chos la 'dam las ut+pal bzhin// bsod nams nyer bsags dad pa'i shugs bskyed nas// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gtugs gyur cing*// dka' ba drag pos bran ltar bla ma bsten// 'chi med bdud rtsis lus sems tshim gyur pa// seṅge lta bu'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// gsol ba btab nas zur tsam bris pa 'dis// mkhas pa rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// phan du re bas bris pa bzod par gsol// dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen bsags pa 'dis// thub pa rnams kyi bstan pa rgyas par shog
/yon tan rin po che dpag tu med pa skyed par byed pa'i gdams ngag /bsil byed tsan dan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

10) ༄// ri khrod pa rnams la gdams pa nam mkha' lding zhes bya ba// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas// chos dang smon lam 'brel pa yis// theg pa chen po'i rigs su skyes// thos dang bsam pas rgyud sbyangs shing*// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// bla ma dam pa mnyes par mdzad// nā ro chen po'i gdung brgyud 'dzin// lus dang srog la ma ltos par// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// rdzogs par mdzad pa'i snying stobs can// bla ma'i thugs dgongs bdud rtsi'i bcud// lhan skyes dri ma med pa'i chus// sems kyi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// gnyis med ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa'i// yon tan rin chen sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan smin par mdzad pa khyed// gong ma rnams kyis rjes snyegs te// dben zhing nyams dga' ri bo'i khrod// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa phyogs su// dri med tshul khrims spos ngad kyis// phyogs rnams kun tu khyab mdzad cing*// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// bslab gsum ma gi'i sbyor ba yis// nyon mongs dug rnams 'joms byed cing*// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas bsgrub pa de// bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pas// dpal rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas// bla ma rin chen yan chad kyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa yin// gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /sgrub pa 'phel ba'i dus tshod du// zhen pa'i mos gus tsab tsub kyis// lus sems g.yeng bar ma mdzad par// lhun grub mos gus ri bo ltar// g.yo 'gul med par brtan par bzhugs// yang cig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// shin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su// gsang sngags gdams ngag zab mo la// sgrub pa tshul bzhin byas gyur nas// nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba'i tshe// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin dran/

dam pa'i chos la nges shes skyes// chos lkog tu ma lus sems su go /tshig tha snyad 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa la// nyam nga mi skye seng ge bzhin// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ltar// dgos 'dod rang las 'byung bar go /dus dang gnas skabs de tsam na// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin dran// mos gus rgya mtsho gting nas g.yo// gdung ba'i sems la tshugs thabs med// mchi ma chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'brub// sems dran pa myos te smyon par thal// tshugs pa med par mjal snying 'dod// drin can rje dang ma bral na// dmyal bar song yang 'gyod pa med// snyam pa'i bsam pa yang yang skye// bu dus dang gnas skabs de tsam na// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon po des// skal ldan slob ma sum brgya la// dus gcig gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig /rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma rnams// dbang du sdud pa'i gdams ngag mdzod// thogs med sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul gyis// skad cig de la byon gyur nas// dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas kyang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// gang 'dod sbyin par the tshom med// bu snying gtam yin cig sems la zhog /brgya la khe grags ri khrod pa// chos brgyad bsgom pa'i sgom chen des// nyon mongs spyod pa'i gol sa bsnyags// rten 'brel che ba mi bslu zhing*// chos kun mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir// nyams rtogs mi skye a cang ste// 'khor ba'i bde skyid bag tsam yang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'byung bas// sdug cing phongs par gyur pa nas// rang blo tshul 'gro rnams la zhugs// chos dang mi mthun mtha' dag dran// ngas bla ma 'di yis dang po nas// kha tshis so tshis mang po byas// sdug bsngal dka' las thams cad kyis// kho yi chos brgyad byung ba dang*// rnyed pa bkur stis phyug pa'i tshe// nga mi med gnam snang 'di 'dra bar// mun pa'i mda' bzhin spyugs nas btang*// wa la za ma snying re na// 'brel gtogs med pa'i mi rnams kyang*// khur cig pang gang 'khyer ba la// da lta drung du cis mi 'gro// snyam pa'i bsam pa 'byung ba rnams// 'dir tshur bla ma'i drung du byon// gzhu stod dpal gyi 'bri gung du// mi yon bdag drug tsha dad pa che// rje bla ma'i bsnyen bkur bsam mi khyab// phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun zhabs tog che// mi chos dang lha dam de na 'dzom// phu 'brog dang mda' zhing gnyis ka yod// thabs shes rab gnyis kyi btsal khungs yod// shar ban dhe rgyun ma'i 'grims sa yin// ja dar gnyis kyi longs spyod yod// khra khre'u par pur bya sa yin// chu khrus dang snum phyis de na mdzod// rwa kha bal snying bla ma yis// ji ltar byas kyang thugs la 'dogs// nyi ma zla ba sgron ma dang*// seng ge glang chen dbang ldan dang*// mi yi seng ges gang gsungs pa'i// yon tan drug ldan 'ong bar rigs// kwa ri khrod rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// 'di na khyod kyi bla ma la// pha yul skyid pa'i mkhar khang med// rmo rko mkhar lan mi 'tshal bas// 'di na bya rgyu ma mchis lags// yang 'di na khyod kyi bla ma yis// rdzas dang yo byad ma bsags pas// bu lon kha skyed bya rgyu med// bu ri khrod dgon par rang sems sgoms// yang 'di na khyed kyi bla ma la// tsha bo bsad pa'i mi sha med// khrag 'khrug dmag mu mi 'tshal bas// bu ri khrod dgon par rang sems sgoms// yang zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog bya snyam yang*// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu slob rnams// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog la// phyogs bcu ri khrod dgon par gshegs// zhabs tog bzhed na ri khrod bsten// bla ma dam pa mnyes nas mchi// 'di na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun yang*// gong ma rnams kyi rjes bsnyegs te// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog tu// thams cad ri khrod bsnyag tshis byed// yang 'di na khyed kyi rje btsun pa// bu dang nor gyis brgyags pa yi// che ba'i nga rgyal 'di tsam gyis// nga yi don chen ma grub ces// mtho dman zang zing btang nas kyang*// thub pa chen po'i rjes 'brangs te// drang srong chen po brtul zhugs kyis// kun la rab tu mi mkho ba// phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing*// slong por lhung bzed snom nas ni// bsod snyoms zas la longs spyod cing*// nags khrod ri khrod dgon gnas su// sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang du len// 'jig rten spros pa rab bcad cing*// gcig pur dge sbyor snying por byed// rang la brtse ba'i bu slob dang*// ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// mtha' yas sems can thams cad kun// bcud pa gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyis// sku gsung thugs kyi zhabs drung du// skad cig gcig gis phyin pa yi// brtul zhugs drag pos sbyor ba rtsom// gnas 'dir bzhugs nges pa ma mchis na// 'dir snyags snyam na smyon pa yin// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu slob rnams// gces par byas pa'i dge 'dun tsho// zhabs tog can gyi ri khrod pa// rang dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa// bla ma'i zhabs tog bzhed lags na// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral ba'i// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// bla ma'i mos gus ma shes na// dang por bla ma shes par bya// bar du mos gus shes par bya// tha mar dngos grub shes par bya// dang po bla ma sangs rgyas ni// sku gsum dag gis bsdus pa yin// chos sku bla ma rang sems ni// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yin// 'khor 'das kun la khyab pa po// dngos med dngos dang bral ba dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhu// thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs sku ni// zung du 'jug cing ngos bzung med// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi sku// 'og min gnas mchog dam pa na// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar ba// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa yin// bu byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhu// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku tshogs ni// dbyer med thugs las byung ba yi// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa de// thub pa chen po'i sprul sku yin// bu sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid ni// khyod kyis de ltar shes par bya// de yi mos gus bya thabs ni// chos rje 'jig rten mgon po yis// sangs rgyas yon tan skye ba'i thabs// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag

/bzhi stong bsdus pa'i snying po mchog /rtag tu snyan tu gsol ba yi// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig mchog /sdom pa gsum dang ldan par bya// sdom pa gsum dang ma ldan na// ji ltar skyes bu'i rtsol ba yis// 'bad pas chu rnams bsrubs pa las// mar gyi snying po mi byung ltar// sdom pa gsum dang ma ldan na// bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu 'byung re skan// sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yis// shin tu dben pa'i ri khrod du// sangs rgyas gsum gyi zhabs drung du// rgyun chad med pa'i mos gus kyis// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// thabs dang shes rab bogs 'don ni// gcig gis gcig la yin zhes gsung*// res 'ga' chos sku'i bla ma bsgom// res 'ga' zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs// gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang*// 'du byed rnam shes phung po lngar// gnyis su med par longs spyod kyang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis rdzogs nas mchi// res 'ga' sprul sku'i bla ma bsten// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa yis// ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs tshul du// bya ba byed pa sna tshogs bya// res 'ga' ri bo'i rtse la bsgom// res 'ga' rgya mtsho'i gting tu bsgom// res 'ga' chu bo'i gzhung du ste// res 'ga' gangs dkar rtse la bsgom// res 'ga' g.ya' dang gangs kyi mtshams// res 'ga' phyogs med ldom bu bya// res 'ga' sprang po'i nang du sdod// res 'ga' rgya gad tshig rtsub chu bzhin btung*// res 'ga' 'tshol gsog rtsol sgrub bya// res 'ga' rgyal po'i tshul lugs kyis// seng ge'i khri la 'dug nas kyang*// mang po'i tshogs la dam chos bshad// res 'ga' 'jigs byed he ru kaḥ /hūm̐ phaṭa pheṃ pheṃ sgra sgrogs pas// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor skrag par bya// res 'ga' 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// gdul bya mang po smin par bya// res 'ga' rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// jo bo thugs rje chen po yis// nyam thag sdug bsngal can rnams skyob// res 'ga' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yis// 'khor 'das kun tu ltad mo blta// res 'ga' khros pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa lis// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas// bde chen bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod// res 'ga' drang srong spyod pa yis// nyal nyil gyon cing dka' thub spyad// mdor na lus ngag bya ba rnams// rnam pa sna tshogs gang spyad kyang*// chos kyi sku las mi g.yo ba// e ma sangs rgyas sprul sku 'dis// rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang*// grol zhing bde ba la bkod cing*// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'joms dang*// mdzad pa bcu gnyis mthar phyungs nas// mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings nyid du// nye bar zhi zhing ro gcig pa// thub pa rnams kyi sprul sku ste// bu sprul pa'i sku yi bla ma dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhu// dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshul lugs 'di// bla ma shes pa'i tshul lugs bzhin// chos sku longs sku sprul sku yis// dngos grub yon tan ma lus pa// mdo las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin// rang gis thob pa ngo mtshar che// sems kyi gdung ba gcod pa'i yi ge mos gus bya ba'i tshul lugs rgya cher bstan pa/

ri khrod pa rnams kyi gdams ngag nam mkha' lding zhes bya ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 11) ༄// rgyal sras rnams kyi lam rim rin po che 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras rtog pa sna tshogs rnams// gnyis med bde ba chen por bsgyur mdzad pa// rang byung byang chub sems kyi bla mar 'dud// spros dang bral ba rang gi sems// 'khor 'das kun gyi rang bzhin ni// dus gsum kun tu khyab pa ste// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa 'o// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// rgal bar 'dod pa'i skyes bu rnams// thar pa'i grong khyer chen po de// rang gi gnas lugs yin pas na// gzhan las rnyed par 'gyur mi srid// rang gi de nyid rtogs par bya// de la rnam pa gsum yin te// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'o// rgyu yi rnam par bzhag pa ni// rang gi sems kyi 'dug lugs la// jo bo byams pa'i zhal snga nas// gnas pa'i khams su bzhag pa dang*// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gsung*// sad pa'i rkyen ni bsam mi khyab// dpag tu med pa gsungs pa rnams// dpon slob rten 'brel 'grig lugs yin// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag ni// bsod nams tshogs las che ba med// de la rnam pa gsum yin te// mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa la// spros dang bral ba'i 'du shes kyis// rtogs par 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// bdag sogs dngos po btang byas nas// rgyu 'bras slu ba med pas na// rang sems rtogs par bla mas gsungs// lar mos gus kyi bsam pa drag po yis// rtogs par 'dod pa'i blo med na// bskal pa bye ba mang por yang*// rdzas dang longs spyod lus srog rnams// rgyun chad med par gtang na yang*// rtogs par mi 'gyur rgyu 'bras pas// rtag tu ngu yi dad pa ltar// mos gus drag pos 'bad pa las// ma dpyad pa yi sa phyogs nas// ci zhig ltar na rang sems rtogs// spros med phyag rgya chen po la// mtho dman phyogs ris med na yang*// gang zag bsags pa che chung las// sgom pa mtho dman sna tshogs su// rtogs pa mtho dman khyad par la// sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams// gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa lags// rtogs rgyu rnam par bzhag pa yi// 'dug lugs zur tsam brjod pa yin// rtogs pa'i ngo bo skyong tsa na// gdams ngag gi rgyal po tshe 'di gtang*// tshe 'di gtong ba'i gtong lugs la// grub thob mkhas pa gong ma rnams// blo yi rim pa shes pa yis// la la ri khrod dgon pa snyag

/la la tshong 'dus dbus su 'dug /la la tshogs pa'i nang du gnas// la la dman pa sprang po byed// byed lugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// spros pa'i mtshan ma spong bar byed// brgya la gal te rnal 'byor pas// gong ma'i mdzad spyod so so yis// spros pa gcod pa ma shes pas// ci yin cha med spyod pa yis// rtags tsam 'dzin pa bdud du bas// spros med lhan cig skyes pa yi// grogs su 'gro na spyod pa yin// gnas dang grogs dang spyod lam rnams// rang gi sgom dang gang mthun bsten// nyams len gyi rnam bzhag 'di ltar bya// nang par snga thun dang po la// byams dang snying rjes rgyud brlan nas// yi dam lha dang bla ma sgom// de nas ngang la btang bar bya// res 'ga' bsngo ba rgya chen bya// lar dad dang brtson 'grus rtsab rtsub kyi// bya byed spros pa sna tshogs kyis// rang gis rang nyid g.yeng ba de// sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod pas// re dogs kyi mtha' la 'chel

bsten pa ba yin// dngos 'dzin gyi gdos su chud pa yin// bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pas na// 'gro ba'i mgon po a ti shas// gal te mnyam bzhag sems brtan na// lus ngag dge ba gtsor mi bya// gnad la dbab pa'i gdams ngag gsungs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// rang sems rtogs pas sangs rgyas par// zab mo'i mdo rgyud rnams su gsungs// sangs rgyas mgo skor mi mdzad ces// kha la rtag tu smra ba dang*// bsam pa 'dzol bar ma song ngam// de la nges shes skyes pa na// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// mi bzad sgrib pa'i gnyen po yang*// rang sems skye med rdo rje las// dus gsum rgyal bas ma rnyed pa// mkhas su re ba'i blun pos kyang*// rnyed dam snyam pa de la med// des na na tsha bde sdug dang*// skyon yon rnam pa sna tshogs la// chags sdang bze re ma che bar// sems nyid rtogs na ngang du grol// kye rang sems rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// bde sdug mang po byung tsam na// zhim bu rab khar phyin pa bzhin// gdams ngag man chung mang po dang*// mo bon gto chog gang drags shig /ha cang re sa mang lags na// gnyis gzhon bar du ltung nyen gda'o// blo bcad drag po'i bsam pa yis// lus srog gdon ltor btang nas kyang*// lus srog khyod rang ci 'dod 'dra// rang sems sgom dang mi 'bral ba'i// blo bcad byas nas sems bsgom na// bskal pa mang po'i 'khor ba yang*// yud tsam zhig la bzlums nas 'gro// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam de// rgyun chad med pa'i dran pas gzung*// brtson 'grus drag po'i go ba de// dran pa rgyun chad med pa yin// go ba 'dzol na phung bar mchi// 'ub kyis hril gyis dril lags na// rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa yis// yengs pa med par sems bsgom na// chu rnams rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtshan ma rnams// sems nyid kyi ngang du dengs tsam na// rnal 'byor pa la sgom rgyu med// lar sgom rgyu med pa'i rtogs pa de// gnas skabs mang por 'ong na yang*// nyams dang bral ba'i sgom med la// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po ches// spros dang bral zhes gsung ba yin// rang dang snang ba'i dngos po rnams// sems nyid kyi ngo bor song nas 'dug

/spyod lam dus skabs thams cad du// mnyam rjes khyad par med snyam pa'i// nyams dang rtogs pa brtan gyur nas// dge sdig kun gyis mi gnod cing*// 'bras bu mthar thug thob pa yi// nga rgyal bsnyems pa mang po 'byung*// lung dang man ngag mtha' dag gis// mthar thug 'bras bu mtshon du med// ji ltar byas kyang btub nas mchi// snyam pa'i bsam pa ngang gis 'byung*// chags zhen ngang gis chung ba dang*// yon tan mang po 'byung bar 'gyur// don zin sa slebs pa'i rnal 'byor yin// dus dang gnas skabs de tsam na// mnyam nyid kyis ngang la 'gro na yang*// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// chos rnams kun la mig med pas// rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa dang*// tshul khrims lhod par 'gro dogs yod// gnyis snang med pa khas len yang*// snang sems zung du ma chud pas// lhan cig skyes pa'i bag chags kyis// rtsa yi mdud pa ma khrol bar// rgyal ba'i zhing khams ga la 'byongs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mi 'dod cing*// stong nyid ro la sred pas na// sems can smin par ga la nus// byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu rnams// ma lus smin nas mi 'dug pas// mthar thug gi sangs rgyas ga la yin// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par// rgyu yi dam bca' ga la rdzogs// ༈ // kwa/ sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// gnas skabs kyi ngal stegs bde mo de// rtag tu sdod pa'i khang bzang min// don dam blo yi spyod yul min// skye med phyag rgya chen po de// 'dzin pas bsgom pa su yang med// de tshod tsam gyis mgu ba na// rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas ma bslus sam// 'gro don shugs las 'byung zhe na// rgyu med kyi 'bras bu gang nas 'ong*// sngon du bsags pas chog zhe na// tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i phyir// don dam sngon nas rtogs par thal// rtogs tsam 'bras bur 'dod gyur na// sgom lam sa bcus dgos pa med// sa lam mi 'dod zer ba na// mthong ba lam gyi khas len ci// min yang ku re bgyis pa lags// ngo bo mthong ba'i rnal 'byor rnams// go cha gsum po bgos nas kyang*// bla ma rin chen spyi bos bkur// shin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su// bde chen rdo rje'i sems bsgom na// bar dor 'ong ba'i chos sku de// lus 'di 'jog kyang mi dgos par// snang sems gnyis su med par go

/gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis su med// 'khor 'das gnyis kyang dbyer mi phyed// ma lus sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'di// 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*// 'jig rten ston pa sgrub bya nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// nga dang gzhan dang don dam dang*// kun rdzob sus kyang mthong ba med// dpa' bo gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yis// khams gsum yang dag 'das la rnam par grol ba'ang min// nyon mongs bsal bar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed// rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston// dus 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po de// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun// skad cig gcig la sems kyi ngo bor byed/ rdul gcig steng du dus gsum ma lus sgrub// sems can kun gyi khams rgyud du ma rnams// so sor mkhyen cing gnyis su med par go /bskal pa grangs med bye ba mang po yang*// blo yi skad cig nyid la sgrub byed pas// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// las dang nyon mongs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// ma lus dag par byed pa'i sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rgyu 'bras rnams// bskal pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab par// dpa' bo chen po rnams kyis bsgrub par byed// bsam gyis mi khyab rnam par thar pa 'di// sangs rgyas phal chen la sogs theg chen mdor// thub pa'i dbang pos shin tu rgyas par phye// ya mtshan rmad du gyur pa'i chos 'di la// rgyal sras rnams kyis brod dga' ba pa cis mi skye// 'di theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor la// rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad kun// gdod nas lhun gyis grub par bzhed// don spyi bo gtsug nas rkang mthil bar// rtsa dang rtsa yi gnas lugs rnams// 'khor lo rnams dang gtso bo dang*// rtsa phran bsam gyis mi khyab pa// mdud pa'i rnam pa du ma rnams// 'khor ba'i bag chags bskyed pa'i rgyu// sa bon yi ge'i tshul du gnas// gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pas// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du ma dang*// sangs rgyas zhing khams rnams su 'gyur// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas// nang gi zhing khams ma mthong bar// phyi yi mthong bar mi bzhed de// pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa rnams// thub pa chen po chos kyi rjes// phyi yi rten cing 'brel pa de// nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bur gsungs// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur gsungs// nyi ma phyogs na med pa yis// 'od zer gang nas rnyed par 'gyur// nang gi zhing khams ma mthong na// phyi yi zhing khams ji ltar sbyong*// snying khams bskyed nas grangs med gsum// rtag pa'i yid kyis rnam bsams nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos po can// dman pa'i yid kyis bsams pa rnams// rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// skad cig nyid la shes 'gyur te// tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pas na// de yi rjes su 'brang bar bya// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa dang*// mos gus can gyi slob ma gnyis// dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom tsam na// mos gus kyi rten 'brel zab mo yis// lam zab bla mar 'gro bas na// bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus pa// skad cig nyid la 'char bar yang*// gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// rang gi sems las mi srid pas// rang sems rtogs pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'khor 'das thams cad mngon du 'gyur// lus dang snang ba'i dngos po rnams// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par bsgyur// dus gsum rgyal bas thugs chud pa// mya ngan 'das pa bden gcig pu// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// 'bras bu'i rnam par gzhag pa ni// gzung 'dzin spangs shing gdod nas zhi// blo dang bral ba de nyid la// sa bcu'i mgon po man chad dang*// 'gro drug sems can ma lus la// rgyal ba ji ltar 'dod pa ltar// snang lugs so so'i bye brag rnams// byang chub mchog tu sems skyed pa// de yi bsam pa rin po che// sems can khams dang mnyam par gnas// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang*// sems can khams dang mnyam pas na// rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// sems can rnams dang mnyam par nges// rgyal sras rnams kyi bslab pa'i rim pa bla ma'i gsung gi rjes su 'brangs nas/

'dir phan pa'i sems kyis cung zad yi ger bkod pa 'di la nor zhing 'khrul bar gang gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la zhe 'dod med pas bzod par gsol/ dge ba cung zad bsags pa des ni 'gro ba ma lus rdo rje 'dzin par shog /rgyal sras rnams kyi lam gyi rim pa rin po che 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan rdzogs so// // 12) ༄// lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam bzhag bstan bcos blo gros rgyal mtshan// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig srid pa'i rgya mtsho mi zad brgal dka' bas// thabs dang shes rab mchog gi gru yis sgrol mdzad pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma dam pa dang*// yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por ni go tshe 'di yang mi rtag cing skad cig tsam dran du ni 'dug bde bde'o skyid skyid po ni ji ltar byas kyang mi srid/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas ni chos min pa med par go ba'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ spang bar bya ba'i chos rnam pa gsum/ nyams su blang ba'i lam rnam pa gsum/ nyams su blang ba'i 'bras bu rnam pa gsum mo// de la spang bar bya ba'i chos rnam pa gsum ni/ 'dod chags spang bar bya ba'i chos dang*/ zhe sdang spang bar bya ba'i chos dang*/ gti mug spang bar bya ba'i chos so// ma spang ba'i nyes dmigs rnam pa gsum ni/ 'dod chags ma spangs na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gang du yang bde ba dang skyid pa mi srid de/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste// thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed// ces gsung pas/ phyi yul dang nang sems can gang la chags kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi gnyen por 'gro ba ston par byed pa'i bla ma 'tshol zhing*/ de 'dra rnyed kyang phyi yul la chags na ni/ rdzas dang yo byad khe skyed dang*/ gsog brnab 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da'/

chos thos bsam bsgom gsum ye mi khom/ tha ma rang gi yul phyogs na rdzas dang*/ yo byad yul dang*/ longs spyod bran brun gyis shes pa brod nas/ sdig pa mi dge ba 'ba' zhig byed pa ma gtogs pa dge ba byed mi khom/ nang sems can la chags na/ rang gi nye du gnyen 'brel mtho dman 'bring gsum la chags nas/ chos byed pa'i bsam pa mi 'byung*/ gal te las kyi dbang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad kyang*/ rang gi yul phyogs dang gnyen 'dun phyogs ris su bcad cing*/ rang sdod pa'i grwa sa de 'jig par byed cing*/ dge 'dun mthun pa'i dbyen byed/ sde 'khrug gi gzhi 'dzugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs dkrugs/ dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu gsog tha ma rang yul du phyin yang*/ gnyen 'dun la chags shing skyong bar 'dod pas/ nye du gnyen 'brel gyi so nam 'ba' zhig byas kyang*/ las dbang che bas rang gis phan par bsam shing byas pa rnams kyis sbrul la 'o ma blud pa bzhin du gnod pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur/ rang nyid kyis ci byas tshad thams cad kyis 'khor ba dang*/ ngan song gi rgyu 'ba' zhig byas nas/ ngan song rnam pa gsum du 'gro zhing mtho ris dang*/ thar pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa ni chags pa'i nyes dmigs so// zhe sdang gi nyes dmigs ni/ rang gi bsam pa 'di shin tu gdug cing ma rungs pa'i sems skyes na/ dper na mi shin tu bu 'dod pa zhig gi chung ma sbrum pas bu skye bar re zhing dus la sdod pa la/ sbrul gdug pa mthong ba dang*/ reg pa dang*/ kha rlangs kyi dug can cig skyes na re thag chad cing yid skyo nas/ de spong ba'i thabs sna tshogs 'tshol ba bzhin du/ pha ma dang nye du gnyen 'brel du gyur pa thams cad kyang re thag chad cing yid skyo nas gsod pa dang*/ skrod pa'i thabs rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'tshol/ gang nye ba dang brtse ba thams cad dgra'i don por bzung nas thams cad du phung shom/ sdig pa'i las des skyes bu byams pa dang*/

snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems che ba gtan mi 'dod/ brgya la'am gal te de 'dra ba dang phrad kyang*/ zhe sdang 'ba' zhig gis so nam/ ngas 'di la 'di byas pa la/ 'dis nga la gnod pa 'di byas/ da lta 'di byed/ phyis kyang 'di byed nas 'ong*/ nga dang mthun pa rnams la gnod pa 'di byas/ 'di byed/ 'di byed par 'gyur ro// nga dang mi mthun pa rnams dang 'di bshes so// bshes par gyur to// bshes par 'gyur ro// snyam pa'i zhe sdang chen po mnar sems rim pa dgu skye zhing*/ su mthong ba dang phrad phrad thams cad 'thad pa gcig kyang med/ mi 'thad pa 'ba' zhig je mi 'thad je mi 'thad la ci zhig ltar la/ rdo rje slob dpon man chad gsod pa'i gshed mar song nas 'bros dgos pa yang gan na 'dug de'i gnyen po byams pa dang*/ snying rje bsgoms kyang*/ zhe sdang ni gzhi ma gnyug mar song*/ byams pa dang snying rje ni 'gron po glo bur bar thal bas/ choms par dka' zhing thag thug mang bas/ rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ yun thung bzod pa bsgoms pa ni// sdong po dba' la bskyur ba 'dra// mdor na mtho sa che na g.yang sa che zhing*/ bzang po thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa dang phrad pas/ zhe sdang gi me cher 'bar nas gnyen po gtan med du song*/ rang gi yul du phyin nas mi thams cad ā/ skyes bu dam pa byon snyam tsam na/ yul khams thams cad mi bde ba dang*/ 'khrug pa rlabs po che la sbyar nas 'ong bas/ dmyal ba gting zab pa zhig tu 'gro ba'i rgyu byed/ mtho ris dang thar pa la gtan rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i nyes dmigs yod do// mi shes shing gti mug pa'i dbang du song na/ rmongs pa de nam yang rmongs pa 'ba' zhig la dga' ba ma gtogs pa/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab can la rgyab kyis bltas shing*/ mi dga' ba 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur/ de la mi dga' ba ci yang mi shes par 'gyur/ ci mi shes zhe na/ da ltar kun rdzob kyi bya ba dang byed pa/

phan pa dang gnod pa ci yang mi shes pas/ yul bzung nyes rang gi rigs rgyud thams cad chud gson pa'i yul 'dzin/ las bya nyes tshe 'di med phyi ma med/ rang la gnod gzhan la gnod/ rang phung gzhan phung thams cad byed par 'ong*/ gtam smra nyes mi tshe thams cad du bzang byas pa/ ngan smras tshig gcig gis mgo 'chad pa'i nyes pa thob pa/ dper na/ rgyal po'i mdun du btsun mo dam pa zhig gis/ rgyal po ngan pa khyod gsod byas pas/ rang gi mgo 'chad pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang*/ nam yang don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs mi srid pa dang*/ brgya la'am gal te thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab yod pa/ lung dang rigs pa'i bdag thob pa 'ba' zhig gi drung du phyin na/ rigs pa'i chos mngon sum dang rjes dpag rnam gnyis kyis/ spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad gtan la 'bebs pa la ni ci byed/ 'di mu stegs byed dang thun mong yin zer nas rna mi gtod/ lung gi chos de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa chen po rnams kyis 'di ltar nyams su blangs pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu thob pa 'di lta bu yin byas na ni/ gna' gtam rnying pa la da dgos kyi don mi 'ong*/ rus pa btsa' can bzhib kyang lha ba mi 'byung zer nas rna ba mi gtod/ yang don dam pa'i bden pa gtan tshigs chen po bzhi'am lngas gtan la phab pa dang*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos/ sa dang lam gyis bsdus pa thams cad ni/ 'di go dka' gting ring zer nas rna ba mi gtod/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya ba yin nges byas kyang*/ sangs rgyas 'di bzang po zhig yin pas sla drags zer nas rna mi gtod/ dang por ma dad/ bar du ma bslabs/ tha mar mi shes chos spong ba'i las gsog ci zhig ltar gzhan chos kyi bla bo

gtam dang*/ gleng langs byed pa'i dus na rna ba gzer ting gis 'gro/ chos mi gleng ba'i thabs grub tshad byed/ de ma thub na ngan smras byed cing langs nas 'gro/ rjes na yod pa'i mi rnams kyis sna snyer dang*/ zhe snyer mang po byed/ a ā ci 'dra yang srid zer cing 'phya/ rang yul du 'gro ba'i dus su mi ngan pa'i gtam ngan snga bas/ sus kyang blta mi mi gcig kyang med/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan med pas dge bshes su yang ma btub/ thag ring du song ba'i gtan tshigs kyis mi skyar yang ma btub/ 'di la sa mtha' khyi rjes kyis 'gengs shing sgo gsham brdung ba min pa las med/ rang mi thog rgan pa dang*/ dge bshes bsten yun ring ba dang*/ chu rka 'gor 'thung pa yin pa la nga sus kyang mi bkur/ 'di kun bkur bar 'dug snyam zhing smra bas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu gsog mtho ris dang thar pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pas nyes dmigs gsum mo// de yis spang bar bya ba'i gnyen po rnam pa gsum ni/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por sdug pa dang 'bral ba bsgom/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ gti mug gi gnyen por rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lugs su 'byung ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pa bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bsgom pa ma yin goms pa yin// ces pas/ goms pa la dang po yod pa zhig goms par byed dgos pas/ mi sdug pa lta bu zhig la mtshon na snying du sdug pa dang*/ chags pa dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ 'chums pa ser sna de la snying du mi sdug pa dang*/ mi 'thad pa dang*/ yid du mi 'ong ba zhig rgyud la ci skye lta ba yin pas/ mchu la chags na sho re/ sna la chags na sna rdum/ mig la chags na zhar ba/ gson po la chags na ro/ de yang rnam par bam pa dang*/ rnam par dmar ba dang*/ rnam par 'bus bshig pa dang*/ rus gong la sogs pa'i bar du brtags pas/ chags zhing zhen pa log pa'i myong ba gang la skye ba blta/

myong ba gang la skyes pa de goms par byed pa la sgom zhes bya ba yin/ de bzhin du a mar goms pa la byams pa dang snying rje skye ba dang*/ rtog pa 'di yod na 'di 'byung*/ 'di 'gags na 'di 'gag pa bsam pas/ rten 'brel gyi gshis go zhing myong ba skyes pa la sgom zer ba yin/ 'di rnams kyis nyon mongs pa spong ba la myong ba bag tsam skyes nas snying rus dang brtson 'grus kyi kha na rtsen ne yod/ 'dir rang nyid ngan sar cog gis bzhag /gzhan rnams mtho sar rtsen 'phag gyis dbyung*// nyon mongs dug gsum gang skyes kyang*// de yi kha 'dzin mi bya bar// ku re kyal ka ma mchis par// snying nas dgra'i zon thag chod bya// dgra bo nyon mongs dug gsum 'di// thog med dus nas da lta bar// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa yi// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen por bskyur// tshe 'di thog mtha' bar gsum du// nyes pa ci bskyed dran par bya// da yang 'di dang ma bral na// ji ltar me dang tsha ba bzhin// nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal yang*// 'gro ldog gcig tu nges pa bsam// de ltar yang yang bsam pa dang*// snying stobs brtson 'grus chen po yis// gnyen po bsten cing goms pa yis// nyon mongs gsum po choms par 'gyur// tshe 'di mi rtag yun re thung*// bde skyid mi rtag 'jig par nges// longs spyod mi rtag 'bral bar nges// gnyen 'dun mi rtag 'bye bar nges// sha khrag brdos pa'i phung po la// nga dang bdag tu ma 'dzin par// bu gcig gnyen po goms par mdzod// spang bar bya ba bstan pa'o// ༈ //de ltar nyes pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs spang bar bya ba bstan nas/ da ni nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum bstan par bya ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ lta ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ spyod pa rnam pa gsum mo// de la lta ba ni/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/

gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba/ smra ba dang bsam pa dang shes pa dang brjod pa thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa/ 'khor 'das kyi gshis su gnas pa la lta ba zhes bya/ de rtogs dgos pas lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/ de rtogs par byed pa la gsum/ zhing mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma de lta bu rtogs pa zhig dgos te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba// yon tan lhag bcas brtson pa lung gis phyug /de nyid rtogs pa rab tu smra mkhas ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la bsten// ces pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ rkos phor la ri mo med na tsha tsha la ri mo mi 'byung*/ bla ma la yon tan med na slob ma'i rgyud smin par mi nus gsung ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab thams cad du yang bla ma'i mtshan nyid bzang po dgos pa sha stag du bstan pa yin la/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa zhig gis don dam pa'i bden pa ston nus pa 'thad cing rigs pa yin pas/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma la bsam pa rnam par dag pa dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs gcad du med pa/ dper na byang chub sems pa rtag tu ngu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang dang*/ slob dpon chen po dpal ldan nā ro pa bzhin tu sku'i rnam par thar pa ci mdzad pa srog gcod pa dang*/ ma byin pa len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rang gi srog gcod pa dang*/ spu gri'i ri la 'dzegs pa dang*/ me'i 'obs chen por mchong du 'jug pa la sogs pa rang thog tu ma rungs pa ci bsgrubs kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa sha stag tu go zhing dga' ba skye/ bla ma'i gsung mtho ba dang*/ dma' ba dang*/ rdzun dang*/ phra ma dang*/ tshig rtsub dang*/ ngag 'khyal dang*/ 'thad pa dang*/ mi 'thad pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa ji ltar gsung yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thog mar dang bar du tha mar dge bar go ba/

sngon byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi zhal mthong zhing gsung thos pa dang*/ chos thams cad 'gro 'ong med par nye bar zhi bar rtogs shing khong du chud nas/ lo bdun gyi bar du gnyid dang rmugs pa med par spyod lam rnam gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar byed pa las/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags dang zhal mjal nas/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu nye bar zhi ba yin pa la/ yang ri rab sna tshogs pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs pa nyid do// de bzhin du gzugs sna tshogs pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs pa nyid do// de bzhin du phung po khams dang skye mched 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa yin pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rnam pa sna tshogs pa nye bar zhi ba'i stong pa nyid/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'di nyid yin zhes pa re mi 'thad cig gsungs pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung la gus pas ri rab sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de bzhin du chos rnams thams cad sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa dang*/ yang bla ma des mtho dman bzang ngan thams cad ci yang mi shes pa dang*/ rang dang mi mthun pa dang*/ brnab sems dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ log par lta ba can du snang zhing mthong yang sangs rgyas kyi thugs gdul bya smin par dang grol bar mdzad par go bas/ dper na slob dpon ri khrod dbang phyug rngon pa'i cha byad du byon pa la/ slob dpon chen po mnga' bdag mai tri pa lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa/ bla ma la dad gus yod pa slob dpon chen po yin kyang*/ rngon pa yin nam snyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa zhig byung bas/ tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub ma thob/ g.yog po rgyal bu sa ga ra the tshom ma skyes cing*/ bla ma yin snyam pas phung po lhag med du de nyid du song ba dang*/

bla ma gong ma phal cher de lta bu sha stag gis rnam par thar pas gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtogs pa bsdur bas thams cad la ngo mtshar can sha stag byung bas las/ byang chub sems dpa' li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pas cang ma smras pas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas de nyid rgya cher gsungs pa yin no zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin pas/ thugs kyi rnam par thar pa sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes nor 'khrul med par go ba zhig dgos/ bsam pa rnam pa dag pa de lta bu zhig yod na/ dngos po rnam par dag pa ni bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin du byed pa yin te// bla ma'i gsung bzhin du ni mi byed/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi rnam par gzhag pa/ dang po rnam gzhag /bar rgyag phud/ 'gro khar phyi phyag /rjes la 'bul ba 'ong ba'i ngor chos zab mo ston pa po ti re btsongs nas zos pa la'ang sdig pa che ba skad zer na/ rang gi mig dang snying thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa zas dang nor la 'tshong ba'i sdig pa'i grogs po bla ma'i cha byad can de/ sa gas nas mi ltung ngam/ yang slob ma yang rdzas dang yo byad kyi ngor bla ma la dbang cha btsongs nas/ chos sam bzang bzang po zhig su bas thon du re yang*// de yang en cig 'ong du dka' ste/ mi ltogs pa bsod nams zad pa shi la khad pa tshan gcig kyang dom len pa'i bu lon la 'jigs na/ ldom bu la lto 'grang zhig ni gar yang rnyed/ lhag pa'i rdzas dang yo byad kyis ni 'jigs/ 'jig rten gyi zang zing la dgrar ni 'dzin/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi gtsug gi nor bur bkur zhing*/ ka cas ma phongs pa zhig zang zing gis mnyes pa dang drin bzhag chen po 'khur nas rang gi ci bya byar yang mi 'ong*/ de 'dra ba'i ka ca 'dod par dka'/ zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog gis mnyes par de yang*/ dben par bzhugs na ni dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis zhabs tog byed/

tshogs su bzhud na ni tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa rgyal po chen po rnams kyis zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog byed/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa byung na ni/ lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen pos zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog dang mi 'bral ba'i mi la g.yog gi dgos pa chen po yod par yang ma go sgrub pa yang lar 'or cho/ tsab tsab dang dga' rab 'dug /mi sngun jo mo la de las bya thabs med/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla mas tshogs su bsdad pas/ sems mi gnas pa gnas pa dang*/ gnas pa brtan pa dang*/ brtan pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa dang*/ bdud mi 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs pa ldog pa la sogs pa yon tan mang po gzigs nas tshogs su sdod gsungs na ni/ nga 'bu mi la ngo tsha/ a po dang a ma dang*/ g.yog po dang khol lu g.yog chung dang mtshams ma bcad zer nas mi dga' bar 'dug /slob dpon nga 'bu dben pa zhig tu smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar dam pa zhig byed par zhu zer/ dben par bsdad pas skyon 'dag cing yon tan skye ba'i rigs can bla ma'i zhal nas dben par sdod gsung na ni/ a ba nga re sdug /skyid rgyags khyed rnams byed/ nga ni dben par bskrad/ lan gcig zhal mthong ba dang tshogs gsog pa'i skal pa nga la med pas/ slob dpon rang gis kyang nga bzang dogs par 'dug snyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'ong zhing tshig pa za/ tshogs su bsdad pas bla ma de 'khor dang bcas pa'i skyon 'ba' zhig mthong zhing*/ ci bya ci bya snyam zhing khyis bya bdas ba bzhin du yon tan je ring je ring du 'gro ba'i sgrub pa de 'dra bas kyang*/ bla ma'i thugs dkrug pa ma gtogs pa ye thugs mnyes pa kho nar yang ma go 'o na mnyes pa rnam pa gsum po ma gtogs pa gzhan ci 'dra ba zhig gis mnyes/ nged kyis ma shes snyam na/ yod lta yod de bzla sa med/ 'on kyang kha chems rlung la bskur ba dang 'dra bar tshig gcig las med de/ bla mas ci gsung kha la nyan pa gcig pu yin/

de ltar yang rje btsun mar pa'i zhal snga nas/ ci gsung bka' la nyan pa ni// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin// gdams ngag byin pa de tsug yin// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas kyang ci gsung kha la nyan pa la mos gus zer ba yin gsung*/ de'i gnad ka gong du ji ltar bstan pa'i yon tan bskyed pa dang bar chad sel ba mtha' dag bla mas ji ltar gsung ba ma gtogs par rang gis mi shes pa'i phyir ro// de ltar zhing shin tu rnam par dag pa ni bla ma rtogs ldan/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa ni sangs rgyas su go ba'i mos gus/ dngos po rnam par dag pa ni bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du byed cing mnyes pa ste/ de ltar zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum rnam par dag cing*/ rten 'brel 'grigs pas gong du ji ltar bstan pa'i lta ba chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs smrar med pa/ bsam du med pa brjod du med pa/ shes su med pa mthong du med pa/ de mngon du gyur cing rtogs pa ni lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa yin te/ lta ba rnam par dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i lta ba/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs dang babs mngon du gyur pa'i lta ba la/ lung dang rigs pa thams cad dang mi 'gal ba/ 'phags pa thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags pa'i lta ba'o// ༈ //de la sgom pa ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ lar lta thog tu sgom 'tshol ba dang*/ sgom thog tu lta ba tshol ba dang*/ lta sgom zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa la sogs pa lugs mang du yod kyang*/ 'dir 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i dgongs pas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la mos gus tshad du skyol ba las lta ba mngon par rtogs pa'i shes rab skye bar bzhed de/ de ltar yang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes pa dang*/

yang*/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid thar min// skya ba 'dzin pa med pa yi// gru yis pha rol 'gro mi nus// zhes pa la sogs pas mngon gsungs/ rtogs pa'i lta ba bla ma las skye/ lta ba de goms pa la sgom du bzhed de/ de yang ji ltar nyams su len na/ lta ba spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad dam gnyis dang bral ba yin na/ sgom yang spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dam gnyis dang bral bar nyams su len dgos/ de nyams su len pa la gnas dang grogs dang*/ dus dang rdzas dang*/ dgag par bya ba dang bsgrub par bya ba'i bslab pa mtha' rnam pa gnyis dang*/ mtha' rnam pa brgyad dang bral ba nyams su len pa la spyod pa zhes kyang bya ste/ mdor na rang gi dge sbyor la gang phan pa nyams su blang bar byed pa yin pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don/ zhes gsungs pa de'i don thabs gang yin pa dang*/ shes rab gang yin pa dang*/ bogs ji ltar 'don pa dang*/ bogs thon pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa las/ thabs ni byas pa dang bcas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ shes rab ni byas pa med par lhun gyis grub pa/ bogs 'don lugs ni blo gcig du nges par mi mthun pa'i phyogs lan grangs mang du bsten cing goms par byas pa/ bogs thon pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni spyir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ting nge 'dzin bye brag mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang*/ 'dir ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gshis/ spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad dang gnyis dang bral ba de nyams su len pa yin te/ 'dir ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma 'di 'dra rtogs pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ phal cher drag shos mthar thug pa rnams kyang lta ba ni skye med dang*/ stong nyid dang*/ spros bral dang*/ dbu ma dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/

rdzogs chen dang*/ zab zab por grags pa zhig la byas/ sgom pa ni bde stong ngam/ gsal stong ngam/ bzang bzang po zhi gnas shig la byas/ spyod pa ni la la dag na re/ dgag sgrub med pa yin zer nas gcer bur bang rgyugs zas su mi gtsang ba za ba la byed/ la la na re/ spyod pa 'di btsun po yin/ 'dul ba dang mthun dgos zer nas/ mi sngon du sog ma tsag mi zer ba tsug byed/ mdor na gnam gyi ya cha dang*/ sa'i srel gzhi thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas thub pa'i bstan pa yang 'jig /yon tan gong ma yang rgyud la mi skye/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung dang yang mi mthun ste/ de ltar yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa gcig tu mchi// rgyun chad med par rtag na yin// zhes gsungs pas/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa gnyis gcig pa/ spyod lam bzhi dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rgyun chad pa med pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ 'on kyang shin tu dka' bar 'dug /dge sbyor gsha' ma zhig yod na yun ring du bsgoms pa las gnyis med zung du 'jug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa skye ba la tshegs med/ de la yang gal te yun ring du bogs ma thon na/ bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal mdo rgyud kyi dgongs par rang gi nyams su myong bas/ bla ma na 'pho dgos pa zhig tu go de la bla ma na 'pho ba'i go ba gang zhe na/ snga ma'i dge sbyor yod tshod go ba skyes tshod de yi bla ma la mthong lugs des ma phan pa yin pas/ snga ma'i bla ma la mthong lugs de la bogs 'don dgos/ rang gi dad gus la bogs 'don dgos/ mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog la bogs 'don dgos te/ de la bla ma la gsum/ de yang sku rnam pa gsum ste/ rtogs pa la bogs ma thon na bla ma chos skur ma mthong ba'i nyes pa yin/ yon tan la bogs ma thon na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur ma mthong ba'i nyes pa yin/ phrin las la bogs ma thon na sprul pa'i skur ma mthong ba'i nyes pa yin/

de ma go na bla ma dam pa'i de gzhan gyis bzang yang zer/ rang gis bltas pas kyang bzang por 'dug /mos gus byas pas yon tan cig kyang byung*/ yon tan de byung ba'i nyams myong zhig yod pa yin pa la/ 'dir bla ma de 'khro ba dang 'tshig pa dang 'bar ba dang bka' bkyon byung ba'i dus su/ rang nyid mi dga' zhing tshig pa za nas zhe sdang gi rnam par rtog pa phra mo skye/ de skyes pas phyi nang gi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab cing phra bas rtag tu snying mi dga' ba dang*/ tshig pa za ba dang mi mthun pa'i dgra mang ba dang*/ bla ma dang phrad snying mi 'dod cing*/ phrad kyang sngon gyi de dran nas khyod lta ngas re shes snyam pa'i bsam pa 'byung*/ des dam tshig gi sel du song nas/ bsam pa sa bon rnam par shes pa 'di yod na sgom bzang po zhig yod kyang*/ sems can gyi khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag la/ glo bur gyi rnam par rtog pas 'khor bar 'khor zer ba dang mi 'dra'am ste/ rang la gnyer kha med/ lung pa yo ba chus mi 'gyur/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ma spangs pa'i sgom bzang po yin bya ba'i ming gis phan du re bar 'du+ug ste de ngas mi shes/ bka' bkyon de nyid la sangs rgyas sku gsum tshol dgos pa yin na de gang skye bar 'dug /sangs rgyas la khro ba gang yod snyam na/ de ltar yang*// sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang*// khro dang rngam dang bzhad pa dang*// thugs rje ngo mtshar zhi ba'o// zhes pa dang*// yang shin tu khro zhing gtum pa la/ zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te// shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis// khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad// ces pas/ gdul bya rang rgyud ma rungs pa'i gnyen por 'dul byed thabs la mkhas pa'i bla ma de ltar byung ba ma go nas/ phyin ci log tu bsams na rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro ba la tshegs med/ yang bu kun khyed ha cang bla ma la de tsam pa'i ko long mi sdom par zhu dgos/

'jig rten pa kun kyang brtse ba'i pha mas phru gu nya bsring ba'i dus su thabs sna tshogs pa zhig ma gtogs pa/ ye phru gu la phye gtor 'ba' zhig gis kyang chen por 'gyur ba ma yin na/ yon tan skyed pa'i bla mas lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ ye phung shom nges su mi bsam/ 'di kho nas mtshon nas bla ma'i 'dod chags dang*/ gti mug dang*/ phrag dog dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ nyes pa 'di rnams la theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bla na med pa/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba de 'di kho na yin zhes bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas gsung*/ gsang sngags la yar gyi mtshams med dang mar gyi mtshams med las bar du bsdad sa med gsung ba de yang 'di yin tshul du 'dug /des na 'dis mtshon nas bla ma me long yin gsung ba'i don rang gi bsam pa bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dra ba de/ bla ma dam pa'i me long la gsal bar go bar mdzod la/ gegs sel ba dang bogs 'don pa mtha' dag rang nyid kyi shes par bya'o// 'di ni spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa zhig smras nas// ༈ //bye brag bla ma dam pa ni// sangs rgyas sku gsum lhun grub du// rgyun chad med par blta bar bya// de dang dbye ba med pa yi// mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid can// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa rnams// spyi dang bye brag tha dad pa// gcig po zhig la mtshon na yang*// skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// rdo rje theg par gang gsungs pa// yon chab lha mo gang yin pa// rigs ni rdo rje'i rigs yin te// kha dog sngon mo dag tu bshad// phyag na rin chen bum pa bsnams// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs nyid rdo rje mi bskyod pa// lha mo der gyur de nyid kyang*// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// rigs lnga gcig tu gyur pa nyid// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid dang*// yon tan phrin las mnyam gyur pas// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// phyag zhabs 'khru bar bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis gsung*// de ltar dngos po thams cad kyang*// 'di dang 'dra ba sha stag tu// bla med rgyud kyi rgyal po mchog

/gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs su// brjod bya 'di las ma bstan pa// bu gcig khyod kyis bsam nas kyang*// bla ma dam pa mchod par bya// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa brtsam par bya// de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// kun mkhyen nyid kyang thob par 'gyur// ye shes dam pa'ang skye bar 'gyur// dgongs pa bla na med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdus nas bstan pa yin// bu gcig khyod kyis mchod pa'i tshogs// bsam gyi mi khyab dpag med pas// bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya// mchod pa'i bye brag 'di rnams kyis// mchog dang thun mong mtha' dag gi /dngos grub gang dang gang 'dod pa// spyi dang bye brag thams cad kun// gang las gang 'byung shes par bya// ci dang ci 'dod bsgrub par bya// nga ni za 'dod ma lags te// bu gcig snying gi dkyil du zhogs// dngos pos mchod pa bstan pa'o// bsam pa bsam pa bsam pa ni// ji ltar gang ltar skyes pa de'i// lus dang snang ba 'gyur bas na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun// snang ba rang gi sems su gsungs// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma rnams// bu la snying gtam gsang tshig rnams// snang ba sems su bstan pa yin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol pa rnams// rang gis nyams su myong bas kyang*// 'di ltar snang ba gang snang ba// sems su nyams su myong bas grub// ngas kyang khyed la ngo sprod bya// mdun na gnas pa'i bum pa 'di// rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms na// de nyid yi dam lhar gsal nas// bum pa mthong bar mi 'gyur ba// zan zhig za ba'i tshad tsam du// rtog pa gzhan gyi mi g.yeng bar// mnyam par zhogs dang myong ba skye// de la myong ba skyes pa la// tshig gi 'thad pa sna tshogs kyis// snang sems tha dad gang smras kyang*// de la nges shes ga la skye// bum pa lhag pa'i lhar snang na// de las gzhan pa'i rang sems zhig

/phyi na yod dam nang na yod// gal te rang gi lus pa yi// dbus na rgyu ma yod pa yi// de yi nang na yod dam ci// yang gcig snying gi dbus nyid na// khrag rlangs the bong tsam zhig yod// de yi dbus na yod dam ci// lus kyi nang na mi gnas na// phyi rol yul rnams gang na yod// tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las skye na// yi dam lha nyid rang sems yin// de la 'gro 'ong yod pa min// de ltar snang srid 'khor 'das su// ji ltar snang ba thams cad kun// rnam dag 'gres su go bar bya// lcags sregs sa gzhi su yis byas// mo tshogs de dag gang las byung*// de 'dra de dag thams cad ni// sdig sems yin par thub pas gsung*// 'jam dbyangs sras kyis gsungs pa dang*// skyob mdzad 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// ye shes rang snang gnod sbyin ri mo ltar// gcig la mkhas na kun la chags thogs med// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal pa// spyi yi rnam gzhag bstan nas kyang*// bu gcig gong du smras pa'i don// dge sbyor dum zhig yod pa las// bogs thon 'dod pa'i bsam pa ni// ngan zhing btsog par gang bltas pa'i// phung byed mgo skor bla ma la// sngar gyi bum pa ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma mchog tu btud de bsgom// zan gcig za ba'i tshod tsam du// sgom mkhan byung na nyams myong skye// sprang po glen pa dmu 'thom pa// chos dang bral ba 'ga' zhig gis// goms su bcug na ye shes skye// skyon can bla ma de nyid la// sangs rgyas nges shes skyes gyur na// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// sangs rgyas sku gsum lhun grub tu// nges pa'i shes pa mi skye re// gdod nas yin yang ma yin re// gong ma rnams kyi mi gsung re// bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bshad re// bu gcig mos gus tshad du skyol// mos gus tshad du skyol tsam na// ring por mi thogs mngon du 'gyur// zhing dang bsam pa dngos pa yi// bogs 'don bya lugs bstan nas kyang*// snang srid sangs rgyas sku gsum du// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa la// rgyun chad med par skyong ba'i thabs// mang po smras pas ci zhig bya// lug mjug bzhin du rbad kyis bcad// sbra log bzhin du hril gyis dril// da lta nyid du nyams su blang*// nges shes skyes pa'i bsam pa dang*// gang mthun thams cad bsten par bya// nges shes 'di dang ma mthun na// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla ma rnams kyang mi bsten na// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// 'grogs par bya ba smos ci dgos// 'di la skyob pa sangs rgyas rnams// spyod pa rang gi dus tshod dang*// 'brel ba nyid du bstan pa yin// 'di yi mthun rkyen gang yin pa// bsam gyis mi khyab dpag med kyang*// bsdus na rnam pa lnga nyid de// gnas dang grogs dang chos dang ni// rdzas dus ston pa rnam lnga yis// nyams su blangs par gyur pa las// mthar thug 'bras bu thob pa'o// de ltar lta sgom spyod pa gsum// nyams su blangs par gyur pa las// sangs rgyas sku gsum thob pa'i tshul// rgyu dus sa bon gang btab pa'i// 'bras bu dus su thob pa bzhin// sems can ma lus thams cad la// gdod na yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa nyid// sangs rgyas snying po gang gsungs pa// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma yis// rtogs pa'i lta bar bstan pa de// nyams su blangs par gyur pa las// mi mthun phyogs spangs mthun rkyen bsgrub// spyod pa rnam pa gnyis spyad pas// mthar thug 'bras bu sku gsum mo// dbye ba med pa gcig nyid du// 'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas gsung*// bu gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// bsags pa rab gyur dad pa can// shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la// phul du gyur pa bya snyam na// bya ba thong la sgrub pa gyis// lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kyi// chos dang mi mthun mtha' yas pa'i// bsam pa nged kyis rdzogs par dka'// brgya la gal te rdzogs na yang*// dgos pa ci yod legs par soms// sgrub pa snying por mdzad par zhu// dben par bsdad nas ma bsams shing*// mkhas par gyur pa ma yin yang*// bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros dang*// rang gi nyams su myong ba rnams// yi ger bris par gyur pa las// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// nongs par gyur pa gang yin pa// byin gyis brlabs cing bzod pa zhes// 'di bris pa yi dge ba 'dis// mtshon nas bdag dang 'gro kun gyis// byas dang yod pa'i dge ba des// thams cad byang chub mchog thob shog
/shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa rin chen dpal zhes bgyi ba la dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa bstan bcos blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

13) ༄// gdams zab gnad bsdus 'khor lo rin chen dge bshes sha ston la gdams pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos/ thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba yin te/ de lta bu'i chos de gang yin zhe na/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhes pa/ sems nyid zab pa zhi ba 'od gsal ba 'dus ma byas pa 'di/ spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad po gang du lhung bar gyur kyang*/ tshe 'dir nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rgyu/ phyi mar 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu/ sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthong ba dang sgom pas spang rgyu/ mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi phan pa dang bde ba'i 'bras bu rin po che la bar du gcod pa yin par ngo shes par bya ste/ dbu ma'i don la skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o// de la dbu ma gang zhe na/ rtsa dbu ma dang*/ rlung dbu ma dang*/ snod dang bcud dbu ma dang*/ dbu ma rnams kyi babs rtogs shing ro snyoms pa la/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gnod pa dang bral zhing phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub par 'gyur te/ 'dir ni sems nyid rang byung lhan cig skyes pa/ smra bsam mtha' dag dang bral bas dbu ma yin te/ gang gis 'di la gnas par nus na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ sems nyid kyi gshis mnyam pa nyid la mnyam par gnas par bya'o// de la gnyis/ gang zag dang dbang po rab sems nyid gnyug ma ngo shes pas ni/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa ro gcig pa'i don de las ma yengs par gnas par bya ste/ de la ma yengs pa kho nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi skyon thams cad 'dag par rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// 'brum bu me dbal nag po yi// sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yang*// nges shes skyes pas zhi ba dag

/ma skyes dgra yi 'gyod pa kun// bsal ba'i mdo las shes par bya// de skad yang yang gsung ba dang*// spyir skye med phyag rgya chen po 'di// don dam bden pa yin nam min// don dam bden pa yin lags na// bden pa sems nyid rdo rje yis// 'khrul pa'i rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal tshogs// 'joms par 'gyur ba ma lags sam// sdug bsngal 'joms par mi nus na// nged kyi phyag rgya chen po 'dis// rang la phan nam gzhan la phan// go ba tsam gyis chog par yang*// mgon po shākya seṅge dang*// ma pham mgon pos ma gsungs pa// sa lam sbyong bar bstan pa yin// go rtogs skyes pa'i gang zag la// sdug bsngal nad kyis gtses pa'i tshe// shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// phyi nang g.yeng ba rab spangs nas// 'od gsal sems la bsgom byas na// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// sems nyid gnyug mar rtogs gyur nas// bde chen rgya mtsho'i gting du gnas// sdug bsngal zug las grol ba de// rgyu 'bras gnas dus rten 'brel gyis// cis kyang spong ba rdzun ma yin// yang gnyis pa sems nyid rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ sems nyid gnyug mar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang ma phrad nas/ rtogs pa ma skyes na yang*/ dper na gla rtsi dang gla rtsi'i dri bzhin nam/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin du/ phan pa dang bde ba thams cad kyi gzhir 'gyur bas/ dper na 'brog dgon pa shin tu tsha ba'i gnas na chu shin tu bsil ba zhig yod pa la/ skoms pas gdungs pa'i srog chags kyi rigs mang pos spyad na skom pa sel ba dang 'dra bar/ 'du ba rnam bzhi la sogs pa nad dang gnod pa'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas nyen pa rnams kyang*/ thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rang bzhin gyi babs la gnas na myur du skyon dang bral bar 'gyur te// ༈ //'di ltar gser 'od dam pa dang*// 'dus pa chen po rin chen tog

/mdo rgyud rnams su rgyal ba yis// legs par gsungs pa'i sman dpyad dang*// lha dang mi yi drang srong gis// mdzad pa'i gso ba rig pa rnams// tsha grang 'du ba rnam pa bzhi// nad kyi nyen par gyur pa las// gnyen por gyur pa'i sman bsten pas// gnyen pos spang bya choms pa la// ri thang mtshams kyi sman pa dka'// 'di yi dus su gdams ngag gnad// kha zas sman dang spyod lam rnams// snyoms pa'i man ngag gnad du zab// nyon mongs drag las byung ba yi// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po dang*// phan tshun zhe 'gras 'khon pa las// gyur pa'i mdze nad la sogs pa// spang bya gnyen pos 'joms pa rnams// mi bzad bsam pa gdug pa yi// gnyen po byang chub sems bsgoms shing*// sbyor ba'i gnyen por bcom ldan 'das// khros pa'i rgyal por rab 'jigs pa'i// sku gsung thugs nyid khros pa yis// gdug pa choms par gyur pa'i tshe// yang bsgrim zhing glod par mi shes na// sa bdag gsol ba ga la dbang*// yang 'di gdams ngag zab mo ni// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// bral zhing brje ba'i dus kyi tshe// snying rje'i rngan rtags gtsigs su che// gdug pa'i drag sngags spangs nas kyang*// zhi ba'i sems kyis rtsa sngags bzlas// 'dir yang phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// spyir rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi// spang bya gnyen por gyur pa yi// gnad du 'gro ba'i gdams ngag 'di// shin tu dka' ba yin mod kyi// nus pa'i mthar thug bir+wa pas// gsungs pa'i gegs sel gang yin pa// la dor byin rlabs bde ba yis// bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu ma shes na// bya rgyu mang po'i gdams ngag gis// bya 'am mi bya yi re mug /nyams myong med pa'i shes bya 'di// lam rgyus med pa'i lam mkhan bzhin// bde sdug byung na the tshom za// 'dir yang phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le yis// rang lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe// 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan rnams// ngam ngam shugs kyis 'byung 'gyur zhing*// phyi nang rten 'brel zab mo rnams// mngon du gyur pa'i rten 'brel 'byung*// mtho dman nyams myong byung ba'i tshe// skyon dang yon tan gang yin pa// shes nas ston pa'i bla ma dka'// gnyug ma'i drod tshod mi shes par// skal ldan gyi mgo skor ma re mdzod// yang bka' babs brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// 'dir yang phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// rang sems ma hā mu dra 'di// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// phan dang bde ba'i rang bzhin la// 'di ltar yon tan gang brjod kyang*// bdag pas dus gsum rgyal pas kyang*// rdzogs par mthar thug gsung bar dka'// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// kun nas sgo yi theg pa yin// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// mos gus tshad du phyin pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog rnams kyi// snang ba med pa'i shes rab kyis// gnyis snang med pa'i tshul gyis rtogs// tha snyad tshig gi rjes 'brangs nas// tshig tsam gtso bor 'dzin pa yis// rtogs par 'gyur ba ga la srid// bu kun tshur shog rang cag rnams// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// bgrod cing bzhugs par gyur pa'i gnas// gnyis med rdo rje gdan du deng*// phyin par gyur pa skad cig gis// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// mthar thug dbang gis smin byas nas// mthar thug sku gsum thob nas kyang*// lhun gyis grub pa'i chos sku yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yi// gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// gnyis med rang sems rdo rje 'di// rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// mnyam gzhag rjes thob med pa yi// zhe rlom lta ba'i rjes 'brangs nas// brgya phrag stong phrag mang po yi// 'khor gyi dbus na seng ge bzhin// 'gro ba smin par byed pa la// chags pa'i bsam pa ma thengs nas// de yi rtsol sgrub byas lags na// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// smin cing grol bar byed pa la// cis kyang bar du gcod par nges// bu kun 'khor la zhen pa spang*// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba 'am// seṅge rgyal po ji bzhin du// gcig pur gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// khams gsum sems can kun gyi rje// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// spyir bya byed spros pa'i mtshan ma rnams// gnyis snang med pa'i dbus su nub// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// bsod nams tshogs rten rang du go

rdzas dang longs spyod thams cad kun// sgyu mas sprul shing rten 'brel gyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa la// ngo mtshar nges shes skyes gyur na// zang zing spros pas g.yengs gyur na// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin la// dbang phyug chen pos dbang bsgyur zhing*// mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang du// zag med bdud rtsi chen po yis// rang gzhan smin par mi nus shing*// sku gsum nor bu rin po che// dbang gi rgyal po chen po yis// rang gzhan smin par mi nus pas// zang zing spros pa'i rgyun bcad nas// tshur shog nags khrod dgon par bsdad// ri mchog dgon par rnal 'byor rnams// zang zing spros pas dben par 'gyur// spros med ye shes mngon du 'gyur// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// bdag nyid gtsug gi nor bur 'gyur// mthong ngam thos sam dran pas kyang*// phyogs rnams bag dro re ba skye// 'gro ba'i mgon du 'gyur ba 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// spyir na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// nga 'bu ldom bu ban rgan 'di// 'jig rten mi chos 'dun ma mkhas// nged rang bstan pa'i sgor zhugs rnams// phyi mig mig rgyang ring po yis// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// gang yag phyis su gang che ba'i// spyi yi mdun ma ma bsams na// sgos kyi pha yul mi chos kyi// ngo srung mdun ma byas lags na// gnyen dgra bor 'gyur ba a la la// grogs gshed mar 'gyur ba a dzi dzi// bshes rang srog gcod pa 'jigs kyang 'jigs// rang la snying rje yod pa kun// rang yul gnyen bshes spangs nas kyang*// 'gras 'dris med pa'i sa phyogs su// rnal 'byor gcig pur gnas pa'i tshe// dgra zun med pa thams cad kyis// bkur bsti chen po byas nas kyang*// rgyal mtshan rtse mor btags nas kyang*// phyogs bcur ngom par byed pa 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// nged kyi pa pha rin chen de// nye 'dres spangs pa'i phyir de nyid// brgya stong mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// yul phyogs zhen pa bcad pa'i tshe// khams gsum kun gyi bdag por gyur// zang zing spros ba spangs pa'i tshe// nam mkha' mdzod kyi dbang phyug brnyes// tshe 'di'i spros pa bcad pa'i tshe// 'di phyi gnyis ka lhun gyis grub// gcig pur ri khrod bzhugs pa des// kha drag bde skyid phun sum tshogs// bya btsal 'bad pa spangs pa yis// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sar byon// nged rang byed myong ma lags te// gong ma'i mthong phul yod pa yin// brtse bas khyed la gdams pa yin// gdams ngag 'khor lo rin po che// phyi nang rten 'brel zab mo 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas gtso// rgyu lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// gegs sel gnad rnams bsdus pa yi// snying po dam pa rin chen 'di// dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ston gyis// zhus nas bris par gyur pa las// byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kun// skyon dang bar chad bral nas kyang*// sangs rgyas sku gsum thob par shog

/kun nas sgo'i theg pa zab mo'i gdams ngag thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa 'khor lo rin po che lta bu rdzogs so// // 14) ༄// mdo rgyud du ma'i lung rigs kyis gangs ri ti se la bstod pa// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// ti se zhes bya dpal gyi ri bo la// mdo rgyud rnams dang yongs su grags pa dang*// rin chen bla mas bstod par gyur pa las// cung zad tsam zhig deng 'dir bdag gis 'bri// byin rlabs mthar thug dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom// rtsa ba'i rgyud dang yan lag rgyud rnams dang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phan pa'i rgyud rnams las// bde chen 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro gzugs can ma// mtha' yas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu// kha ba can na bzhugs par bcom ldan 'das// ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa dang*// snying po lta bu dgyes mdzad rdo rje nas// sum cu rtsa gnyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gnas// ba yi mchod sbyin kha ba'i rir grags pa// mkha' 'gro'i gnas su bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// mkha' 'gro'i gnas su rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis// ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa mang po zhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud sde rnams su gsungs// rnal mi 'byor pas nyams rtogs med pa dang*// ston pa'i gdams ngag zab mo med pa rnams// mkha' 'gro'i gnas su e ma ji ltar 'gro// ston pa'i mdo sde rnams su mthong ba ni// ma dros klu yi rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdor// ston pa shākya seng ge 'khor bcas rnams// ma dros byang chub sems dpas spyan drangs tshe// ti se'i ri la bzhugs par gyur nas kyang*// mo'u 'gal bu yis gdugs tshod sbran pa las// gangs can ri dang ma dros mtsho yi bar// byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyis// rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i gzhal yas khang*// dpag tshad bdun brgya yangs shing rgya che sprul// tshangs dbang brgya byin rgyal po chen po rnams// gnas mchog brgyan cing bcom ldan 'das la 'dud// gnas der ma dros dbang pos zhus pa'i mdor// theg chen yangs pa zab cing rgya che bas// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// bsam gyis mi khyab dpag tu med pa rnams// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sa la 'god par gsungs// bskal pa bzang po 'di yi sangs rgyas stong*// dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis// gnas der theg chen zab cing rgya che bas// 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin brlabs shing*// sems can dpag tu med par smin mdzad pa'i// ti se'i gangs la ci phyir 'gro mi byed// song nas sgrub pa snying por mi byed pa// sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams// khyed la mi gzigs rgyab tu skyur snyam mam// sa bcu'i mdo nas ri rgyal gangs can ni// sman rnams thams cad 'byung ba'i sgo yin zhes// ston pa thugs rje can gyis cher bstod cing*// sman gyi rgyal po lha mdzes chen po dang*// shing mchog rtsa ba ma grub pa la sogs// ngo mtshar rmad du byung bas gang mod kyang*// mi ma yin gyis sbas par gyur pas na// ba glang rdzi la sogs pas mi mthong gsungs// 'dul ba lung nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// phyag na rdo rje 'tsho byed gzhon nur bcas// sman gyi ched du gangs can rir gshegs nas// sman pa'i rgyal po mya ngan 'das la bkod// 'dul ba lung du rgya cher gsungs pa dang*// ston pa thugs rje can 'dis gangs can 'dir// thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// ti se'i rtse mor phyag stong spyan stong gis// srin po'i rgyal po btul bar gyur ces gsungs// rdo rje me ltar rab tu rmongs byed gzungs// gangs can ri yi sul du gsungs pa dang*// stong chen rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo sde dang*// rje btsun byams pa phyag na rdo rje yi// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa las ti se'i rir// yongs las kyi rgyu ba ni// bzang ngan ji ltar byas pa'i las rnams kyis// dgra bcom thob kyang bzang ngan 'bras bu la// ji ltar spyod pa rgya cher gsungs pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs dang*// ma 'dres yon tan tshogs kyi rgyu 'bras dang*// phrin las gang la ji ltar 'byung ba yi// rgyu 'bras mtha' yas dpag tu med pa yis// byang chub yon tan phrin las bstan pa yis// sems can dpag tu med pa smin pa rnams// 'dul ba lung dang ye shes rgyas pa'i mdor// mtha' yas dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*// 'phags pa me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs gsungs shing*// 'phags pa sdud pa sangs rgyas phal chen dang*// ston pa'i mdo sde dpag tu med pa yang*// ston pa thugs rje can gyis bsngags pa ni// ma dros byang chub sems dpa' chen po des// bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// 'dzam gling 'di yi bde skyid thams cad kun// sku gnyer dam par bzhes pa'i dbang gis so// spos kyi ngad ldang ri yi rgyal po las// theg chen ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo sder gsungs// ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyod yul der// spyod pa rlabs chen dpag tu med pa yis// sems can dpag tu med pa smin mdzad pa// gsung rab mang po zhig tu bdag gis mthong*// 'jig rten bzhag par glang chen dbang po mchog

/lha min g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa po// rab brtan 'khor bcas gser gyi bya skyibs la// gnas par gyur ces yongs su grags pa'o// dbang phyug chen po u ma 'khor dang bcas// 'dzam gling dbang phyug chen po ma dros pa// mi'am ci yi rgyal po ljon pa sogs// lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che yi gnas// sems pa bdag nyid chen pos gang ba der// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas// zab cing rgya che
