ston pa'i zhabs kyis nam yang ma bcags zhes// glen pa mu cor ma smra mdo rgyud ltos// 'jig rten yongs su grags pa'i gtam rgyud las// dbang phyug chen po shel gyi gzhal yas khang*// 'dzam bu gling gi lto ba ti se la// dgra bcom lnga brgya yongs su bzhugs pa dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun mi la yis// zhabs kyis bcags shing yun ring bzhugs pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa mtha' dag in+d+ra bo dhi chen po la// rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa ni// gnas der rgyal po de la bshad do zhes// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dam pa de nyid du// seng ge'i sgra bsgrags bdag gis thos pa dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul gyi gtso bor ni// ti se'i gangs 'di yin zhes bka' bstsal gsungs// gdul bya dbang phyug u ma gnas pa der// 'dul byed su zhig gnas par soms dang kye// 'jig rten kun gyi bdag po lha chen ni// 'jig rten 'das pa'i bdag po su zhig yin// legs par bsams na go ba ngang gis skye// drang por smras na kha 'ud can du mthong*// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i dam pa rnams// ston pas zhabs kyis bcags pa byin rlabs che// grub pa thob pa'i gnas 'di bkra re shis// rang yul rigs dang mthun pa grub thag nye// bod yul kha ba can gyi sa phyogs 'dir// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'di 'dra ba// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi mi rnams la// ston pa thugs rje can gyis bcags pa 'dir// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzod dang rnal 'byor pa// 'di 'dra gnas kyi bdag po mi dbang ni// mnga' bdag byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i mgon// mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dpal dbyangs// khri gtsug ral pa zhes su yongs grags pa// rje btsun phyag na rdo rje tshun chad nas// mnga' ris skor gsum yang mes gdan sa dang*// bod khams yongs kyi spyi rje mi dbang ni// chos kyi rgyal po gdung rgyud ma chad pa// ngo mtshar bla med rmad du byung gyur ba// deng sang bzhugs pa'i rgyal po chen po ni// 'gro ba'i mun sel bsil ba'i rgyal mtshan can// byang chub sems dpa'i skye bar yongs grags pa// mnga' bdag seṅge de yi mchod pa'i gnas// ti se la sogs rmad du byung rnams kyi// mgon po ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba la// mi yi seṅge rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// 'jig rten chos brgyad 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyi// nyes pa mang po gzigs nas thugs skyo zhing*// 'gro ba'i nyes tshogs mtha' dag bral ba dang*// byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i go cha can// rgyal ba'i bstan pa zab zhi spros dang bral// sems nyid 'od gsal sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa der// srog la bab kyang sgrub pa tshul bzhin bya// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// gnas kyi bka' stsal dpag tu med pa gsungs// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor pas// ston pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa snying por bya// phyogs gcig gnas gcig mdor bstan nas// gzhan yang rgyas par bshad pa ni// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor pa// snang srid 'di la sku gsung thugs kyi rten// kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam gsung thugs kyi yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// ma lus mtha' dag rdzogs par bya bar gsungs// chos rje bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// 'khor 'das chos ni ma lus ji snyed pa// gdod nas ma skyes spros pa'i /nye bar zhi ba'i gnas 'dir rnal 'byor pa// gnyis su med pa'i gnas 'dir bag rkyang bzhugs// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyi gnas// gcig yod gcig med smra ba mi bden te// nyi ma dro ba 'od zer mun sel bzhin// nyams su blangs na mngon du 'gyur bar nges// ri yi rgyal po gangs can gyi skor de bzhin gshegs pas zhabs kyis bcags shing bsngags pa phyogs gcig mthong ba bris pa rdzogs so// //

/grub thob gong mas bzung ba dang*// khyad par bla ma rin chen gyi// gdan sa rang rig gnyug ma la// sku gsum yon tan ma lus rnams// dar cing rgyas par mi byed par// thag pa bcad pa'i bya bzhin du// pa lags// nyams rtogs gnyis med ma bskyangs par// thag pa bcad pa'i bya bzhin du// lho yi phyogs su 'gro ba de// bsams kyin blo ba ma bde lags// byang phyogs gnam mtsho phyug mo ni// g.yu yi maṇ+ṭal bkod legs 'dra// zab cing rgya che gting dpag dka'// pad+ma'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i// grub thob gong ma'i dgon pa lags// rang sems gtan la ma phab par// thag pa bcad pa'i bya bzhin du// lho yi phyogs su 'gro ba de// bsams kyin blo ba ma bde lags// nam ra gcen gcung gi dgon pa ni// gdug pa'i lha 'dre tshogs sa yin// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// gdug pa can rnams btul nas kyang*// rang gzhan don kun ma bsgrubs par// thag pa bcad pa'i bya bzhin du// lho yi phyogs su 'gro ba de// bsams nas blo ba ma bde lags// rtsal chen lha sgo mdung rtse ni// mdung dar nam mkhar 'phyar ba 'dra// rje mar pa dpal chen rga lo yis// spros pa bcad pa'i yang dgon yin// sems la spros pa ma bcad par// thag pa bcad pa'i bya bzhin du// lho yi phyogs su 'gro ba de// bsams nas blo ba ma bde lags// ngo mtshar can gyi dgon pa bzhi// kha ba can gyi byang phyogs su// ma bsam lhun gyis grub pa la// rang gzhan don kun ma bsgrubs par// lho yi phyogs su 'gro ba de// mi kho bo'i blo ba cung ma bde// rje sa bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas dang*// 'bral bar shes pa ma nus kyang*// rang dbang med pa'i gnad 'di byung*// spyir gsang sngags dam tshig gnyan pa dang*// sgos dpal ldan nā ro'i brgyud pa 'di// lam zab bla ma yin pa des// ngam shod du mi 'gro rang dbang med// lus bskyed pa'i pha ma 'dra ba yi// mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis// sku na so bgres pas grongs kar phyin// brtse ba'i shugs kyis 'bod mi btang*// mi yongs dogs nas dam lam bsgres

bsres pa // des kyang mi 'gro rang dbang med// pha chos rje bla ma'i lugs sku dang*// bla ma dam pa'i bka' dar byon// dam tshig gnad la bsgres pa yis// des kyang mi 'gro rang dbang med// gru lam gcig tu zhugs pa yi// mched grogs rdo rje spun drung rnams// brtse ba'i shugs kyis drung du lhags// snying rje rje'i skad du zhu don gsol// rje sa bdag rgyal po'i zhabs tog kyang*// nged phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'khor ni// bod yul dbus 'dir bzhugs pa yi// chen por gyur pa phal cher yin// ji ltar bzhed pa'i thugs dgongs kyang*// thams cad nged kyis bya'o zhes// zhu don yang yang gsol na yang*// snying sran bskyed nas bsdad pa la// lus srog gtong ba skad kyis bsdigs// blo bas ma bzod kha mar shor// gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma drug /ngam shod klung du sngon la btang*// 'ong ba rgyal khams yongs su grags// des kyang mi 'gro rang dbang med// rje sa bdag rgyal pos bka' ma bkyon// phyogs ris yon bdag thugs ma chad// da res lan gcig mchi bar 'tshal// slad nas tshur la mchi bar zhu// spyir kho bo shākya'i ban ldom 'di// sa phyogs gang dang gar 'dug kyang*// khyod sa bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi// bla mchod rtsod pa med pa yin// chos dang mthun par gyur ba yi// nus pa'i mthu stobs ci yod pas// da rung rje yi zhabs tog bgyi// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams// khyed dang sems can rnams la 'bul// bkur bas gces ka 'tshong ba med// mi 'gro rang dbang med pa lags// lan cig cis kyang mchi bar zhu// slad nas myur du mjal bar zhu// // 16) byang gnam mtsho la bstod cing zhen med kyi sgrub pa byed par bskul ba// oṃ swasti/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// legs par bsngags pa sgrub pa'i gnas// dben zhing yon tan rab rdzogs pa// kha ba can gyi sa phyogs 'dir// deng sang dus na rmad byung ba// shākya seṅges lung bstan pa'i// dbang po dri za rnams kyi rje// zur phud lnga pa'i gnas la sogs// kha ba can gyi ri rnams dang*// dpe zla med pa'i gnam mtsho 'di// ngo mtshar can gyi sgrub gnas bsten// gnam mtsho phyug mo'i mtshan nyid ni// zab cing rgya che gting mtha' med// bai ḍūr sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba// gser gyi ri bo mchog rab 'dra// khyad 'phags rmad du byung ba yi// dpal dang ldan pa'i do rnams byung*// khrung khrung ngang ngur la sogs pa// yid 'ong bya yi tshogs rnams kyis// snyan pa'i sgra skad phyogs bcur sgrogs// nags mthongs me tog sna tshogs kyis// legs par bkra ba lha gnas yin// sha rkyang ri dwags tshogs rnams kyis// bag phebs 'jigs pa med par gnas// dgon par gnas pa'i g.yag rgod rnams// nyam nga med par sgo drung sdod// grub thob gong ma bzhugs pa'i gnas// 'jig rten ngam gyur 'gro ba'i mgon// pad+ma'i rgyal pos byin brlabs pa'i// gnam mtsho do 'dir cis mi sdod// skyon med phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas// ngang ngam shugs kyis dgon pa yi// mthun pa'i rkyen du gnam mtsho 'di// mnyam nyid mtha' dang bral ba yi// gnyis med phyag rgya chen po ltar// mnyam zhing mdzes pa'i thang gis bskor// dngos po kun gyi ngo sprod pa// smig rgyu'i tshogs kyi 'phreng bas 'khrigs// mi dang mi min la sogs pa// dpa' zhing rngam pa'i chos skyong rnams// zang zing g.yeng ba la sogs pa'i// sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad sel// lha klu gnyug mar gnas pa rnams// ma ga dhar yang rnyed dka' ba'i// kha ba'i rgyun rnams 'bebs par byed// gangs can ri bo la rnams la// dbang po rdo rje ra ba ltar// srung ba'i 'khor lo mchog tu gyur// 'di yang gnam mtsho'i rkyen tu snang*// rmad byung gnam mtsho phyug mo ni// gnyan chen thang lha la sogs pa'i// gangs ri shel gyi phreng bas bskor// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog rnams la// tshur byon 'dir bzhugs zer ba 'dra// dben zhing nyams dga' la sogs pa// bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad kun// gangs ri rgyal po mchog la snang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la dang*// brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyis kyang*// kha ba can gyi ri khrod du// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don kun bsgrubs// yar la gzigs pa'i dam pa rnams// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// 'dod yon ro la ma zhen par// gong ma rnams kyi rjes bsnyags te// gangs la bsgom na seng ge yin// skyes mchog mi yi seṅge de// gangs khrod gnas dang 'bral mi bya// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// chags pa'i bsams pas gnas mi bya// chags pa'i bsam pas gnas gyur na// gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gsod// zhe sdang bsam pas gnas na yang*// gdug pa'i lha 'dres gsod par nges// gti mug gnyid kyi dbang song na// klu bdud gdug pa'i dbang du 'gro// shin tu dben pa'i gnas rnams su// nyon mongs gsum pos gang gnas pa// gdug pa'i lha 'dres bsad nas kyang*// ngan song gsum du nges ltung zhes// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs// bla ma'i bka' las gang 'da' ba// dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur ram// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// chags sdang bre mo'i gtam rnams kyis// rtag tu dus rnams 'da' byed cing*// rang gzhan kun gyi mgo bskor na// dgon par gnas pa'i dgos pa ci// bu gcig 'du 'dzi long gtam spongs// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// don med bya ba sna tshogs kyis// dus rnams 'da' bar gang byed pa// thar pa'i bsam pa nyams gyur pa// nyon mongs bdud kyi dbang song nas// 'di phyi gnyis kar ngan song lhung*// rang la rang snying mi rje 'am// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// gdug pa chags sdang drag po'i bdud// mig gi dbang po'i sgor zhugs nas// mig gis ltad mo don du gnyer// ri dang mtsho dang thang rnams la// rtag tu skyo bsang byas na yang*// mig shes chags sdang ma zhi na// gzugs kyi skyo ba mi bsang zhing*// chags sdang mchil pas

lcags kyu bzung nas kyang*// 'di phyi gnyis kar dmyal bar 'tshed// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// rang sems 'khrul pa'i chags sdang gis// dbang po rnams kyi sgor zhugs nas// snyan pa'i sgra dang zhim po'i ro// mngar mo bza' btung sna tshogs dang*// bde ba'i reg bya thams cad la// zhen cing chags pa'i zhen stobs kyis// bsam zhing zhen par byed pa rnams// dben pa'i dgon pa ma bsams sam// zhen pas phung ba ma go 'am// rul pa mchod pas ci la phan// bu gcig 'dod yon zhen pa thongs// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// bu gcig bde bar 'dod pa'i sems// dman pa'i bsam pas gnas mi bya// sangs rgyas rnams kyis smad pa yi// bsam pa 'di la gang gnas pa// nyan thos theg par ltung nas kyang*// byang chub sems la bar du gcod// bar chad bdud dang ma bral na// dgon par gnas pas ci zhig bya// 'di 'dra dben pa'i dgon pa 'dir// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// dbang gi rgyal po rin po che// sa gzhi phun sum tshogs pa la// grub thob brgyud pa las byung ba'i// zab mo gsang sngags gdams ngag gis// sa bon skyon dang bral ba 'debs// rang don gzhan don phun tshogs pa'i// mchog thun mong gnyis kyi 'bras bu 'di// dben pa'i dgon par ma smin na// chags sdang nyon mongs sna tshogs kyis// lus ngag yid gsum rnam g.yengs nas// nyon mongs g.yeng ba sna tshogs kyis// rnam par g.yeng la dgon pa zhes// dpa' bo bdud bzhi las rgyal ba// sangs rgyas rdo rje bsnams pa yi// bla ma rin chen ma gsungs pas// bu rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// dgon par gnas pa'i dgos pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// dgon pa bsten pa'i yon tan rnams// thogs pa med par 'byung ba ni// rgyu 'bras slu ba med par nges// yang gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// rang sems 'khrul pas bskul bas so//

// 17) ༄// mdo rgyud du ma la brten nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bstod phyag 'bul ba// lha na mo/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs gnas dam par phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa grangs med sngon rol du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas shing*// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang*// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs tshe// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can la// sku gsung thugs nyid mi bzad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pas// ma lus smin par mdzad pa yi// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// sku yi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa yi// zhing rnams ma lus thams cad du// la lar dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs// la lar byang chub mngon sangs rgyas// la lar zag med mya ngan 'das// la lar dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*// gdul bya rigs can tha dad la// dman dang mchog gi lus rnams kyis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// sgrol mdzad rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// 'gro mgon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun khyod ni sngon gyi tshe// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can la// thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'gro drug sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// nam yang thar bar ma gyur bar// thugs rjes byang chub thugs bskyed pas// bde gshegs rin chen snying po yis// spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan btags shing*// ming gi 'khor lor byin brlabs pas// gang gi rje btsun khyod kyi mtshan// yi ge drug pa bzung ba des// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong bzung bar 'gyur ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung*// dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bye snyed dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rdul snyed rnams// ma lus thams cad 'du bar 'gyur// lha klu gnod sbyin tshogs rnams kun// lus dang grib ma bzhin du bsrung*// rje btsun khyod mtshan 'dzin pa yi// ba spu'i bu ga re rer yang*// sangs rgyas bye ba snyed bzhugs shing*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs par mdzad// lus la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams// phyir mi ldog pa thob par 'gyur// mthong dang rig dang dran pa dang*// gang gis rje btsun khyod kyi mtshan// lan gcig thos par gyur pas kyang*// nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// myur du thar bar 'gyur ba dang*// rje btsun sku yi dkyil 'khor gyi// zhing khams rnam par dag pa dang*// bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// bde skyid yon tan rab rdzogs te// mthar thug byang chub thob 'gyur ba// khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*// 'di dang yon tan mtha' yas pa// thob par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// phyag 'tshal mgon po spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi// rje btsun mgon po spyan ras gzigs// khyod kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal ba// chos sku rnam par dag pa nyid// de yi byin rlabs phul byung ba// zab cing rgya che rgyal ba'i chos// shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs// bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag gi

/zab pa'i mdo don rtogs mdzad pa// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po khyod kyis thugs bskyed pa// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji snyed par// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs so zhes// thugs rjes dam bca' ji bzhin tu// rje btsun chos kyi sku nyid dang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang ni// sprul sku mya ngan mi 'da' ba// mtha' yas yon tan rab rdzogs pa// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun khyod kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// nyes tshogs sdug bsngal rab zhi ste// bde skyid mtha' dag thob mdzad nas// byang chub mchog la 'god mdzad pa// phrin las mthar phyin phyag 'tshal lo// chos skus 'dul ba'i zhing khams su// chos sku 'phrin las bsam mi khyab// mi mjed 'jig rten gcig pur yang*// phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba stong*// spyan stong bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong*// gang la cis 'dul de ston pa// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la// 'dzam bu gling 'di gcig pu+ur yang*// bram ze chen po sa ra ha// khyod kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la// 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa// grub thob dpag tu med pa yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par gyur// de yang rje btsun thugs rje can// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pas lung bstan byang phyogs su// kha ba can 'dir spyan ras gzigs// lag na pad+mo 'grub ces gsung*// phyag 'tshal mgon po spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// rigs can smin par mdzad pa la// nam yang dus las mi 'da' ba// chos kyi rgyal po thugs rje can// mnga' bdag srong btsan zhes bya ba// de yang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten ngam gyur pad ma dang*// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// rmad du byung ba'i dam pa rnams// rje btsun mgon po spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs rje yis// 'gro kun smin par mdzad pa yi// phrin las mthar phyin phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bla ma rin po ches mdo rgyud du ma la brten nas bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so//

18) ༄// nyams myong dri med bdud rtsi yag bzhed ston pa shes rab la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi gter du gyur pa/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong kyi bar du/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los/ 'gro ba ma lus pa smin par mdzad pa'i bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa bsgom/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba bya zhes/ nged rnams la mnyam du gsungs pa de las/ de re re la yang nyams su myong ba bag tsam skyes pa la goms su bcug pas/ da lta'i nad dang gnod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams dang*/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa/ gegs dang bar chad du gyur pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ bogs dang yon tan gyi tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel bar go de la dang po kho nar byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed pa brtan pa dang*/ brtan pa bogs dbyung ba rnam pa gsum las/ ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i tshul lugs shin tu mang yang*/ gsang sngags nyams su blang ba'i tshul bzhin du lus kyi 'phrul 'khor/ ngag gi 'phrul 'khor/ sems kyi 'phrul 'khor rnam pa gsum la brten nas nyams su blang na/ myur du skye ba la tshegs mi 'dug /de yang dang po kho nar shin tu dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad nas/ stan bde ba'i steng du bsam gtan gyi yan lag ci bder gnas par byas nas/ bdag nyid la gnod par byed pa'i gegs/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra /thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du gcod par byed pa'i ma rgan rnams la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po bskyed cing*/

gdung ba'i shugs gcad du med pa'i stobs kyis/ lus kyi 'phrul 'khor smin phrag bsdus nas mchi ma glog pa'i tshul du/ ngag gi 'phrul 'khor/ bdag la gnod par byed pa 'di snying re rje/ bdag la gnod par byed pa 'di snying re rje/ zhes phreng ba la grangs su bzung zhing*/ rgyun chad med par sngags su shes pa la 'dres par byas nas phri li li bgrang*/ brgya rtsa brgyad tsam song ba dang*/ yid kyi 'phrul 'khor ni/ gong gi snying rje'i shugs de rgyun ma chad par byas la/ bdag la gnod par byed pa 'di cis snying rje na/ rgyu mtshan 'di rnams kyis snying rje ste/ tshe thog ma med pa nas a ma yin pa dang*/ a ma 'di las ngan pa'i dbang du song bas/ shes pa la rang dbang ma thob/ smyos pa dang 'dra bas spyir sems can thams cad la gnod pa mi bya dbang med/ sgos rang nyid la gnod pa mi bya dbang med pa dang*/ a ma 'dis rang gzhan la gnod pa byas pa'i rgyus/ 'bras bu sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba dang*/ de'i sdug bsngal dran par bya ba dang*/ dmyal bar lan gcig skyes pas mi chog ste/ 'khor ba mtha' dag tu 'khyams pa'i sdug bsngal dran par bya ba dang*/ a ma sdug bsngal de lta bus mnar ba la skyabs dang re sa bu rang nyid ma gtogs pa gzhan med pa/ de rnams rim pa yin min du shes pa la gang gnad pa/ rgyu mtshan zhib par bsams pas/ snga ma'i snying rje la shin tu snying rje ba'i bogs thon nas de'i rgyun yang snga ma bzhin bgrang*/ yang rgyu mtshan dran par bya/ de ltar rgyu mtshan dran par bya ba dang snying rje bgrang ba rnam pa gnyis la ma yengs par phri li li nyams su blangs pas/ shes pa la rang dbang med pa'i snying rje chen po skye ste/ ngu snying 'dod pa dang*/ mchi ma 'chor ba dang*/ lus kyi tshugs mi thub pa rnams 'byung ste/ 'di ni yid kyi 'phrul 'khor zhes bya'o// de ltar 'phrul 'khor gsum gyis skyes pa'i 'bras bu gnod par byed pa la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po rang dbang med par skyes pa de/

rgyun chad med par bskyang bar bya ste/ dgra dang bgegs la zhe sdang ba dang gnod pa skyel ba la sogs pa snying rje'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa spang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ gnod par byed pa rnams thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing*/ gnod byed kyi gtso bo byas pa'i don du bskal pa dpag tu med par dbu dang rkang lag dpag tu med pa btang zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po ches gnod par byed pa smin cing grol bar byas nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs rnams kyang dran par bya ba dang*/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di'i gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di yang*/ gnod par byed pa la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes pa'i lag rjes yin par mdo rgyud thams cad du rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i phyag len mtha' dag kyang*/ 'di 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs la sdo ba rnams la dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas phan dpag tu med pa 'dogs shing*/ kha zas ngan pas grongs par byas pa rnams kyi ming byang bzung zhing*/ dge slong bzhi sdes kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs chog mdzad cing byang bu 'khru ba dang*/ 'di ngan song du ma song ba kho bo'i gnyer ka yin gsungs pa la sogs pa mtha' dag dran par bya ba dang*/ yul dman pa gsum gces par bzung ba'i bka' stsal dpag tu med pa gsung zhing*/ byed du bcug pa rnams dran par bya zhing*/ snga ma'i snying rje'i nyams de brtan par bya ba ni skyes pa brtan par bya ba'i thabs so// de ltar gnod par byed pa la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes pa'i stobs kyis/ rang la ltos pa med par bdag gi bde ba dang skyid pa thams cad gnod byed par gtong zhing*/ gnod byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur 'khur ba'i blo skyes pa'i dus su/

gong nas gong du bogs 'don par byed pa ni/ gnod par byed pa la ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul lugs de kho na bzhin du 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la yang de kho na bzhin du bsgoms pas snying rje ji bzhin du skyes pa'i dus su byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya ste/ de yang sngon du bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams gzu dang dpang du bzhag ste/ bdag gis sems can ma bsgral ba bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba 'byor dbang phyug mi la des// zwa tsha med du gsol ba'i dka' thub kyis// yon tan rdzogs par ma gsungs te// mnyam med bla ma dam pa la// bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin// bsod nams bsags pa'i thabs mkhas na// che chung dang bzang ngan mi bdog ste// bla ma mnyes pa gtsigs su che// bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas la// sa rdul dang ras kyi kha tshar tsam// phul nas thugs bskyed zhus lags pas// bskal pa bzang por gsungs pa dang*// slob dpon chen po tog rtse bas// dpal ldan bzang po'i bla ma la// glu tshig bzhi yis mchod pa yis// mnyes pa dam pas mnyes pa las// slob mas mchog gi dngos grub thob// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la// gar mkhan rigs las lcam sring gsum// bro gar phrug cig phul ba yis// don chen grub shing dngos grub thob// byang kha'i 'brong dang lho kha'i stag

/nam mkha'i bya dang chu nang nya// 'dre gdon mngon shes can rnams kyis// da rung thar pa ma thob pa// phrag phrug gi bu chung ma go 'am// yang bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyu med na// 'bras bu yon tan re thag chad// lam log gol sar zhugs pa dang*// bdud kyis khyer ba'i gang zag rnams// tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i rgyu spangs nas// mu stegs byed kyi rnam thar ltar// dka' thub spyod la yon tan re// log pa'i lam du zhugs par nges// yon tan gong ma skye bzhed na// rgyu la 'bad na 'bras bu 'byung*// // 22) ༄// 'od gsal shags ka mtho dgos pa brdung rdung tag tag/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// brdung rdung btag tag pa re sdug /rje gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i ri bo bcom// 'khrul pa'i rgyal po nga bdag de// sdug par gyur pa shin tu yus// 'khrul ba'i rnam rtog gces ka can// khyod kyi yus ka len re shi// spyir rang sems 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog 'di// phan pa bas kyang gnod na dga'// dug dang bdud rtsi dug la dga'// goms pa'i stobs kyi bag chags kyis// srog rtsa chad pa 'tsher ba yin// srog chad 'tsher kha shin tu yus// 'di gnod pa'i dgra bo gces ka can// khyod la blo gtad byed re shi// bdag 'dzin gyi yus ka mi len na// skye med 'od gsal chos sku dang*// bdag 'dzin mun pa'i ma rig pa// spang bya gnyen por gnas pa la// rigs drug 'khor ba'i grong khyer na// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// spang gnyen gnyis kyi shags ka bkye// ma rtogs 'khrul pa shags mtho na// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gshed ma des// chags sdang gnyis kyi mtshon thogs nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// gsod lugs mi 'dra sna tshogs kyis// bsha' res byed pa 'di yi re mug /rang dbang med pa 'di 'jigs kyang 'jigs// sdug bsngal drag po 'di zhe re lang*// thar dus med pa 'di sdug re bsngal// skyabs mgon bral ba re thag chad// 'di cis kyang 'byung ba ku re min// bu da rung skyug nag ma log gam// skye med 'od gsal shags mtho na// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs drung du// lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor la// bde ba chen po'i mdza' na mos// gnyis su med par 'khril nas kyang*// dga' ba bzhi yi longs spyod la// zhen pa med pa'i bde skyid kyis// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi longs spyod myong*// longs spyod mi ngan bzang por gda'// yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po des// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byams pa chen pos ris su bcad// snying rje chen pos bur yang byas// byang chub sems kyi pha phogs gtad// pha rol phyin drug rgyan gyis brgyan// stong nyid snying rje'i ru mtshon gyis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i dgra las rgyal// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bor gda'// dgra gnyen du chod pa'i dpa' bo dang*// gnyen stong par rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis// sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// dus rgyun chad med par ko ra ra// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsten pa la// gtor ma mi dgos so re gsod// bsnyen sgrub mi dgos yid re dal// hūm̐ phaṭa srog sngags ma bzlas kyang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i dur khrod du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol pa'i tshe// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// 'bral ba med par gyur pa ni// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// nged kyi pha pa rje btsun rnams// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbyer med pa// ngur khrod dbus su rol pa mdzad// bu nged kyang de yi rjes su slob// 'di 'od gsal shags ka mtho ba yin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol pa yin//

23) ༄// mos gus bya ba'i rim pa sgom pa rin chen seng ger gnang ba// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// dpon slob kyi rten 'brel ma 'dzoms par// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mi 'byung zhes// grub thob gong mas 'o dod bos// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pas na// rig byed slob pa'i gang zag bzhin// dpag nyan go tshod glo gtam bsam tshod gleng langs kyis// chos zab mo shes par mi mdzad zhu// bsgrubs kyang yon tan mi 'byung lags// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma lus rten cing 'brel ba zhes// grub thob gong mas 'o dod bos// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal pa// zhing dang dngos po bsam pa gsum// gcig tu gyur pa'i rten 'brel gyis// gnas dang dus kyis ma bskal na// ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'grub 'gyur ba// lag len rgyu 'bras zab mo yi// me long bltas la dam chos zhus// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi chos// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung khungs mchog /'khor 'das bde skyid mi zad pa// 'di la 'byung gi gzhan med ces// grub thob gong mas 'o dod bos// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' bstsal pa// rgyal bas mdo rgyud rnams su gsungs// bstan bcos mkhan po rnams kyis bshad// gdams ngag rnams su mang po 'dug /'di 'dra bdag gi rna ba tsha// snyam du bsams nas mi spang zhing*// nyams rtogs ldan pa'i bla ma la// mos gus tshad du bskyal nas kyang*// stong dang snying rje'i nyams rtogs ni// tshig phyir mi 'brang rgyud la bskyed// lar snyigs ma lnga yi dus la babs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dam chos rnams// deng sang tshig gi brgyud par song*// yin lugs 'dod lugs tshig tshogs mkhan// tha snyad tshig gi spros pa la// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ya so thug /gsang sngags sgrub pa'i 'bras bu yis// grub nas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis// rang gzhan gnyis kyi mgo bskor byas// mthu chen grong chog byed pa 'dis// gong ma'i zhabs 'dren bstan pa bsnubs// lar ji ltar byas kyang dka' bar 'dug

/mgo gang du bstan kyang nad pa'i sngas// chos nyams su blangs pa yi mug snon// kye ho rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// dus deng sang gi dus 'dir mi 'bad re// 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad 'di mi spang re// thar pa'i khang bzang du mi 'gro re// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dgongs pa bka' dang bstan bcos rnams// nyams myong dang rtogs pa mi bstar re// pha grub thob gong ma thams cad kyi// gshegs shul phyir rjes mi bsnyag re// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa mchog /'gyur med lhun grub 'dus ma byas// rdo rje gdan la mi 'dug re// lar bsgrubs pas 'bras bu mi 'byung na// dus gsum sangs rgyas gang nas byung*// dam chos byed pa su zhig 'ong*// bsgrubs na 'bras bu 'byung nges pas// tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub// rdo rje theg pa'i chos sgor zhugs// smin lam rin chen dbang bzhi bskur// grol ba bskyed rdzogs dang du blang*// rang don gzhan don phun sum tshogs// 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob par nges// mos gus bya ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba// shākya'i dge slong rin chen dpal la dad pa dang gus pa dang ldan pa'i sgom pa rin chen seng ger gnang ba rdzogs so// // 24) ༄// rang rnam mdze 'ur 'ded chen mo'i gsung mgur// bu ngas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// tshad ldan bla ma rin chen btsal// sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes// rje btsun sku yi dkyil 'khor la// dbang yongs su rdzogs pa mang du zhus// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs la// lam nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag gnang*// don gnyis su med par nyams su myong*// dus dang gnas skabs de tsam na// yun ring po bsten long ma byung bar// khong 'jig rten mgon po mya ngan 'das// gdung ba'i sems la tshugs thabs med// 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' drin dran// gcig pur ri khrod dben gnas bsten// 'jig rten chos brgyad rgyab tu bskyur// lto gos gnyis la zhen pa bcad// sems gnyis med kyi ngang la rgyun tu bsgom// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin dang*// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// sngon thog med kyi dus nas bsags pa yi// las ngan gyi sdig sgrib dus 'dir smin// nad gso bar dka' ba'i mdze nad byung*// shi na dga' ba'i bsam pa skyes// sprang po ri khrod dgon par lus// gdams ngag gi be'u bum phyogs na med// khyod na'am zer ba mi gcig med// sngags dang sman yang byed mkhan med// dus dang gnas skabs de tsam na// skyabs 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma la// g.yo sgyu med pa'i mos gus dang*// nad sems su shes pa'i ting 'dzin la// ngas rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa bsten// zhag gsum dro bzhi'i nang par na// mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag

/rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tshan gcig go /zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha bye// gnyis med 'od gsal chen po la// mnyam rjes gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yin nam snyam// las ngan drag po'i mdze nad la// stong pa snying rje'i gdams ngag go /'ur ded chen por yongs su grags// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs 'dra// gong ma'i zhabs tog bya blo skyes// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar bslab// za 'dod 'bog bcol gyi spyod pa yis// sha chang gi tshogs 'khor ma byas pas// 'gro mgon gyi zhabs 'dren ma byas tsam// da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do// da ni rgas kyang mi 'tsher ro// tshan gcig gi tshogs dpon byas na yang*// bu la nye ring ma byas shing*// 'khor ba spang blang ngas ma byas// nor phyir dam chos kyang ma bshad de// ci byed gong ma'i khol po byas// 'dun pas smra ba mang na yang*// tshogs dpon gong ma'i rjes su bslab// skyob pa shākya seng ge yi// bstan pa'i phung 'drer ma song tsam// da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do// da ni rgas kyang mi 'tsher ro// // 25) ༄// chos kun sems nyid mnyam nyid bde chen kyi gsung mgur// chos kun sems nyid dkyil 'khor mnyam nyid bde chen ni// chags dang sdang ba'i 'khrul pa kun 'joms shing*// byams dang snying rje dri med bdud rtsi'i chu brlan 'dzag /skyes chen bla ma rin po che la gtsug gis 'dud// mgon po khyed kyi dgongs pa sgrub byed cing*// 'gro la phan pa'i blo gros mchog mnga' na// dad cing 'dun pas drung du 'khor ba yi// 'khor rnams kun la shin tu zhe sdang zhing*// tshig rtsub mtshon gyis brlag par byed dam ci// chos kyi rgyal po dbang phyug chen po la// sprang pos gcud par byed pa shin tu mdzes// mtshungs med seng ge'i nga ro chen po ni// ri dwags phru gus shin tu bzod par dka'// gdug pa dug sbrul shin tu mi bzad pa'i// drung du gnas pa brlag par nges pa ltar// bdag nyid rigs dang bcas pa thams cad kun// brlag par gyur na dga' sems skye 'am ci// rigs par mi spyod sdug bsngal mtshor gnas pa// gnod cing gdug pa'i 'gro ba bcad byas kyang*// byang chub mchog la 'god par dam bcas nas// phan pa bsgrub pa'i grogs mchog thams cad la// gnod par sems shing ci phyir khro bar byed// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur tshe// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'khur bar dam bcas nas// mtho dman tshig re tsam yang mi bzod cing*// chags sdang phyogs ris byed pa 'di ma 'thad// bde chen byang chub sems kyis bskyed pa'i lus// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba 'di// skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho yi// lus su bsgyur ba rang snying mi rje 'am// snang ba thams cad rang gi bsam pa bas// bden pa'i tshogs kyis rdzun gyi tshogs rnams kun// bskal pa'i me ltar rab tu bsreg byed cing*// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin mchog gnas pas// bde chen 'og min gnas su longs spyod cing*// rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus dag byed pa// dpa' bo chen pos bdud rnams 'joms par mdzad// gnyis su med pa ro mnyam chen po yi// chos las 'byung ba'i skye bo mtho dman rnams// chos kyis skyong zhing mi chos kyis// chos rnams ma lus nyams su myong ba yis// gzhan gyi rgyud rnams byin gyis mi rlob na// ne tso'i wa skad de yis su la phan du re// 'gro bar 'dod pa'i skyes bu sdod pa'i so tshis kyis// rang mgo skor ba shin tu glen pa ste// mu mtha' med pa'i bsod nams rmad byung ba// mnga' bdag chen po'i khrims las ma 'da' zhig

/sdug bsngal sa bon bag chags tshogs rnams kun// mtho dman bya byed rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// slob zhing mnyam nyid ngang du 'dag par mi byed na// thub pa'i dbang pos 'bad pa'i rdo rje theg pa la// tshe gcig mchog gis sangs rgyas ji ltar thob// ngo bo mnyam nyid bde ba chen po thugs chud cing*// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur bdud rtsi yis// 'khor ba'i sa bon sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras rnams// sangs rgyas sku gsum mi zad 'khor lor bsgyur// yul dang dus kyis bskal cing rnam smin zad pa yi// 'brel bar ma gyur mthong tshor med pa la// ting 'dzin bzang por ma blta rnal 'byor pa// // 26)༄// bsam bzhin rang la rang khrel gyi gsung mgur// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems mdzad cing*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// yon tan mtha' dag skyed byed cing*// lhar bcas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// gtsug gi nor bur rab btud cing*// mthong ngam thos sam dran pas kyang*// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// 'gro ba'i mgon po mi dran cing*// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yis// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i gnas// chags sdang phung khrol sna tshogs gzhi// don tu gnyer ba yi re mug /bsam zhing rang la rang zhe khrel// rje bla mas bskyangs pa don re chung*// mtshungs med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku// 'jigs byed khams gsum kun gyi bdag /sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg pa'i me// sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid can// bcom ldan lha yi lhar gyur pa// skyabs gcig yi dam mi dran cing*// bsnyen sgrub don tu mi gnyer bar// log shes 'khrul pa'i blo gros kyis// 'jig rten chos brgyad mtho dman rnams// nyams kyis dogs pa yi re mug /tshe rabs dpag med thams cad du// rjes su bzung ba don re chung*// bsam zhing rang la rang zhe khrel// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// rnyed par dka' ba'i rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi// yon tan rin chen kun gyi gter// 'khor 'das kun gyis mchod gyur pa// stong nyid snying rje mi dran zhing*// goms pa don tu mi gnyer bar// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mo sham bus// chags sdang nam mkha'i me tog gi

/kha dog bzang ngan bltas bltas nas// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi skyes bu de// khams gsum 'khor ba'i g.yang la mchongs// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bos khyer// bsgom zhing zhen pa mi ldog pa// bsam zhing rang la rang re khrel// stong nyid bsgom pa don re chung*// tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas// smon lam gcig tu gyur pa yis// gtan gyi skyid sdug gcig tu gyur// lam chen gcig tu zhugs nas kyang*// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// spun drung rdo rje mched grogs rnams// gtan gyi skyabs mchog dam pa la// snying gtam re ltos mi byed par// phrag dog drag po'i bsam pa yis// rang bas ngan na dga' ba dang*// mi bzad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ru// snying brtse med par khrid byed cing*// mi mthun pa yi phyogs rnams kyis// brtse zhing gdung gdung ltar byed pa// gnyen 'brel bdud kyi dpung rnams la// gtan gyi skyabs mgon 'tshol byed pa// bsam gyin rang la rang re khrel// byas pa chud zos ngo re tsha// skyabs dang bral ba yi re mug /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// rang la dad cing 'dun pa yis// re zhing drung du 'khor gyur cing*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du// khrid par byed pa'i ded dpon tu// re zhing mdun pas bsams nas kyang*// dad pas drung du 'khor pa la// chos dang zang zing thams cad kyis// smin cing grol bar mi byed par// shing kun skye ba'i grong khyer du// kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po yis// gser gyi shing rtas drangs pa yi// rdzas dang yo byad thams cad la// bstod dang bkur bsti thams cad kyis// legs par brgyan nas 'bul ba yi// snyan grags 'jig rten chos brgyad la// ye rngam 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi yis// rang gzhan brlag par byed pa 'di// bla mar bsams pa don re chung*// mang pos bkur ba zhe re khrel// dmyal bar 'gro ba yi re mug

/gzhan la byas pa ma lags te// kha gtam tshig tu brjod nas kyang*// yi ger bris par gyur pa 'dis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// sku gsum yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// rdo rje mched grogs bu spun la// don tu gnyer pa'i blo rnyed nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog// / 27) ༄// byang chub sems kyi go chas thams cad dbang du byed pa'i man ngag/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir ku sā li yi rnal 'byor rnams// brda las byung ba'i rten 'brel gyis// nang gi nyams myong bskyed par byed// byams pa gces phrug mthong na skye// snying rje mdze po'i drung na skye// dga' ba bshes dang phrad na skye// btang snyoms gnyid kyi mtshams su 'ong*// 'jig rten 'khor ba'i nyams myong 'di// goms shing brtan par gyur pa las// mtho ris bde ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas nas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can dang*// dga' ba la sogs rnam pa bzhi// gcig tu gyur pa ngo mtshar che// sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag pas// gnyis su med par sbyangs gyur na// tshad med bzhi dang sems can rnams// gnyis med rnam par dag par 'gyur// spyir byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pa'i// lus ngag yid gsum 'di dag gis// lus ngag yid kyis bsdus pa yi// sems can smin par 'gyur bar nges// yang lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag pas// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum dag par 'gyur// spyir cal col mang po'i kha na med// 'dir mang smras pas ci zhig bya// don gyi snying po gcig las med// gnad du song na gcig gis chog /'gro drug sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// rang nyid thed la btang nas kyang*// rang bas gzhan dag gces pa yis// dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// gzhan gyi don tu ma spyad na// sa bon me yis tshig pa bzhin// theg chen chos la rigs chad yin// lus ngag yid kyi brtson 'grus kyang*// smyon pa rnams kyi lag rjes yin// rang la ltos pa med pa yis// gzhan la phan pa bsgrub pa ni// 'di dang 'di zhes smos pa med// gzhan gyi don du gyur tshad bya// gzhan gyi don tu 'gyur ba ni// sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang*// phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste// bde yang mi phan mi bya'o// de ltar bdag nyid chen po des// sems can nad kyis gdungs mthong na// nad la phan par byed pa'i sman// rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yod nas kyang*// rang gi tshegs la ma ltos par// sems can nad pa gso bar byed// nad pa sos par gyur tsam gyis// chog par blta ba ma yin te// snying nas yon tan bsam byas nas// bstod dang snyan pa'i ngag rnams kyis// bsam pa gcig tu 'dres par bya// snying 'dres dus la bab pa'i tshe// gang zag rigs la brtags nas ni// skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa nas// so sor thar pa'i rigs bdun dang*// mthar thug byang chub mchog la bkod// de ltar gzhan dag smin bya zhing*// chos dang zang zing thams cad kyis// gzhan rgyud smin par byas na yang*// sems nyid 'od gsal dbyings mthong nas// gzung 'dzin gnyis su med rtogs nas// nga 'o ngas byas nga rgyal gyis// gzhan la drin brtsi lan bgrang med// mi bzad gdon gyis nyes pa la// gsang sngags thabs kyi sbyor ba rtsom// mu ge'i 'jigs pas nyen pa'i tshe// bza' btung tshogs kyi sbyin pa gtong*// tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur pa yis// gzhan dag ma rungs gyur mthong na// de dag smin par 'dod pa yis// rang nyid tshul khrims rnam dag pa// dri ma med pa bsrung byed cing*// mgon po shākya'i dbang po la// gsol ba rgyun chad med par 'debs// de ltar sems can smin par ni// bsdu ba bzhi yi tshul gyis byed// bu snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// theg chen mi thub rgyal mtshan gyis// rang gzhan thams cad smin bzhed na// rang gi yus ka mi brtsi bar// rang nyid thed la btang nas kyang*// mtho dman phyogs ris med pa yis// sems can thams cad smin par bya// brgya la gal te re zhig na// nga bdag med par ma rtogs shing*// gzhan la phan pa bskyed pa yis// rang nyid bde bar 'gyur ba yi// rten 'brel zab mo ma go zhing*// bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs chung bas// bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags// phung po la sogs mngon zhen cing*// nyon mongs rtog pa'i dug rgyas nas// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje mched grogs la// gdung sems bral zhing rgyab kyis phyogs// rtsa ba byang chub sems btang nas// spros pa'i mtshan mar rab zhugs te// rang gzhan thams cad phung 'gyur na// gces par byas pa'i phung po dang*// nye du gnyen 'dun yo byad dang*// 'bral bar 'gyur ba'i 'du shes ni// rgyun chad med par goms par bya// snying rje rtsa ba brtan po yis// byang chub sems kyis blangs nas ni// shin tu mi rtag g.yar po yi// lus ngag yid gsum 'di dag gis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// gtan gyi bde ba sgrub par byed// gnas lugs stong pa nyid shes pas// chags shing zhen pa rab spangs pa'i// gdams ngag gong bzhin bsam par bya// mdor na mthon po bzang po dang*// zab pa'i gdams ngag thams cad dang*// nyams rtogs mthon po khas len yang*// byang chub sems kyi go cha yis// rang nyid thed la mi btang na// mthon po bzang po 'ong bar dka'// snying gtam tshig gcig gdams ngag 'di// chen po mthon por bzhugs gyur cing*// thams cad kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas// bla ma dam pa skyu ra la// snying gtam tshig gcig smras pa 'di// dam pa'i phye gtor 'gam bzhed na// snying dang 'dra bar thugs la zhog

/snying gtam tshig gcig gi gdams ngag /'khor 'das thams cad kyi bde skyid kyi 'byung gnas// thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i srog shing*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rten 'brel/ ka ca zang zing gi nor sgrub/ thams cad dbang du byed pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //

28) ༄// skad cig tsam yang mi yengs par nyams len dgos pa'i gsung mgur// na mo rat+na gu ru/ gang tshe dpa' bo shes rab mchog 'di bsgom pa'i tshe// sdig can bdud des shin tu bzod dka' bas// skad cig tsam yang yid ni nur ba'i phyir// phyogs rnams bsreg cing thog gi char pa 'bebs// gdug pa'i gzugs su ston cing mi snyan sgrogs// res 'ga' mdza' bo gnyen bshes pha ma dang*// chung ma bu mo rnams la chags par byed// dug gsum nyon mongs phyogs rnams 'bar bar byed// res 'ga' mkhan slob sangs rgyas gzugs rnams kyis// sbyin dang tshul khrims dad dang brtson 'grus dang*// 'chi dang mi rtag byams dang snying rje 'du shes dgu// lus ngag dge ba zil dang bcas rnams kyis// 'di la spyod ces bar du gcod par byed// res 'ga' 'tsho ba gcod cing zhum par byed// mi rnams dad par byed cing 'du 'dzis g.yeng*// bstod dang snyan grags mthu dang nus pa dang*// dben pa bsten cing zhe rlom khyad gsod dang*// nga rgyal dbang gis lta dang rtogs pa dang*// tshul khrims la sogs snyems par gyur la sogs// mdor na thabs rnams gang gis kyang*// dpa' bo go cha bgos la bar du gcod// de tshe mkhas shing rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// skad cig tsam yang don med mi 'jug la// nyin dang mtshan du ting 'dzin rgyal po sgom// chags dang sdang ba'i yul rnams ma mthong ste// bdag dang bdag 'dzin nam mkha' ji bzhin du// spang dang blang ba'i chos las rnam par grol// chos kun gdod nas stong pa'i rang bzhin la// bzang ngan bdag 'dzin gnyis snang mi 'byung ngo*// 'on kyang dpa' bo thabs la mkhas pa des// sgyu ma'i skyes bus don kun sgrub pa ltar// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su slob// 'gro ba'i don tu spyod pa rlabs chen spyod// tha mal tshig gis sgyid lug mi 'gyur la// nyes pa bsgrag na slob dpon nyid du shes// khe grags tshe 'di'i bsam pa dug ltar spong*// bla ma'i gsung ni brtson pas dang du len// chu bur lta bu'i srog la mi chags na// nyon mongs zad gnyis 'dod 'dun smos ci dgos// shes rab mchog nyid sgom pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'khor 'das rtog pa gang byung bdud du shes// nyin dang mtshan tu zad cing g.yo ba med// mi mthun phyogs kyis skad cig zhum pa med pa dang*// chos phyir srog kyang 'dor zhing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson// gzhan skyon mi lta rang gi yon tan bskung*// nyams rtogs brtson dang dben pas snyems pa med// bla ma dam pa'i gsung las mi g.yo la// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// thams cad bdud du gyur kyang ci zhig bya// rang gzhan don kun sgrub pa'i skyes bu bas// 'grang gcig zas la brtson 'grus ci dgos dgos// mi rtag 'jig pa'i lus la su zhig btsa'// bde chen khang bzang spongs la me mur bor// 'khrul ba'i dbang du ma 'gro rang nyid phung*// bla ma 'phags pas 'phyas na thang dgu shi// bya ba gtong bar rigs so skyes bu rnams// rang la snying rje ma spong rgyal ba'i sras// gang phan bsam mno thongs shig rigs kyi bu// tshe 'di'i bsam pa byung na dug sdong yin// zas nor 'dun pa skyes na yi dwags yin// yid kyis rgyal srid bsams na rang phung yin// grogs dang bla 'o mang na bdud du che// nye 'brel 'khras 'khris

bral mi nus pa yod na byur du che// mkhos med brnyas pa'i gnas ni yon tan mchog /nyin mtshan kha sbyar sgom dang mos gus yin// yid kyi 'gyu ba zad na bla ma mnyes// sang bya gnang bya rang gis rang nyid bslus// sgom tshe dga' blo byung yang sdig can bdud// 'dod 'dun gnyid dbang song na ra mda' chos// stan la tsher ma byung na gsol ba thob// sgo lnga phyal bar song na brtan pa chug /rin chen stor ro mel tshe drag tu gyis// don med skad cig song yang dgra bo yin// de ring do nub 'chi yang shes sam ci// da lta da lta rings par don tu gnyer// 'dod pa rnams ni phung ba bskyed pa ste// mkhas pa rnams kyis spangs pa'i gnas yin no// snying nas rang la snying rje lta na 'bungs// thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas// dus 'di bar du bde btsal yang*// da rung bde la rgyab kyis phyogs// da res sdug bsngal dang du longs// mthu sgrub mdze po mi nyal na// thar pa sgrub pa su zhig nyal// da lta'i skad cig mi rtag na// sang bya gnang bya su zhig sems// bla ma dam pa'i spyan snga 'dir// cung zhig ma 'dzoms dbang gis kyang*// gtan du rlog byed mel tshe sgrims// kye ma kyi hud sdug re bsngal// tsha rtsub bzod dka' blangs nas ni// bde chen thar pa rgyab kyis phyogs// 'di 'dra su yis bzod par nus// kye ho dam pa rin po che// rje btsun bdag gi ra mda' mdzod// 'gras 'dris khe drags spangs nas ni// 'jig rten blun pos brnyas pa'i gnas// skad cig tsam yang mi g.yeng bar// bdag gis nyams su len par mdzod// skyes pa'i dad pa kha la yod// bud med kyi dad pa phongs na yod// khyed bod kyi dad pa ngu re bro// ku re'i dad pa skyug re bro// // 29)༄// bdud bzhi g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo'i go cha bgo ba'i gsung mgur// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nyon mongs gdug pa'i 'byung gnas las// bsam pa tsam gyis myur du sgrol mdzad cing*// bde ba chen po gnyis med rin chen thob mdzad pa'i// hūm̐ mdzad hūm̐ gis bdud 'joms bla ma 'dir dran bya// gdug pa'i skye bos gsod pa yi// shin tu zhim pa'i kha zas la// bag phebs za zhing gang chags pa// gdug pa'i sems kyis bzung nas kyang*// myur du srog dang bral ba ltar// chags sdang rtog pa 'thad pa la// chags shing sdang bar gang byed pa// chags sdang bdud kyis bzung nas kyang*// ngan song gsum du gsod par nges// chags dang sdang ba'i yul rnams kun// rang blo chags sdang rnam rtog tu// rang gis rang ngo ma shes na// 'khrul pa'i skye bo yus kyis brnangs// me long byad kyi gzugs brnyan la// chags sdang byed pa'i byis pa rnams// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// nam yang bde ba mi bskyed pa// rmongs pa khyod kyis ma go 'am// chags sdang nyon mongs bag chags kyis// 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du// ngan song gsum po 'byin nges te// byams dang snying rje'i bag chags kyis// stobs 'phel byin gyis brlabs gyur kyang*// 'dod khams lha yi bsod nams dang*// bde skyid longs spyod dbang thang kun// 'di dang phyi ma bar dor yang*// 'byung bar 'gyur ba chos nyid de// 'di la chags shing rlom pa dang*// ro myong gnas par gang byed pa// bde ba'i 'bras bu zad nas kyang*// nga rgyal rlom pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur// ru tra gsum du nges par skye// nga rgyal nga sdug nga bsngal zhes// 'o dod 'bod pa'i dmyal bar 'gyur// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog pa'i// nyams kyi bag chags stobs 'phel na// 'di dang phyi ma bar dor yang*// gzugs dang gzugs med lha rnams dang*// bde skyid nyams su myong bar nges// chags shing zhen pa'i zhen stobs kyis// 'bral mi phod kyang 'bral ba de// byas pa'i dbang gis mi rtag yin// 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ma rig pa// snyam tsam lta ba'i bye brag rnams// mthar thug 'bras bur 'dod na yang*// blo nyid byas la mi rtag pas// ji srid gnyen po byung gi bar// spang byar 'gro ba chos nyid yin// bdag 'dzin rtogs pa'i gser 'gyur rtsis// 'khor ba chos skur ma gyur na// da rung spang bya gnyen por 'gyur// spang bya gnyen po yod ring la// thug pa med pa'i chos skus kyang*// ha cang mgo thon dka' bas na// blo yi yul tu ma gyur pa// 'khor 'das kun gyi gshis nyid la// nam yang 'gyur ba med par bya// 'gyur med sems kyi gshis nyid dang*// skad cig tsam yang bral ba na// bag chags rtog pa bdud du ldang*// bdud kyi dmag dpung chen po la// dmag dpon nges pa ma mchis te// res 'ga' chags sdang rtog pas byed// res 'ga' byams dang snying rjes byed// res 'ga' ting 'dzin nyams kyis byed// res 'ga' nad dang gnod pas byed// dmag dpon ral gris ske bcad nas// mi bzad bdud kyi dmag dpung gis// sha rus dum bur byas nas kyang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// sdug bsngal chen po'i shugs kyis za// kye rang la snying rje yod pa rnams// da res bdud kyi dmag dpung las// cis kyang rang cag rgyal bar bya// sems nyid rang byung dpa' bo yis// gnyis med rdo rje'i go bgos nas// byang chub sems kyi lcags kyu thogs// gnyis med rtogs pa'i ral gri bzung*// bag chags rtog pa'i bdud dpung rnams// byams dang snying rje'i zas la brid// gnyis med rdo rje'i ra bar gzhug

/mi bzad bdud kyi dmag dpon gyi// snying khar lcags kyus btab nas kyang*// sngar gyi ral gris ske ba bcad// dmag dpung chen po bsad nas kyang*// mgo bo bcad pa'i phreng ba rnams// dpa' bo chen po'i rgyan du byas// bdud bzhi rtog pa'i sha khrag rnams// gnyis su med pa'i ngang nyid du// bde ba chen po'i shugs kyis zos// bag chags rtog pa'i bdud dpung gi /rang bzhin rus pa'i tshogs rnams kun// dpa' bo chen po'i rgyan du byas// bdud bzhi'i stobs 'joms dpa' bo des// rngam pa'i nga ro 'di skad ces// 'khor 'das thams cad nga yin te// nga las 'di dag thams cad med// nga rgyal gtum po'i tshig smras nas// dpa' chen rang gi ngang du gnas// dpa' bo chen po'i sgrub thabs 'di// dpa' chen gang gis sgrub gyur na// bdud bzhi'i bag chags stobs bcom nas// 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur// // 30) ༄// rtogs ldan gyi gegs sel bogs 'don ston pa grags pa rgyal po'i zhu chos// gnyis su 'dzin pa nam mkha'i pad+mo 'khor 'das su// rang gi sems la brtags shing 'khrul par gyur pa yis// byis pa log par ltung rnams gnas lugs bstan pa yis// smin cing grol mdzad rang byung bla ma mchog la 'dud// skyon yon rtogs pa lta ba// de la ma yengs sgom pa// de yi skyon yon gnyis ka /'dag pa las sam spyod pa// dag tsam gang yin 'bras bu// rtogs ldan rnams la de smra// brtse ba chen pos 'gro kun smin par bya ba'i phyir// bla ma'i byin rlabs bag tsam sems la zhugs pa des// phyogs ris med par kun la byin par gyur pa yis// bsod nams mchog des 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /mdor sdus te rgyas par bshad pa zhes bya ba/ nyams su myong ba dang mngon par rtogs pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi gegs sel dang bogs 'don gyi gdams ngag shākya'i dge slong rin chen dpal la/

ston pa grags pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa rdzogs so// // 31) ༄// snying rje chen po'i bstan bcos glang chen rol ba// mnyam nyid gdod nas dag pa sems kyi gshis// byang chub chen po lhun grub de bzhin nyid// 'dus ma byas shing spros pa'i mtha' las 'das// bla ma byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes shing*// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa la// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mo sham bus// chags sdang gnyis kyi mtshon thogs nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// rang dbang med par ske ba breg /phan zhing bde ba'i skabs med cing*// mgon dang skyabs dang bral ba yi// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can la// snying rje chen po mi skye na// theg chen chos la rigs chad yin// snying rje chen po'i mtshan nyid ni// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras bcom pa ste// rgyu bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa// 'od gsal rtogs pa'i nyi ma yis// ma rig mun pa gsal byas nas// 'di dang po skyes pa'i snying rje yin// rtogs pa'i 'od gsal goms pa yis// chags sdang shugs kyis dag gyur pa// 'di snying rje chen po gnyis pa yin// 'od gsal goms pa'i yon tan gyis// tshogs gnyis ngang gis rdzogs gyur pas// sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa de// mthar thug snying rje chen po yin// mi shes 'khrul pa'i dbang song ba// byis pa rnams kyi snying rje ni// zhe 'dod rtog pa'i bsam pa yis// chags sdang 'dod pa bsgrubs byas kyang*// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'bras bur smin// phan pa bas kyang gnod pa che// bu de 'dra'i snying rje dug dang 'dra// zhen pa'i snying rje dug 'dra bas// mkhas pa rnams kyis spangs nas kyang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'ang sangs rgyas pa// gong ma rnams kyi gshegs shul mchog /'khor 'das gnyis kyi srog gcig pu// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas gtso// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje 'di// yul dang yul can gnyis med de// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes des// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kyi// gnyis su 'dzin pa'i sdug bsngal gcod// skye 'gag spros pa'i mtha' las 'das// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// skye rga na 'chi chu bo bzhi// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings rnams kyi// sdug bsngal skye 'gag spros pa 'joms// kun rdzob dmigs pa'i snying rje yis// sems can ma lus thams cad kun// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yis// go cha snying stobs chen po yang*// dmus long dmigs bu med pa yis// bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// gzhan gyi long khrid byed dang mtshungs// dmigs med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i blo med kyang*// gnyis su med pa'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// ma rig mun pa sel bar byed// ye shes dri ma med pa'i dbyings// gdod nas lhun grub de bzhin nyid// rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po'i sku// rang sems rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// bstan bcos glang chen rol ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so//

// 32) ༄// ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo don gyi gnad bsdus te gsungs pa// skyob mdzad 'jig rten gsum gyi dri ma kun spangs pa// spros dang bral ba rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i sku// ye shes mtha' yas yon tan kun gyis legs brgyan pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyis legs par rab gsungs pa// ting 'dzin rgyal po don gyi gnad bsdus pa// mnyam med bla ma mchog gis bstan pa 'bri bar bya// ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dran byas shing*// dad dang gus pas spyi bo'i gtsug gis bkur// bdag nyid snying rje chen po'i gdung shugs kyis// thub pa'i bstan pa tshul khrims gzung byas shing*// kun tu bzang po nags tshal dam par ni// snyigs ma'i dus na rnal 'byor sems bsgom bya// mi bzad gnod pa'i tshogs las bzod bya zhing*// sdom pa rin chen gsum dang 'bral mi bya// 'jig rten mgon pos ting 'dzin rgyal po ni// lus ngag yid kyi sdom pa rnam dag pas// ngo bo nyid stong rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// dpag med chos rnams de nyid rnam rig na// de la nam yang sdom pa med mi 'gyur// 'di ltar des ni yang dag nges par rtogs// ting 'dzin rgyal por shākya seng ges gsungs// lus kyi sdom pa lus kyis bsdus pa rnams// 'od gsal skye ba med pa rab rtogs pas// lus dang bral ba'i yon tan dpag med pa// mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs thob pa dang*// srog gcod la sogs lus kyi sgrib pa'i tshogs// sangs rgyas sku la sgrib pa thams cad kun// bdag med rtogs pas thams cad byang 'gyur zhes// 'jig rten mgon po shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs// ngag gi sdom pa brjod du med pa ni// bstod smad la sogs skye bar med rtogs na// ngag gis bsdus pa'i sgrib pa 'dag pa dang*// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu la sogs pa// sangs rgyas gsung gi yon tan ma lus pa// stong nyid dbang gis thams cad thob 'gyur zhes// 'jig rten mgon po shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs// sems nyid spros dang bral zhing ma skyes pa// sems kyi sdom pa dri ma med pa ni// rgyal sras gang gis rtag tu bsgoms nas ni// brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba dang*// mi dge 'di las 'byung ba'i lus ngag gi

/mi dge bdun po mngon 'gyur rags pa dang*// de las byung ba'i nad dang sdug bsngal dang*// ngan song gsum dang mtha' med 'khor ba rnams// ting 'dzin rgyal po sdom pa mchog 'di yis// nyon mongs las gyur skyon rnams dag gyur cing*// lha dang mi yi gnas skabs bde ba dang*// 'phags pa rnams kyi yon tan ci yod dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan dpag med rgya mtsho rnams// sems nyid rnam par dag las nges 'byung zhes// mgon po sras dang bcas pas legs gsungs pas// sangs rgyas gsungs la 'bad pas nan tan bya// snying rje chen pos 'jug cing bya ba ni// byis pa rnams kyis lkog tu phan pa ni// sems can rnams dang rang bzhin dbyer med pa// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa rtag tu goms pa yis// rang gzhan thams cad dbyer med 'od gsal du// ro gcig gyur pas sdug bsngal bral gyur cing*// zag med bde ba chen po rgyas mdzad pa'i// mkhas pa chen po ci phyir snying rje med// de phyir 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// dbang po rab tu 'di las gsungs// mnyam par bzhag pa'i chos nyid la// chos kun stong par rtogs na yang*// gzhan la snying brtse'i bag chags kyis// rjes thob sgyu ma ltar rtogs pas// mnyam par bzhag pa'i gces spras kyis// ri khrod dgon pa bsten par mdzad// snying rje chen po'i bag chags kyis// gzhan don spros pa'i lam la 'jug /gnyis med thugs rje chen po la// gzhan don spros pa ma chod pas// ri dwags lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// dbang po 'bring por gsungs pa yin// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor ltung ba la// thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas// byang chub sems kyi go bgos te// byang chub sems kyi sdom pa yis// sems can smin par mdzad pa ni// rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// gzung 'dzin spros pa gcod pa yis// byis pa rnams la mngon mtshan gyis// phan dang bde ba sgrub pa ni// dbang po tha mar gsungs pa yin// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po ches// ting 'dzin rgyal po'i don bsdus pa'o//

33) ༄// phyag chen gyi rim pa sgom pa grags pa rdo rje la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// bde legs kun gyi gter gyur pa// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// bsags pa rab gyur dam pa khyod// 'khor ba'i bde 'bras thams cad la// dug gi sdong po ltar gzigs nas// thub pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// mos gus las 'phro sad pa yis// dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi yis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang nas// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don ched du// sgrub pa gtsor mdzad dam pa khyed// 'jig rten mgon po sprul pa'i sku// skyob mdzad bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs la dad gyur pa// tshig tshogs spros pas ma bslad cing*// tshong 'dus 'o mar ma song ba// dam pa'i gdams ngag bzhed lags na// dang po 'chi ba mi rtag pa// dran cing bsgom pa shin tu gces// chos 'di rgyud la ma skyes na// dam pa bzang por khas len kyang*// don gyi 'jig rten 'di ma yin// des na skyes bu dam pa khyed// 'jig rten spros pa rab bcad nas// sgrub la nan tan gtsor mdzad zhu// sgrub pa byed pa'i dus kyi tshe// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bstan pa'i gzhi mar gyur pa ni// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa yin// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// tshul khrims bsrung bar mi byed na// rang nyid ngan song sdug bsngal las// thar bar byed pa'i mthu med cing*// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus pas na// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// lhag pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa 'di// srog dang mig 'bras bzhin du srung*// tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu yis// lha mi'i go 'phang thob na yang*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho yin// 'khor ba sdug bsngal du ma shes na/ /spang blo'i sems pa mi 'byung bas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las// yid smon spangs nas thar pa bsgrub// thar pa mya ngan 'das pa yi// zhi bde bdag nyid gcig pu yis// ro myong gzhan dag mi dran pa// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas yin pas// theg pa dman pa'i sems spangs nas// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// byams dang snying rje'i bsam pa yis// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// smon 'jug gnyis kyi bslab bya la// nan tan chen pos bslab par zhu// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// pha rol phyin drug nyams su blangs// bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs// dka' ba dpag tu med pa yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa yang*// ha cang yun ring dka' bas na// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob pa ni// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa na// de yi rjes su 'brang bar bya// dben zhing nyams dga'i sa phyogs su// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// smin lam rin chen dbang bzhi zhu// dam tshig nyes skyon spangs nas kyang*// shin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su// 'bol ba'i stan gting skyil krung bca'// bsam gtan yan lag kun byas nas// mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rang rgyud sbyangs nas bskyed rdzogs sgom// mtshan ma can gyi bskyed rdzogs ni// gzugs sku gnyis kyi rgyu yin kyang*// mthar thug chos sku mi thob pas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul mchog

/grub thob gong mas nyams blangs shing*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying ni// sems nyid phyag rgya chen po yin// de yang rdo rje gzeb chen las// skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgya'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa dang*// rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa nas// dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// de skad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// 'jig rten mgon po til+lis kyang*// rang rig pa'i de nyid 'bras bur ni// til+li nga yis bstan pa yin// zab mo gsung du gsungs pas na// rang sems phyag rgya chen po bsgom// lar yid la byed dang mi byed dang*// skye ba yod med rnam rtog yin// sgrims dang glod pa thams cad kyis// bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan gang yin yang*// lha gnas gong mar gol 'gyur bas// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// skad cig nyid la mngon sum bya// rtogs pa'i ye shes zab mo ni// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// las 'phro can gyis rtogs pa yin// byin rlabs kyi lam la gnas pa yin// blo yi yul las 'das pa yin// rtog ge ba yi spyod yul min// des na dam pa khyed nyid kyis// rang sems bsgom la nan tan zhu// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// bka' stsal gsung sgros zab mo 'di// yi ger bri bar mi 'os kyang*// dam pa khyed kyis bskul gyur pas// 'gal 'khrul nor ba ci mchis pa// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis// bzod pa dam pa mdzad du gsol// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu pa rin chen dpal gyis// sgom pa grags pa rdo rje la springs pa rdzogs so//

// 34) ༄// mi chos bcu drug dang lha chos gnad gcig bstan pa// bde chen rang byung dri med byang chub sems// smon 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i rgyan thogs nas// tshul lugs bzhi dang rten 'brel zab mo yis// mi zad rin chen 'khor lo bsgyur la 'dud// de la spyir sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po skems shing*/ bde skyid gnas skabs dang mthar thug pa thob par 'dod pas/ mi chos dang lha dam gnyis la bsten dgos/ de la mi chos kyi go ba ni/ sngon las dge ba bcu'i steng du/ phar shes pa dang*/ mar shes pa dang*/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram zer shes pa dang*/ rigs kyi nang na rgan pa la rim gro byed pa dang*/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang bcu drug la mi chos bcu drug ste/ de spyad pas mi'i lus thob pa dang*/ yang de dang mthun par spyod pa ni tshul lugs bzhi ste/ rje'i zhabs nas 'degs pa/ chos kyi rgyal po rje dkon mchog gsum gyi rten khyad par can rnams dang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la phyag dang gus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas mchod pa/ mnga' bdag ral pa can nam/ mi nyag gi rgyal po lta bu'o// dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod pa ni/ sngon ma 'gyur ba'i chos bsgyur ba dang*/ dam pa rnams srog las phangs par byed cing*/ phyogs thams cad nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu lta bur byed pa'o// phur ma'i zla srong ba ni/ bdag nyid kyang dkar po dge ba'i phyogs thams cad kyis rgyas par byed cing gzhan dag kyang de la 'god pa dang*/ rang dang mthun par spyod pa thams cad la dga' bas phan tshun du skyes bskur zhing*/ phyogs gcig tu 'gro ba la phan 'dogs pa rgyal bu kun tu dge dang*/ rgyal po gsal rgyal lta bu'o// ngan long gi rad pa gnon pa ni/ rang dang mi mthun pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa rnams phyogs thams cad nas rang gi 'khor du gcod cing*/

mi mthun par spyod na chad pa'i las byed pa'o// tshul de ltar dus rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs pas/ nam shi ba'i dus na rang gi bag chags de rnams stobs su gyur pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye rgyal ba'i zhal mthong*/ stong pa dang snying rje sangs rgyas kyi sgos chos sems skye ba med pa yang mthong bar srid de/ des kyang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i rgyur 'gro ba'o// spyir mi chos lha dam gang yang rung*// byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis// zhe 'dod med par 'gro ba rnams// bsdu ba rnam bzhis ma bskyangs par// gzhan pas rang mtho 'dod pa rnams// phrag dog drag po'i bsam pa yis// zas nor god kar btang na yang*// ma skyes dgra yi spre'u bzhin du// dgos pa'i dus su stongs pa dka'// rang gi kha dang gzhan gyi snying*// dug dang bdud rtsi brje 'dod rnams// snang ba rang snang ma go 'am// kwa legs par dgongs dang 'dun ma mkhan// bsod nams kyi tshogs dang phan pa'i sems// gnyis po med pa'i gang zag la// rang dbang med pa ma mthong ngam// srid la brkam pa'i skyes bu yis// spun dang nye 'brel bsad tsam na// rang srog chad cing phung ba mthong*// tshe 'di'i blo gros btang tsam na// tshe 'di lhun gyis grub pa mthong*// byang chub sems kyi stobs 'phel na// rang don gzhan don 'grub bo zhes// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas gsungs// mi chos kyi mdun ma gzhir bzhag nas// lha dam nyams su len lags na// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// sangs rgyas 'du shes bzhag nas kyang*// zab mo'i dbang bzhi bskur tsam na// tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum brje// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// gnas 'gyur gyi sku zhes gsungs pa yin// kwa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams// rang srog gcod pa'i dgra bo la// ye shes kyi lha ru ma re bar// 'jig rten gyi bde skyid rgyab tu bor// 'jig rten las 'das 'byung bar des// mi chos kyi mdun ma thal nas kyang*// lha dam nyams su len bzhed na// gzhi sems gsum dag pa'i gser 'gyur rtsis// tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum 'di// zag med kyi gter chen dam par bsgyur// dri med byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la// nam yang dus gsum bskal par bgrangs pa med// de ni 'gro ba rnams la rab tu 'jug

/zhugs pas 'gro rnams de ru 'dren par byed// tshe gcig khyod kyis gang rnams thob gyur pa// byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig bsam yas pa// bskal pa khrag khrig byang chub sngon spyod pa// de dag gis kyang phun sum 'di ma rnyed// 'di rnams thams cad mos pa'i 'bras bu ste// brtson 'grus bsam pa ngag ni de bzhin no// spyod pa thams cad smon lam 'byung ba yin// chos rnams thams cad mos las yongs su 'byung*// nor bzang de ltar khyod kyis yongs bsgrub la// rtag tu khyad par yod par bcol bar gyis// klu yi bsam pa ji snyed byung gyur pa// de snyed char pa yongs su 'bab par 'gyur// smon lam ye shes spyod yul ji snyed pa// de snyed byang chub spyod las rgyas par 'gyur// /// 35) ༄// chos rang rgyud la 'byor bar nyams len gsha' ma byed dgos pa// pha mnyam med brtse chen 'gro ba'i mgon// rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi la// mi zad ha la'i dug sdong skyes// bdag bsam pa dkar yang sbyor ba gnag /bsam sbyor gcig tu ma song bas// phan pa'i lan tu gnod pa skyel// zhe sdang dug gi sdong po 'di// snying rje'i ye shes me 'bar na// theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin// 'dod chags gdug pa'i dug mtsho 'di// ma chags bdud rtsi'i rol mtshor bsgyur// 'di theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin// gti mug ma rig mun pa 'di// gnyis med 'od gsal chen por bsgyur// 'di theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin// rkyen mi mthun pa dang phrad tsam na// sems drag po gsum gyis bcom gyur na// rgyud tshod mthon po'i rdzun po yin// chos par bcos kyang gzhan gyis khrel// bzang po zer yang ngo lkog pas// kwa yar la sems pa'i skyes bu khyed// nga che nga bzang nga mtho yis// gong ma khyad du gsod pa de// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsnubs par ni// rgyal bas sdong po bkod par gsungs// nga bdag zad na rgyud mtho yin// sems gsum rgyas na rgyud bzang yin// nyon mongs choms na btsun po yin// smra ba mang na 'chal ba yin// phyi rol snang ba gang snang yang*// rang sems snang ba ma gtogs pa// gzhan du med par mkhas pas gsungs// byams snying rje 'byongs pa'i gang zag la// cir snang pha dang mar snang yang*// ngan 'gro'i srid pa bkag nas kyang*// dga' ldan gnas su 'gro ba de// gzhan gyis ma byas rang sems yin// bskyed rim brtan pa'i gang zag rnams// snang srid lha dang lha mor shar// tha mal snang ba 'gags nas kyang*// rdo rje 'chang gi zhing khams su// gnyis med sgom pa ngo mtshar che// rtogs pa skyes pa'i skyes chen la// snang srid thams cad chos skur shar// mtshan ma'i dngos po rang sar zhi// skye med 'od gsal chos sku dang*// gnyis su med pa ngo mtshar che// rang sems thul cig dam pa khyed// kwa mtho sar bsdad pa'i kha spyad mkhan// khru gang sa la nges pa med// bdud kyi phye gtor ma 'gams sam// dug gsum gyi tshogs dpon ma byas sam// mar khrid kyi ded dpon ma mdzad dam// long gtam gyi 'dred la ma 'gred dam// zhim g.yos kyi thab chung ma byas sam// gong ma'i mos gus ma shor ram// pha phogs dgra la ma bskur ram// 'khor la mngon zhen ma ches sam// sman snod dug gis ma bkang ngam// rang nyid dpang du tshugs lags sam// 'phags pa ka ta ya na ltar// dus rgyun chad med pa'i bya ra zhig

/rang gi sems la ma byas na// nga khyod mtho dman gyi tshig rnams kyis// shan shun phye zhing skur ba btab// gnyis snang gi spu ris gsal tu btang*// chags sdang gi dug chen khong du spar// bzang 'dod kyi kha tsho phyogs bcur bsgrags// khe grags gnyis la so nam byas// bu rang la snying rje ma chung ngam// chos dang rang rgyud ma 'byor na// bshad bshud mang po ngo re tsha// gcig tu 'dres na gzhan gyis go /rang sems rang gis ma thul na// tshig ngan phog thug ngan smras kyis// gzhan la brgyab pas rang sems bsnad// stong nyid snying rjes rang gzhan bde// 'ub kyis hril gyis dril lags na// bde chen gyi ngang las ma 'gul cig /spyir da lta'i dus su dam pa'i chos// rang gi sems la ma byas na// byas lo dang byed lo mang po yis// rang gzhan gnyis kyi mgo bskor yang*// 'chi ba'i dus su ya re nga*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab// ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod re dka'// cis kyang 'ong ba yi re mug /rnam rtog yin pas spang re dka'// da res dus kyi nyi ma la// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma bzlog na// stes dbang rang dgas ga la bzlog /lus sha'i mtho yor 'di 'jig par nges// 'di yi kha tshis ma che bar// le lo ngan la ma zhen par// dus ring po zhig gi so nam de// skad cig nyid la zin par bya// mi nus kyi gces ka ma che bar// stong pa nyid dang snying rje mchog /rgyud ldan gyi gdams ngag rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul mchog /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// tshig tshogs spros pas ma bslad pa// tshong dus kyi 'o mar ma song bar// nyams rtogs gnyis med kyis rang sems la// ltem rkyang med par shugs kyis bsgom// rang sems rdo rje bsgom tsam na// gnyis 'dzin gyi spros pa rbad kyis chad// re dogs kyi rtsol sgrub lhun gyis zhi// zhe 'dod kyi mdud pa shugs kyis grol// bdag med thang la phyal gyis 'gro// gnyis 'dzin gyi 'ja' tshon mkha' la yal// rtog pa'i 'byung 'jug sprin ltar dwangs// lhun grub rgyal ba'i khang bzang du// spros med gnyug ma'i skyes bu de// blo 'das kyi stan la skyil krung bca'// gzung 'dzin spangs pa'i lag pa bsnol// mnyam pa nyid kyi sgal tshigs srang*// gnyis snang med pa'i spyan mig phab// smra bsam brjod 'das kyis gtong mgo mnan// mos gus kyi to pyi dbu la gsol// 'gyur med 'od gsal chos sku las// g.yo ba med pa'i bsam gtan bya// chos brgyad 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi yis// g.yo zhing bskyed par 'gyur re skan//

36) ༄// thar pa bsgrub par bzod pa'i go cha dgos pa khros pa'i nga rgyal zab mo// na mo rat+na gu ru/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*// bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo// gtso bo phan sems yod pa'i mi gcig pu la yang mi thams cad byams par 'gyur na/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher ci ste mi 'gyur bas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la bskyed par bya ba dang*/ dngos po phran tshegs gtong ba'i mis kyang bya ba rlabs po che 'grub na/ thams cad la chags pa med par gtong ba'i bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub pa lta ga la srid pas/ rten sa bzang po rten cing dngos po gang la yang ma chags par gtong ba dang*/ ya rab kyi tshul lugs mi chos kyi rnam gzhag zhad tsam yod pa'i mi yang mang po'i rgyan tu 'gyur na/ nyon mongs pa spong ba'i bsam pa brtan pos/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' bzhin tshul khrims rin po che bsrungs pa'i mi de 'jig rten thams cad kyis rgyan du ci ste mi 'gyur bas/ spong ba'i sems pas lus dang srog la yang ltos pa med par tshul khrims la nan tan tu bya ba dang*// mi dbul po kha cig tsha grang gi sdug bsngal la ma bltas par so nam dang khe bogs la 'bad pas/ phyug pa dang bde ba dang skyid par 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu la/ dka' ba dang sdug bsngal bzod pa'i go cha chen pos nyams su blangs na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi yon tan ci ste mi 'byung bas/ bzod pa'i go cha chen po bgos nas nyams su blang ba la 'bad pa dang*/ zha ba dang long ba'i mi yang 'bad pa dang rtsol sgrub kyis yul sna tshogs rgyu zhing 'dod pa'i don bsgrub par byed na/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi phyag bzhes/ brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi nyams len/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag rin po che la brtson 'grus kyi shugs drag pos nyams su blangs na/ yon tan ci ste yang mi 'byung bas/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la 'bad pa drag pos nyams su blang ba dang*/ phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi bsam gtan/ 'jig rten gyi dmigs pa la yang sems rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs na/ thun mong gi dngos grub rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa thams cad kyang 'byung na/ gong ma khyad par du 'phags pa thams cad kyis nyams su blangs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad bskyed pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bsam pa la sems rtse gcig tu goms par byas na/ bsam pa stobs 'phel ba'i rang gzugs su ci ste yang mi 'gyur bas/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bsam pa la sems rtse gcig tu goms par bya ba dang*/ bzo rig pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi shes rab phra mos kyang rang gzhan mang po la bde bar nus na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs 'byung 'khor bar skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ gnas par byed ba'i gzhi/ 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen shes pa dang*/ rten 'brel gyi gshis nyid spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad kyis stong pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs shing khong du chud pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher ci ste yang mi 'gyur bas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing bden pa gnyis kyi don khong du chud par bya ba dang*/ 'khor yug dang bcas pa'i ri'i rgyal po lhun po yang mi rtag cing 'jig na/ rnam par rtog pa mi rtag pas byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun chad med par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma bsngos na/

mi zad cing rtag pa lta ga la yang srid pas/ dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// ༈ //'di ltar dpa' chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// rang gzhan don kun grub pa de// rgyu lam log pas mi 'grub ste// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yi// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// pha rol phyin drug nyams blangs te// byang chub mchog tu bsngos nas kyang*// 'khor gsum dag pa'i rtogs pa yis// sa bcu yon tan 'khor lo ltar// rgyun chad med par skor nas kyang*// lhun grub rgyun chad med pa yi// sangs rgyas sku gsum rmad byung ba// rang la grub par gyur pa 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// zla ba lta bur dag cing bsil gyur pa// thugs kyi bcud phyung snying po dam pa 'di// yi ger bris pas kun la grags gyur cing*// sangs rgyas sku gsum 'bras bu thob par shog /khros pa'i nga rgyal zab mo rdzogs so// // 37) ༄// rgyu med 'bras bu gang las 'byung zhes pa bstan pa// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i phyir// bsam gyis mi khyab bsod nams tshogs chen rab bsags pa// ye shes rdo rjes sgrib pa ma lus bcom nas dag cing dbyer med pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma rin po che la gtsug gis 'dud// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos// rgyu 'bras bsam pas phyir shar te// skad cig nyid la smin gyur cing*// rgyu 'bras nyid la spyod pa la// bdud dbang song zhing mig med pa'i// tshig gi rjes su 'brangs pa rnams// rgyu 'bras smin pa mi mthong bas// dus ring po gcig la bsam pa yin// kun slong sbyor ba'i gser 'gyur rtsis// dngos gzhir gyur pa'i bye brag ni// spro dang yi mug khyad par gyis// byang chub mchog la 'jug pa dang*// skyon dang yon tan gnyis kas kyang*// mi zad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ru// mi 'dod bzhin du dbang med par// rtag tu sdug bsngal myong ba rnams// kun slong bsam pa'i khyad par yin// chos can kun rdzob bden pa 'di// thub pa'i gzugs sku rnam gnyis te// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// phrin las byang chub sems las byung*// gdul bya'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa'i// khams dang bag la nyal sems la// bsam gyis mi khyab sku gsung thugs// rgyu las byung bar thub pas gsungs// byang chub sems dang bsod nams tshogs// sa bon so sor gang btab rnams// dpyid dang dbyar ston dus bzhin du// rtogs pa'i ye shes rdo rje yi// ci tsam sgrib gsum spangs pa bzhin// 'bras bu 'byin cing gnyis med pas// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te// gzung 'dzin bag chags sgrib pa rnams// gnyis med ye shes rdo rjes bcom pa las// tshogs gnyis sku gsum rgyu 'bras te// bcom nas med pa gang du bshad// rgyu med 'bras bu gang las byung*// kwa legs par dgongs dang skyes bu rnams// kun la bzla pa ma lags te// stong par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod byed cing*// gol ba'i lam du bzhugs pa la// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bstan pa yin//
