// 38) ༄// stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ba dbyer med byang chub ngo mtshar che zhes pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ mtho dman bag chags sna tshogs kun// sgom ro gcig rtogs na lhongs pa yin// lhongs rgyu gong du bsags pa yin// dge dang mi dge rnam rtog rnams// ji ltar rgyud la skyes pa ltar// bde sdug 'bras bu smin nas mchi// des na grub thob gong ma rnams// byang chub sems dang bsod nams tshogs// sngon du 'gro bar bstan pa yin// sngon 'gro sa bon bag chags de// gnyis su med pa'i dus su sad// gnyis med ro gcig chen po la// stong pa nyid kyi phyogs ris dag /stong nyid rgyu dang 'bras bur shar// stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med de// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi// zung du 'jug ces bya ba yin// zung 'jug 'dzin pa rnam dag pas// sku gsum dbyer med phyag rgya che// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos// dbyer med byang chub ngo mtshar che// // 39) ༄// chos tshul gting dpog min 'dri ba'i gsung mgur// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs la gtsug gis gus pas 'dud// bu theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi// dbang dang dam tshig go lags sam// gnas 'gyur sangs rgyas sku gsum la// nges pa'i shes pa skyes lags sam// tha mal chags sdang gnyis snang de// sku gsum zung du chud lags sam// bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i yus po che// rang nyid yin par go lags sam// mnyam rjes med pa'i kha tsho can// nyams rtogs goms su 'jug shes sam// rten 'brel rtogs pa'i nga 'o can// rnam shes ye shes go lags sam// thabs lam gdams ngag che ba kun// rlung sems gnyis med go lags sam// nga che nga bzang gi sgom chen kun// che thabs bzang thabs go lags sam// dar zab kyis brgyan pa'i rje btsun pa// tshul khrims kyi rgyan dang ma bral lam// 'di ku re pag shi ma lags te// zhag gsum dros bzhi'i gong rol tu// zab mo gdams ngag bstan nas kyang*// de ring dus 'dir ci tsug 'dug

/'chad byas khyed la dris pa lags// 'jig rten bya bas thugs g.yengs shing*// bla ma'i mos gus ma khom nas// nyams rtogs rgyud la ma skyes pas// dam pa rnams la bzod par gsol// /// 40) ༄// chos tshul bzhin nyams len dgos pa snying nas yin na ku re ba// dam pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal 'dud// chos byed kyi nga'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// spong sems brtan po'i go cha la// chos brgyad kyi 'du 'dzis g.yeng na mngon// lam tu 'gro na chos byed yin// chags sdang skye na ku re yin// dad pa'i nga 'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// nyams myong dang rtogs pa phul na mngon// gong ma mnyes na mos gus yin// thugs kyis bas na ku re lags// sgom chen gyi nga'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// skyon med brgyud pa'i gdams ngag la// nyams myong dang rtogs pa skyes na mngon// gcig tu 'dres na sgom chen yin// mang po byung na ku re lags// yon tan gyi nga'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// sems gnyis su med pa'i me long la// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel blta na mngon// lung dang mthun na gsha' ma yin// yon tan rlom na ku re lags// tshogs dpon gyi nga'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// 'gyur med rang snang gi gdams ngag la// mtho dman gtam gyis g.yeng na mngon// sems snang du go na mkhas pa yin// dbyen khar nyan na ku re lags// gdams ngag gi zhal tsho che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// rtsa ba shes pa'i shes rab la// bzang ngan sna tshogs byung na mngon// spang gnyen du go na mkhas pa yin// yig nag lta na ku re yin// btsun po'i nga 'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// srung sems bzang po'i sa gzhi la// rkyen ngan mang po langs na mngon// grogs su 'gro na btsun po yin// gtsang sbra la re na ku re lags// phan sems kyi nga'o che ba kun// snying nas yin nam ku re ba// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la// gzhan gyi blo gtad byed na mngon// sangs rgyas la 'god na phan sems yin// zas nor gyis bslu na ku re lags// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// ku re pag shi bgyis pa lags//

// 41) ༄// gdan sa chags sdang med par skyong dgos par gdams pa// pha chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// dag dang ma dag gdul bya rnams// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa la// rang 'dod phyogs ris bsam pa yis// bzang ngan gyi phyogs ris ma byed par// bu rang la gtad pa'i pha phogs de// chags sdang gi dgra la ma bskur mdzod// bka' brgyud kyi bla ma gong ma rnams// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa mchog /rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho de// thugs rje chen po'i thabs kyis 'dzin// spyir gang yang yag par 'ong du 'dra// bu rang la gtad pa'i pha phogs de// chags sdang gi dgra la ma bskur mdzod// pha skyes chen bla ma gong ma rnams// skye 'gag med pa sems kyi gshis// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnas lugs mchog /lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyal sa de// 'du 'bral med pa'i shugs kyis 'dzin// zhe 'dod tung tung gi kha na med// thams cad yag par 'ong du 'dra// bu rang la gtad pa'i pha phogs de// chags sdang gi dgra la ma bskur mdzod// pha rtag pa'i rgyal po chos kyi sku// dus gsum 'gyur med kyi gdan sa de// gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pas ga la zin// yang pha bdag med chen po'i ku re la// bdag 'khrul pa'i byis pa a thang chad// bu nam mkha'i pad mo ma 'dzin par// mnyam nyid kyi thang la ngal sos dang*// bde chen gyi dbyings su gnyid nas mchi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// // 42) ༄// rang sems 'khrul gyi me long la blta lugs ma nyes pa byed dgos pa/ na mo rat+na gu ru/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams// zhing khams phun sum tshogs pa de// mgon po rgyal ba tshe dpag med// byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshe// de ltar blo yis 'dus byas pa'i// bsam pa'i stobs las byung pa yin// snying stobs ma chung rnal 'byor pa// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' med du// rang dbang med par 'khor ba yang*// rang sems 'phrul gyi me long la// blta lugs nyes pas lan pa yin// sku yus ma che rnal 'byor pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// bzang ngan gnyis su ma gzigs te// thams cad spros pa med par zhi// rang don gzhan don phun tshogs pa// thams cad rang gi bsam pa yin// log par ma blta rnal 'byor pa// bdag 'dzin rtogs pa'i rdza ma der// 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi mchog

/stong nyid snying rje'i gdams ngag sbas// 'dzin chags kyi thim bu phyung tsam gyis// skyon med gnyug ma'i bdud rtsi'i bcud// mos gus can gyi slob mas thungs// nyams rtogs gcig tu gyur pa de// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin// bla ma rin chen de skad gsung*// /// 43) ༄// nyams dang rtogs tshad kyi shan 'byed tshul bstan pa// na mo rat+na gu ru bhi r+ya badz+ra ni/ rang rig 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// bde chen chos sku yin ma yin// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa la// mos gus kyi gter kha bye na mngon// rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs mi bzhugs// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// bsgyur zhing byin gyis brlab na mngon// gnod pa byed pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// chos skyong srung ma yin ma yin// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// gsang sngags nyams su blangs na mngon// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo 'di// man ngag zab mo yin ma yin// mnyam rjes sgom gyis ma bslad pa'i// gnyis med nyams su myong bas mngon// dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa de// stong nyid snying rje yin ma yin// skyon med brgyud pa'i byin rlabs des// skal ldan byin gyis brlab na mngon// gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu la// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung mi 'byung*// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la// ci bya rang dbang yod na mngon// kwa tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag rnams// tshe 'dir rtog pa'i blo gros kyis// rang gzhan mgo bskor ma byed par// tshad ldan bla ma spyi bos bkur// byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis// 'gro drug smin pa'i blo gros dang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// rgyas par 'dod pa'i blo gros kyis// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus des// mgo rtsa ma log man ngag la// kha rkyang tshig tu ma shor bar// tshul bzhin nyams su blang gyur na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan yang*// tshe 'di nyid la 'char 'gyur bas// yon tan gzhan lta smos ci dgos//

44) ༄// dus bzhi'i mchod pa chen po tshogs chen rdzogs par bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ bstan pa 'di y-i sgor zhugs shing*// skyob pa shākya seng ge la// ston par gang gis khas len cing*// gsum la skyabs su song rnams kyis// bslab bya dus mchod chen po 'dis// sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag pa dang*// tshogs chen rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*// dge slong rmas par gyur pa yang*// sos par gyur pa la sogs pa// phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa// ston pa nyid kyis gsungs pas na// gong ma rnams kyi rjes 'brangs nas// dus bzhi'i mchod pa chen po bya// sa ga sa ri'i zla ba la// tshes brgyad rgyal dang 'dzoms pa'i tshe// ston pa sku bltams dbu skra bregs// de yi nya la rdzogs sangs rgyas// dus der mngon par byang chub pa'i// dus mchod chen po bya ba yin// de nas zhag grangs bzhi bcu dang*// rtsa dgu lon pa'i dus tshod du// wā ra ṇā sīr mgon po yis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin// dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po la// tshul du bzhugs shing tshul thon nas// zhag bdun lon pa'i nyin par ni// lha las babs pa'i dus mchod yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// 'das mchod dang yang gcig tu 'ong*// cho 'phrul rta yi zla ba la// cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod pa bya// /// 45) ༄// rten cing 'brel 'byung las skye ba grub tshul bstan pa// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rgyu rkyen las skyes rnams// gdod nas ma skyes spros pa kun dang rnam par bral// mkhyen gnyis mnga' bdag bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa nyi mas 'gro rnams skyobs// lhan cig skyes pa'i yul rnams 'dod pa'i gzhi// rtogs na 'dod pa med pa bde ba che// rtogs pa'i ngo bo bla ma rnam gnyis mkhyen// sa bon ldan pa rkyen gyi dbang yin te// yul la 'dus pas chags sdang rmongs gsum byung*// shes par byed pas 'du byed shes pa phyogs// shin tu nges pa rnam par shes pa'o// bye brag shes pas ming dang gzugs su btags// skye mched drug po drug la rab tu 'jug

/zhugs pas reg dang tshor bas sred pa len// mngal tu zhugs pa srid pas 'grub pas skye// rga shi la sogs sdug bsngal 'khor yug go /dang po gti mug sred len 'dod chags yin// gzhan rnams byed pa'i ming la las zhes bya// kun kyang dug gsum 'gyur ldog 'ba' zhig yin// yul la brten nas skye ba me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// 'dus pa'i shes pa rten 'brel dag las 'byung*// shes pa de las mun dang snang ba nyi ma'i 'od// gzhan du 'pho ba med do shes pa gar yod sa der yod// /// 46) ༄// rten 'brel lugs 'byung ldog gi go don gsal bar bstan pa/ rang bzhin rnam dag spros pa nyer zhi ba// rgyal ba rnams kyis mngon du mdzad gyur pas// 'gro ba kun gyi rten dang gnas gyur pa// 'khor 'das kun gyi gshis la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo dran pa nye bar bzhag pa las/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis so// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'di rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung gi gces pa zab mo zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ lugs las 'byung ba dang de las ldog pa'o// lugs 'byung ba ni/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel ba las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin// zhes pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed dang*/ rga shi'i bar du'o// de yang ma rig pas gzhi byas/ drug pos las bsags/ sred len gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ srid pa dang*/ skye ba dang*/ rga shi'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po rigs drug tu 'khor/ rten 'brel zhes bya ba 'tshogs pa las skyes pa dang*/ gcig ma tshang na 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel ma tshang bas/ 'bras bu de lta bu grub par mi 'gyur bas rten 'brel 'phyug pa'o// de la lugs las ldog pa ni/ yul rten 'brel lugs las ldog pa dang*/

ldog pa'i thabs dang*/ ldog pa la zhugs pa gsum la// 'dod sred drag po skyes pa la gzhi dad pa zhes zer ro// de yang mgon po byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// zhes pa dang*/ dad pa la yang 'dod pa'i dad pas gang 'dod pa de/ brtson 'grus drag pos bsgrub pa la lam mam/ yang na rten 'brel lam/ tshogs gsog ces ming tha dad par btags pa'o// yang yul gang yang rung ba gcig la gang dmigs dmigs su 'gyur bas/ de dang der 'gyur bas 'dun pa'i rtsal la rab tu gnas pa'o// yang rang gis dang por sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du mos nas/ de la 'dod pa'i dad pa drag pos bsgrub na/ de thob pas lta bas go 'phang mchog tu byed ces gsungs so// 'o na sred len 'khor ba'i rgyu yin pas spang rgyu yin nam snyam na/ de nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'khor 'das gang yang ma grub par rtogs pas/ srid par song ba sdug bsngal ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi bar 'du shes pa'i shugs kyis 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag nas de spong bar 'dod pa dang*/ sred dang bral la yang sred med ces pa ni gnas skabs kyi srub rnyed pa'o// rgyal ba'i sras rnams ni/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad gdod nas ma grub par mthong bas srid par mi gnas pa dang*/ sred len rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu'am/ rten 'brel zab mo byang chub kyi sems 'di'i skabs su gnas 'gyur rnams dang*/ gsang sngags rnams bzhed/ bsod nams kyi tshogs de las rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byung bas/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya'o// // 47) ༄// gnyis med byang chub sems 'di goms par byed dgos pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ badz+ra rā dza dharmā ka ya ni// bram ze chen po dngos 'dzin med// lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid kyis// rang byung phyag rgya chen po rtogs// byang chub sems kyi de nyid las// 'khor du gtogs pa'i mu stegs rnams// lta spyod gzhan du ma bsgyur nas// rang gzhan phyag rgya chen po yis// gnyis su med par bsgyur nas kyang*// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzad/

de la 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ rang gi 'khor dang*/ gnyen 'dun dang*/ ma nyid nges pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo mthong ba'i dbang gis/ phyin ci log gi rten 'brel gyis phyin ci log gi rgyu 'bras da lta nyid nas bzung ste/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen por 'byung ba la snying brtse bas ma bzod nas/ bzang po'i rgyu 'bras la 'jug pa'i 'dod pa'i dbang gis/ ngan rtog gi gnyen paur bzang rtog bsten cing*/ tshar gcad pa dang rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyis/ khro 'khrugs dang 'bad 'bungs sna tshogs byas kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob ces gsung ngo*// 'o na ji ltar bya zhe na/ spyir mkhas pa thams cad kyi mthar thug cing lus pa med pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin te/ chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas pas/ rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ de'i dgongs pa rje btsun bram ze chen pos thugs su chud pa'i rnam par thar pa yang de nyid do// des na/ sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod las byung*// de skad gsungs pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gnyis med byang chub sems 'di goms par gyis// gnyis 'dzin rtogs pas byang chub mi thob ces// dpal ldan mda' bsnun 'o dod 'bod pa nyon// // 48) ༄// gnyis med thugs rje chen po dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar byed pa// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// a la la ste dpe las 'das// snying rje snying rje kun gyi bdag /gnyis su med pa'i snying rje mchog /snying rje can gyis gang rtogs pa// blo las 'das pa'i snying rje ni// gnyis med snying rje can rnams kyis// gnyis snang med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// rgyun chad med par gnas par bya// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// khams gsum srid gsum 'khor 'das kun// rig pa'i ngang las ma g.yos pa// rgyu 'bras gdod nas stong nyid 'di// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rig pa rtul zhugs spyod pa yis// gnyis su med par 'gyur ba yin// gnyis med thugs rje chen po 'dis// gnyis su med pa'i bag chags sbyang*// de ltar gnyis med thugs rje dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral 'tshal//

/// 49) ༄// rlung sems dbyer med kyi dran rgyun la gces par dgos pa// na mo rat+na gu ru hūm̐/ a ya cha lnga cha'i rnal 'byor pa// thabs lam yon tan 'byung 'dod na// shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// mthun pa'i gnas dang stan bshams nas// phyi nang gi g.yeng ba rab bcad de// dam tshig bla ma spyi bos bkur// sbyor ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe// rlung sems gnyis med dran pa gces// nyams myong rgyun chad med par bya// gtsub shing gtsub stan 'tshogs gyur kyang*// rgyun chad drag tu ma bsgrub na// me lta 'ong bar cang srid dam// /// 50) ༄// gtum mo'i lus gnad dang bral na re ba med ces pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas// gtum mo gnad kyi sbyor ba la// thog ma bar dang tha mar yang*// kha zas 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa gces// pho rlung mo rlung ma ning rlung*// lto bde tsam du kha zas ni// yang yang za ba'i sbyor ba yis// rlung ni non par 'gyur ba ste// gsus pa ltebs nas mnan rgyu med// 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi sbyor ba yis// rlung lnga dbang du byas nas kyang*// rang gi gnas su chud par 'gyur// lus gnad 'bral na re ba med// gcig tu gyur pa'i dmigs pa yis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// rang rtags phyag rgya ston par byed// gnyis su song na re thag chad// des na bla ma'i gdams ngag gces// // 51) ༄// nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar bar bde chen rgyal po'i rang sems bsgom pa// na mo rat+na gu ru// dbyer med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// gnyug ma spros dang bral ba la// ngos gzung med par blo 'das te// 'dzin pa'i spros pa sna tshogs kyis// sems nam mkha' chen po bkab gyur na// mkhyen pa'i yon tan nyi zla de// sgrib par 'gyur pa gdon mi za// bu sku gsum yon tan 'dod pa na// nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar bar// bde chen rgyal po rang sems sgoms// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kyang*// ri bong rwa dang mo gsham bu// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// gnyis su grub pa mi srid pas// bu 'dzin pa thongs la rang sems sgoms// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// bsgom dang sgom mkhan thams cad kun// gnyis med rang sar dag gyur na// thabs lam gyi dgos pa rdzogs pa yin// mnyam nyid ngang la mi 'gro na// gzung 'dzin spros pa sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan don kun ga la rdzogs// sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa la// rang gi sems dang mi 'bral mdzod//

// 52) ༄// dpal sa ra ha'i phyag chen ma bcos rnam lnga'i bsdus don par phu ba la gdams pa// bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas// phyag rgya chen po skye ba med// ma bcos ngang la bzhag pa chos kyi sku// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug kun tu tshogs drug lhug par zhogs// tshogs drug lhug par bzhag na bde chen rgyun mi 'chad// rje btsun gong mas gsungs pa'i don// rang byung lhun gyis grub pa yin// sems ma bcos pa la rnam pa lnga// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma bcos pa// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'dug lugs yin// nyams myong bzang po ma bcos pa// lha gnas gong mar skye ba'i rgyu// sems kyi gnas lugs ma bcos pa// mya ngan 'das pa'i sa la gnas// 'khor 'das gnyis med ma bcos ba// theg chen slob pa'i zung 'jug yin// mthar thug blo 'das ma bcos pa// rang byung lhun gyis grub pa la// rtsol sgrub med pa'i gzhan don 'byung*// mi slob 'bras bu mthar phyin yin// khyed kyi de rnams ngas ma shes// de la gzigs la zhu thug mdzod// // 53) ༄// 'od gsal chen po'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa// na mo rat+na gu ru/ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// 'pho lugs bsam gyis mi khyab ste// bzang ngan rtog pa'i bye brag gis// rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khaur// sred len 'pho ba'i rnam gzhag 'di// mkhas pas rmongs pa mgo skor yin// mos gus can gyi slob ma dang*// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa gnyis// dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms tsam na// gnyis med sems kyi ngo bor rtogs// lhun grub dbyings la 'pho 'gyur med// rje rnal 'byor chen po'i gsung bzhin du// dang por 'pho ba gzhi ma grub// bar du 'pho ba ngos gzung med// tha mar 'pho ba blo las 'das// 'pho bya 'pho byed 'pho ba gsum// dbyer med gcig tu song tsa na// 'od gsal chen po'i 'pho ba zhes// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla mas gsungs// rab kyi yang rab 'pho ba'o//

// 54) ༄// rang sems skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba'i gdams ngag dam pa tshig gcig na mo rat+na gu ru/ pha ltar byams zhing ma ltar gdung ba de gang yin// mdza' mo bzhin du yid du 'ong ba de gang yin// dus rnams rtag tu bde ba 'byin pa de gang yin// dbang gi rgyal po lta bur dgos 'dod 'byung ba de gang yin// ji ltar byas kyang skyo ba med pa de gang yin// shar nub med pa nyi zla lta bu de gang yin// yon tan mang po'i gter kha 'byed pa de gang yin// chos rnams ma lus mtha' dag ston pa de gang yin// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dad pa de gang yin// skyon dag yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa// gcig pu rang gi sems nyid gcig pu// gcig pu 'di las skad cig tsam yang*// bral ba'i thabs ni cung zad tsam yang med do// bu gcig snying dang 'dra ba khyod la// tshig gcig gdams ngag dam pa 'di smras// de las gzhan pa nga la'ang med do// // 55) ༄// tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag bya thabs med pa rnam gsum// na mo rat+na gu ru/ 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan rnams// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus las// nges par 'byung zhes gong mas gsungs// mos gus bral na bya thabs med// bsod nams bsags dang mos gus kyis// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu nyams rtogs la// dran pa yengs med ma shes na// mi bsgom pa la bya thabs med// bde sdug mtho dman myong tshor rnams// gnyug ma'i ye shes bdud rtsi yis// bzang ngan nyams myong dag pa'i tshe// gdams ngag med na bya thabs med// bya thabs med pa rnam gsum la// rmongs pa'i slob dpon gang zhig gis// a thang chad par byed na yang*// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas na// de la sus kyang bya thabs med// tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag rdzogs so// // 56) ༄// rnam rtog bdud las bsrung ba gces pa'i gsung mgur//

dge sbyor shes pa bkol tu btub pa zhig /yod pa'i dus su bdud kyi bar chad ni// tshe 'di la sogs spros pa'i sems byung na// dge rnams gzhong chu bzhin du 'gro bar snang*// 'bras bu bde skyid byang chub mi 'ong bas// rnam rtog bdud las khyod kyis srung ba gces// dus gsum bar la blo gros can// bsod nams bsags pa'i skyes bu la// bdud rnams chos skyong srung mar 'gyur// ngan pa brjod pa dkon mchog sgra// mtshon cha pad+ma'i char par 'gyur// phyi rol rang sems snang ngo kye// rdo rje'i lus la snyoms 'jug pas// rten 'brel rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa yis// phan gnod gang bsgrub rang dbang che// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas// snang ba dbang bsgyur ngo mtshar che// 'jam dbyangs shes rab chen po yis// lhag pa shes rab bslab pa'o// 'di la tshul khrims bslab pa shes// des na ting 'dzin sems bslab bya// // 57) ༄// thabs kyi rgyal po rnam gsum la mos gus gces zhes pa// rje rang byung chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// rgyu sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag bsgom// rkyen bla ma dam pa'i mos gus byed// thabs dran pa yengs pa med pa bstain// don blo yi yul las 'das par myong*// don dam blo 'das chen po la// gnyis med byang chub sems kyis brgyan// thabs kyi rgyal po rnam gsum yang*// nyams su blangs pa'i dus kyis 'byung*// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas sku gsum ngo mtshar che// thabs kyi rgyal po rnam gsum la// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus gces// dang por mos gus ma skyes na// skyob mdzad drin can dam pa dang*// a kar shag pa'i skyon chen yod// mos gus gnyis pa ma skyes na// sman pa'i rgyal po ma bsten pas// gzugs brnyan sman pa bsten pas phung*// mos gus gsum pa ma skyes na// chags sdang dug gi stobs 'phel nas// rang gzhan gnyis ka phung bar nges// des na bla ma'i mos gus dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// ci gsung bka' dang 'gal mi bya//

// 58) ༄// skyo shas dang go cha skye dgos pa'i nyams mgur dum bu gsum// bcom ldan snang mdzad dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe la long med phan sems brtul zhugs bzung*// long gtam ma byed don nyams ltung ba phog /shes pa ma rings khrid las bya rgyu med// so sor rigs rnams dus su ngo sprod bya// byin rlabs med na blo sna 'gyur mi nus// gzhan la phan pa bsgrub bya ma yin nam// snying rje nyi ma 'dra ste bzang ngan phyogs ris med// bla ma snying dang 'dra ste bsam pa logs na med// tshogs gnyis chu bo'i gzhung bzhin nam yang rgyun chad med// chos rnams sems su shes pas gdod nas yod ma myong*// skyo shas dang go cha skyes pa'i tshe// go cha'i rtsol sgrub byas pa des// sems kyi de bzhin nyid khrid nas// bya byed kyi rgya la mchong bar nges// go cha'i 'dug lugs go lags na// lhan cig skyes pa'i mdza' na mos// bde chen rang sar khrid nas kyang*// dga' ba bzhi yi nyams myong gis// rang gzhan smin pa ngo mtshar che// gzhan gyi skyon la mi rigs pa med pa// rang gi yon tan la rlom pa med pa// sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'gal ba med pa// drang po'i bsam pa la g.yo ba med pa// 'di dang ldan pa'i skyes bu de// rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa// // 59) ༄// gzhan sems mgu ba'i gdams ngag rtogs ldan rnams kyi rgyan zhes pa// bdag gcig pu dben par ngal gsos na// ngal sos pa'i dus su bla bo thos// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rnam thar 'di// skye med nam mkha' stong pa las// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mo sham bus// ri bong rwa yi mtshon thogs nas// nam mkha'i pad+mo'i rnam gzhag la// chags sdang sna tshogs dbye ba byas// zla ba gnyis pa'i bshes gnyen la// chags pas nam mkha'i pad+mo phul// smig rgyu'i dgra bos pad+mo khyer// rmi lam grong khyer chen por phyin// nam mkhas nam mkha' tshad byas kyang*// nam mkha'i dbyings las 'da' ba med// dam chos phyag rgya chen po ni// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras su// rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// zhe 'dod med pa'i mdun ma de// ji ltar byas kyang yag par gda'// pha bka' drin can gyi gdams ngag yin// byams snying rje skyes na dgra yang brtse// gzhan sems mgu ba'i gdams ngag 'di// rtogs ldan rnams kyi rgyan du che// rgyan 'di dang ma 'bral rnal 'byor pa//

// 60) ༄// stong nyid gcig pus sangs mi rgya bar bstan pa// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gling gsum dag na skyes pa yi// skyes pa dang ni bud med ni// so sor thar pa'i rten yin gyi// gzhan ni rten du mi bzhed kyang*// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu// klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa// so sor thar pa'i rten du gsungs// bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis// lhan cig mi 'byung grags mod kyang*// lung 'di bon 'bum dag na 'dug /gsung rab gzhan du ma mthong bas// mkhas pa rnams kyis gzigs sam dris// stong nyid rtogs pas bsod nams tshogs// sa bcu'i bar du gsog dgos te// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas rgyu// ku sā lī pas ma thos sam// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyu// byang chub sems las gzhan pa yi// stong nyid gcig pus sangs rgya ba// rmongs pa khyed kyis su las thos// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skye dang gnas pa'i rten du ni// so sor thar pa mi 'dod kyang*// nyon mongs sgrib pa ma spangs pa'i// mthar thug sangs rgyas su yis thob// gsang sngags pha rol phyin pa dang*// 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus kun// sa brgyad thob nas gcig tu mchi// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa yin// sems ngo shes pa mthar thug yin// da yong skye ba mi len ni// 'jig rten mgon las ma thos te// ngo bo mthong ba mthong lam gsung*// sa bcu yod par shugs kyis shes// khyod lta mu stegs rgyang 'phen ltar// skye ba mi len pa yang srid// snga nas ma 'ongs phyi nas mi skye ba// blo lta bde ste bde bas phung*// ris su bcad pa'i skye ba ni// rgyu med pa las skye ba 'o// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med pa// rgyu dang rkyen las skye ba rnams// skye ba'i ma mo rtogs pa yis// rtogs pa'i rgyu 'bras go ba las// 'gog pa'i bden pa zhes bya'o// rten 'brel rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i// rang bzhin rtogs pa rang sangs rgyas// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mkhas pa 'o// rtogs pa de yi bag chags kyi// dri ma gser gyi 'gyur rtsis bsgyur// gnyis su med pa'i slob zung 'jug

/dbyer med mthar phyin mi slob pa// tha dad chu bo'i tshogs rnams dang*// ser ba kha char gyi tshogs bzhin du// bdag la gnod sems chags sdang dang*// mthun dang mi mthun tshogs rnams kun// byang chub sems kyi rgya mtsho ru// phyin nas so so'i las rnams byed// lan tsha'i ro ni gcig tu gyur// // 61) ༄// yod ma myong ba'i khyad par gyi chos zhes pa'i gsung mgur// oṃ āḥn mo rat+na gu ru badz+ra rā dza hūm̐/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// nga dang bdag ces gang btags pa// don mthong skye bo ngo mtshar che// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gzigs pa'i// bden pa bzhi zhes gang btags pa'i// nyan thos bsam pa ngo mtshar che// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa yis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skams so zhes// rang rgyal shes pa ngo mtshar che// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god do zhes// mo sham bu yi snying stobs kyis// ri bong rwa yi skas 'dzegs nas// sems can nam mkha'i me tog rnams// mgo bos 'khur ba'i rgyan thogs nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas nam mkha'i dbyings// mnyes par byed pa ngo mtshar che// /// 62) ༄// slob dpon gdan sa ba la gdams pa'i dum bu gsum// thog mar gnyid las langs dus su// mi mthun phyogs sgrub gtsor byas pa'i// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// bsam pa nor bu rin po che// 'byung ngam mi 'byung rang nyid kyi// yid kyis yid la yang yang 'dri// ma chags zhe sdang med pa dang*// btang snyoms dag tu mtshan gsol ba'i// ma rig gti mug thams cad kun// bdag la med par 'gyur ba dang*// bya ba dag la 'jug pa ni// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag yin// rnal 'byor bdag gis dran par bya// de ltar dran par ma byas shing*// gang zhig chags dang sdang ba 'am// rmongs par gyur ba dag gis ni// bya ba dag la zhugs pa na// rang nyid phung ba'i gshed ma ru// rnal 'byor bdag gis shes bgyis la// byang chub sems la nan tan tu// yang dang yang du shes par byos// snying nas thar pa bsgrub lags na// rang la rang rdzun ma byaid par// mchog dang thun mong thams cad kyi// yon tan 'byung ba'i rtsa ba de// theg chen bla ma dam pa yin// bla ma dam pa rin chen la// dad dang gus pa'i sems pa yis// nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du// mos gus brjed pa med pa yis// gsol ba dus gsum btab byas na// bla mas thun gcig ma bstan cing*// slob mas thun gcig ma bsgoms kyang*// rgyud la yon tan chos rnams skye// rang sems sangs rgyas nyid du go

/'khor ba gzhi rtsa bral bar go /mtshan ma rang sar grol bar shes// tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad la// zhen pa log nas gcig pur gnas// rdzas dang gnyen 'dun thams cad la// zhen med gcig pur 'dod pa bral// lar 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la// sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes rab tu gces// rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs pa gces// sems can ma rgan tu dran pa gces// ma la snying rje dran pa gces// rang don yal bar dor ba gces// gzhan don dang du len pa gces// dus da res yin no skyes bu kun// 'bad pa chen po'i dus la bab// 'phur shes bya la nam mkha' bde// bya 'phur sbab tu song ba med// rtogs pa'i mi la sgom med bde// ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa med// sgrub byed ting 'dzin mi ldan na// lus ngag yid gsum rnam g.yeng zhing*// rang gzhan don kun mi 'grub pas// sgom gsal chab la ma gsol mdzad// bde sbyin ting 'dzin mi gnas shing*// lus ngag yid gsum rnam par g.yeng*// gzhan rgyud byin gyis mi rlob cing*// sgom gsal chab la ma gsol mdzod// ces slob dpon gdan sa ba la gdams so// // 63) ༄// sems can gyi don du gcig pur ri khrod 'grims pa// dpal ldan phag mo grub pa'i zhabs la 'dud// shākya'i ban ldom nges med nga*// rgyal khams phyogs med ldom bu byed// gnas la nges pa med pa la// gcig pu ther zug ga la gnas// drang srong rnams kyi rjes bsnyags te// 'gro la phan pa'i don ched du// gcig pu ri khrod dgon pa bsnyag /rang gi chos dang ma mthun na// khyed phyogs ris kyi ngo srung ga la byed// cis kyang mi phan 'bral nges pas// chen por rlom pa'i grwa pa la// gtan grogs bsam pa ga la yod// 'du 'dzi'i bsod nams g.yeng ba de// bdud kyi phye gtor yin pa la// dam pas zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bdud kyi zhags pas ga la 'ching*// nor dang ka dang ca dang gsum// byis pa bslu ba'i rdzas yin yang*// mkhas pa mgo skor ga la nus// bde chams yul gyi dgon pa yang*// skyid chos za brang gi gnas yin te// nyams rtogs ri khrod dgon par 'phel// 'di phyi gnyis khrid chos pa yang*// mi sngun jo bo che na yang*// rang nyid gar 'gro gtol mi bdog

/babs la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// la kha'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// mi kha la nyan pa ga la srid// khe grags 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams// 'gro skad 'dug skad gtam rnams kyis// gces ka rnyed bkur 'tshol na yang*// nga rnal 'byor pa la de 'dra med// bu rang la skyes pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// nga la gros 'debs rigs pa min// khyed kyi slob dpon nga yin pas// so so gang 'dod gdams ngag zhus// // 64) ༄// chos nyams su mi len na yig rul gsog dang 'dra ba// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// bla ma'i mos gus las 'byung zhes// gdams ngag dam pa bstan na yang*// kho rang zhe 'dod yin snyam nas// khyad gsod byed cing gan shags rgyag /'di 'dra'i grwa pa mang po des// nga la phan nam khyed la phan// grogs ngan spongs la nags su song*// ji snyed gsang sngags yon tan rnams// dbang dang dam tshig las 'byung zhes// 'o dod chen po bos na yang*// dam tshig mi srungs rang dgar 'jug /dam tshig nyams pa'i mi rnams dang*// lhan cig bsdad pas thams cad phung*// da yang rang nyid gtsang sar sdod// skyed rdzogs gnyis po bsgoms pa yis// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum 'di// brjes nas gsang sngags 'grub bo zhes// snying gtam gdams ngag bstan na yang*// nyams su mi len yig rul gsog /mos gus skad nas 'dre gzugs 'bri// ba lang mi yi gzugs can la// smras pas rang nyid kha tshags che// da yang mi smra kha rog sdod// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po de// rang gi rgyud la skyes tsam na// bdag 'dzin cis kyang ldog go zhes// gong ma'i bka' stsal smras na yang*// kha lta bzlo zhing zag pa sogs// mi chos bla ma smra rnams dang*// lta spyod bstun nas ngan sar ltung*// da yang rang res mi bsrung re// // 65) ༄// rtag tu bla ma bzang po dang mi 'bral bar bstan pa// spyir rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la// gsol ba ma btab bshes gnyen gyis// dus rgyun chad med par ma bskyangs na// khams gsum sems can gang la yang*// rang dbang gtad na zhan par mchi// gsol ba 'debs pa'i bla ma yang*// byang thang stong par bor nas kyang*// rang nyid che ldir byed pa mthong*// dkar po'i yon tan ga na 'ong*// zang zing spros pa rgyun chad na// yon tan bskyed pa'i bla mas kyang*// ngan pa smra zhing zhan du 'gro// bu mi chos lha dam thams cad kyi// gdams ngag snying por gyur pa de// rang la yon tan yod pa yin// bu yon tan bskyed pa'i bla ma dang*// srog dang sdos la ma 'bral cig

/tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad kyi// mdun ma thams cad gru bzhir 'ong*// mgon po shākya seng ge la// ma pham mgon pos bsten pa 'dra// des na bla ma bzang po dang*// 'bral bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// phan btags mdza' bor gyur pa yang*// rtag tu de ltar mi 'gyur te// sho shum ma yi mdza' bo ltar// thams cad de ltar shes par bya// // 66) ༄// sems kyi rang bzhin go bar gces pa ba sgom btsun rgyal la gdams pa// dmigs gtad kyi sgom pa gzung 'dzin yin// bcos ma'i spyod pa tshul 'chos yin// spang blang gi 'bras bu 'dus byas yin// 'khor 'das gnyis sems kyi 'khrul pa yin// 'khrul pa rtogs pa ngo mtshar che// 'da' ka ye shes mdo las kyang*// sems ni ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyu// sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol gsungs// dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// yi dam lha tshogs ji snyed pa// dngos su ci tsam mthong ba bas// sems kyi rang bzhin go ba gces// brjod bya'i sangs rgyas de yin pas// bde gshegs lha rje'i zhal nas kyang*// sems skye ba med pa chos kyi sku// 'gag pa med pa longs skur gnas// ngos gzung med pa sprul sku yin// de gsum tha dad med pa la// ngo bo nyid sku dam par gsung*// des na sems nyid ngo mtshar che// sems 'phrod na ye shes 'gag med yin// bcos par byas na mang du 'gro// des na slob dpon zhal snga nas// tha mal shes pa ma bcos pa// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i yul ma yin// glo bur gyi rnam rtog dbyings su yal// mthar thug gi gnas lugs de yin gsungs// spyir na sems kyi ngo bo de// gcig yin sems na ngos gzung med// gnyis yin sems na tha dad med// mang por sems na dbye ba med// dus gsum sangs rgyas ye shes dang*// bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa dang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// rang bzhin gcig pas tha dad med// des na dam tshig gsal bkra las// rang lus rgyal ba'i phyag rgya che// sems can khams kyang der shes shing*// gang yang bdag las gzhan min dang*// bde gshegs snying po nyid yin gsungs// sems nyid rtogs na de nyid yin// stong pa nyid la don dam med// shes rab snying po nyid las kyang*// ye shes med ces gsungs pa lags// spyir gang zag blo yi bye brag tu// theg pa'i rim pa gsungs pa rnams// 'di ltar yin zhes brjod par ni// gzhung lugs gcig kyang mi lang bas// gong du brjod pa mtha' dag gi

/mdor sdus pa yi don 'di yin// khams gsum gzhi rtsa med pas na// 'khor ba ched du spong mi dgos// gdod nas sku gsum lhun grub pas// 'bras bu gzhan du btsal mi dgos// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pas// 'khor 'das gnyis kyang mi dmigs phyir// des na rgyal ba'i yum las kyang*// sangs rgyas zhi ba'i blo gros kyis// byang chub sems dpa' ma gzigs gsung*// rang sems rtogs pa ma lags pa// mthar thug logs na ma mchis so// gud na sems nyid dngos po med// rtogs dang ma rtogs gang yang med// des na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis// rgyal po chen po'i sems la ni// dbyibs dang kha dog ma mchis pas// sems zhes bya ba dngos med gsungs// des na thams cad dngos med yin// bla mas gnang ba'i gdams ngag 'di// phyi rabs don phyir yi ger bkod// lung dang snyan ngag sdebs nas brgyan// stong nyid snying rje'i gru gzings la// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug skya ba ldan// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// bdag gzhan ma lus sgrol mdzad pa'i// ba sgom btsun pa rgyal la 'bul// 'di las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// chu zla lta bu'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas rmi lam ltar shes nas// rnam rtog rang bzhin go bar shog /rje yi thugs dgongs zab mo 'di// yi ger bkod par mi rigs kyang*// ma nam mkha' mnyam don blo bskyed phyir// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par zhu// sbyangs pa chung zhing thos pas dbul ba dang*// g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur rmongs pas brtsams pa'i phyir// gong 'og nor 'khrul sgro skur snang gyur kyang*// gzigs pa rnams kyis thugs kyis mi 'phya zhu// //

67)༄// tha dad blo yi 'khrul pa spong ba'i gsung mgur// kye ho skal ldan shes rab can// lar ji ltar byas kyang phyug pa de// nam mkha'i ba mo bzhos na mchi// 'dus byas dngos po'i rang bzhin 'jig /yang mi 'jig bstan pa'i bang mdzod de// bde chen lhun grub bang mdzod yin// lha dang bla ma dkon mchog gsum// rang bzhin dbyer med gcig pa la// tha dad blo yi bye brag la// 'khrul pa yod pa mkhyen lags sam// // 68)༄// rang ngo bo mnyam nyid bsgom par bstan pa dum bu gnyis// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jug pa'i sgo dang 'byung ba'i sgo// sgo gnyis khegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur// lugs 'byung lugs las ldog pa yis// 'khor bar 'khor dang de las ldog /gzung ba'i yul dang 'dzin pa'i sems// gnyis po bcud la bor ba ni// bzlas pa gcig gis byed pa'o// gzhan gyi rnam par rtog pa rnams// rang gi rnam par rtog pa yis// mnyam par bsgrub cing phan par 'dod// rtog pa yin phyir mi mnyam ste// phan pa rnams kyang mi srid pas// ngo bo mnyam nyid ma gtogs pa// rang gzhan gnyis ka bde mi srid// des na rang nyid bsgom par bya// // 69) ༄// bden pa mthong ba'i rnam thar rang byung bde chen// lhan cig skyes pa rang byung bde ba chen po'i sku// 'khor 'das yon tan ma lus thams cad 'dzin pa'i gzhi// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po skem mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gtsug gis 'dud// sems nyid rang byung lhun grub de// gdod nas chos skur gnas pa la// 'khrul pa'i bag chags gzung 'dzin gyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams// thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// thugs rje btang snyoms mi mnga' bas// chos sku spros dang bral ba de// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lor snang*// bag chags 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho las// sad par mdzad pa'i bla mar gyur// bla ma'i thugs rje 'od zer gyis// 'khrul pa'i mun pa rab bsal nas// skad cig yud tsam thang cig la// sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs su skyes// 'khor ba'i rigs rgyud chad pa dang*// sangs rgyas rigs su skyes pas na// rigs kyi bu zhes de la bya// bu rigs kyi bdag po spyi bos khur// gong ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i tshe// phyi dang nang gi dngos po la// chags pa'i zhen pa rab log nas// ltos 'jog med pa gcig pur gnas// chags pa'i dri ma ma spangs na// ltos 'jog dri ma mi spong bas// chags sems spangs la 'bad par bya// spyir re ltos 'khor ba'i dug ro 'di// zhen med bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba yis// dug ro gting nas ma bton na// dge ba'i bsod nams tshogs bsags kyang*// 'bras bu yon tan 'dod pa yi// lan la re ba'i chags pa des// zhi bde chags pa med pa'i sems// nam mkha'i ngos ltar rnam dag pa// dri med rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang*// gcig tu 'gyur ba mi srid pas// re ltos chags sems bral ba'i yid// nam mkha' lta bur gnas par bya// gti mug ma rig mun pa yang*// zhen chags med pa'i ngang nyid kyis// rtog med 'od gsal chen por 'gyur// 'od gsal spros dang bral ba de// gti mug gnyen por thub pas gsungs// gnyis med 'od gsal chen po las// zhen med thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro drug smin par byed pa yang*// ngam ngam shugs kyis 'byung ba yin// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// gzhan phan zhen med snying rje 'di// thabs kyi mchog tu btsir gyis zungs// chags pas bde 'gro mi thob ste// thar ba'i srog kyang gcod par byed// brtse sems phal cher chags pa yin// mo bon gzhan don zhe 'dod yin// mdor na bla ma'i zhal snga nas// sems spros dang bral ba'i nam mkha' la// re ltos zhe 'dod sprin tshogs rnams// mkha' la rang sar ma yal na// zhen med thugs rje chen po yis// gzhan la phan pa dka' mor mchi// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// thub sku gser gyi kha dog dang*// mtshan dang 'od zer 'bar ba dang*// rang byung dri med chos sku la// sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa dang*// ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin du// lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas de// thob par 'dod pa'i re ltos kyis// tshogs gnyis rgyun tu gsog pa de// tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi rnam thar yin// thob bya chos sku dri med de// chags pa'i yul du ma gyur cing*// re dogs bral ba de ga nyid// blo yi yul du ma gyur pa// don dam bden par go ba'i tshe// rang gi de nyid goms pa las// 'bras bu gzhan du mi 'dod pa// 'gyur med sa gzhi lta bur gnas// sems can khams dang mthun pa yi// kun rdzob rdzas kyi dngos po rnams// so so'i bsam par snang ba ste// sems gnyis 'drais pa'i gser 'gyur rtsis// lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rnams// bsgyur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa las// ma lus sems can khams rnams kyis// rang blo bsam pa ji bzhin tu// chos dang mi 'jigs zang zing sogs// phan pa'i sbyin pa rnams su 'gyur// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// tshogs gnyis gsog pa ma gtogs pa// mchod pa gzhan gyis mnyes pa med// byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis// 'gro drug thar pa'i lam la bskul// sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i zhing khams mchog

/sems can gnas ris thams cad kun// stong pa nyid kyis bskul zhing bskyod// spyod pa gcig gi rnam gzhag la// go ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas// de nyid nyan dang 'chad par snang*// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'di// bden pa mthong ba'i yon tan de// gcig las thams cad 'byung ba la// brjod kyis nus pa ga la srid// dper na dbyar dus 'byung ba'i tshe// rtsi shing lo 'bras me tog rnams// 'di 'byung bsam gyis mi khyab ltar// chos nyid bden pa mthong ba la// yon tan brjod kyis ga la lang*// bden pa mthong ba'i rnam thar yin// // 70) ༄// khro chu'i bzhu lugs man ngag gi nyams myong*// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la zhu ba/ spyir lugs thams cad la dpe'i tshos btsad dang*/ khro chu'i bzhu lugs gnyis kyi gdams ngag ma shes pa yin/ de la dpe'i tshos btsad dmar por thal nas/ phyogs thams cad nas dkar ling nge ba de yin/ khro chu'i bzhu tshod khrol thab kyi lugs su byed nas/ zhabs dang glo dang thams cad sol ba'i nang du nub par byas nas/ sbud pa drag zhan ran par thams cad mer thal nas/ khro bzhu ba'i snod kor thams cad nas zla ba ltar dkar hril gyis song ba'i dus su zhu ba yin pas/ lugs byas na legs par 'grub pa yin te/ 'dre dang bar chad du 'gyur mi srid bar gda'/ nyams su myong bas grub pa yin no// // 71) ༄// bzang skyong ngan 'dor gyi gsol 'debs mgur ma// kyai/ gson dang rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ kye ho/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// yang cig chos skyong srung ma rnams// khyed kyi mdzad pa'i rnam thar 'di// nged kyis mthong ba da lta 'dir// mthon po bzang ngan ma lus la// bzang po skyong la ngan pa 'dor// bdag cag 'gro drug sems can rnams// rgud cing sdug pa ma mthong ngam// 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed pa// ku re kyal ka tsam du gda'// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can la// thugs rje chen po mnga' ba ltar// skyes chen ltad mo mdzad na yang*// sku gsum rin chen brtan bzung nas// byang chub sa la mi 'god dam// mya ngan 'das pa chen po las// bya dang ri dwags la sogs pas// rtswa chu lo ma bcud zos nas// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs zhes gsungs// bdag cag 'gro drug sems can la// sngon gyi dam bca' ma bsnyel bar// sdug bsngal thams cad zad pa dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob mdzad gsol/

zhes dbyangs su mdzad do// // 72) ༄// dga' skyid kyi bstan bcos dge sbyong gzhon nu grags par gnang ba// bde chen kun bzang yangs pa'i mdzod// bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ston pa rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// bcom ldan shākya seng ge yi// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs thams cad kun// skyid pa'i nga ro 'di skad sgrogs// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams na// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs pa rnams// mi gtong skyong bas nga re skyid// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// ji ltar byas kyang bde legs gzhi// spyad du yod pas nga re skyid// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal sras ye shes spyan can rnams// bu bzhin skyong zhing bsrung mdzad pa'i// lam gcig grogs po nga re skyid// skyabs 'gran zla med pa dkon mchog yod pa skyid pa'i tshoms so// ༈ //dus gsum ma lus bsags pa yi// lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa yis// dus gsum 'phags pa sems can la// sbyin par 'grol bas nga re skyid// ston pa'i ma 'dres dam pa'i chos// dgag dang sgrub pa'i bslab pa la// sna gcig tsam zhig bsrung na yang*// mya ngan 'da' bas nga re skyid// tshig rtsub mtshon cha rnon po dang*// mi mthun spyod pa gang byung yang*// bzod pa gsum las mi 'da' bas// skyon nyid yon tan nga re skyid// byang chub sems gnyis gser 'gyur rtsis// snang srid rang gzhan ma lus kun// dbyer med byang chub chen por bsgyur// lhun grub brtson 'grus nga re skyid// bla ma'i gdams ngag rin po che// chags sdang rmongs gsum yan chad dang*// mthar thug chos sku man chad kun// dmigs par 'gyur bas nga re skyid// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa lam gyi mchog

/chos kun rten 'byung rab zhi ba// shes rab rnam gsum nga re skyid// ji ltar byas tshad pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu 'gyur ba go gcig pus chod pa skyid pa'i tshoms so// ༈ //e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang*// dus 'dir phrad pas nga re skyid// lus ngag yid gsum gshis dang gzhi// rin chen dbang gi man ngag gis// mthar thug sku bzhi sangs rgyas su// log gis gyur pas nga re skyid// sha khrag rdos pa'i phung po 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan du// bdag nyid nges pas nga re skyid// e ma nyon mongs rin po che// sems can khams la gnas pa rnams// rtsa rlung thig le'i man ngag gis// ma spangs rang grol nga re skyid// 'di la bsams pas he he 'chor// bsams shing dga' ba yang yang skye// dran na gcig pur khong dgod 'chor// rje yi thugs zin nga re skyid// phyi rol yul dang sems can la// 'dod cing chags par gyur pa'i tshe// bskyed rdzogs dkar po'i chos rnams la// nor bu rin chen nga re skyid// zhe sdang gnod sems byung ba'i tshe// gsal dang 'od gsal 'od gsal che// 'phags pa klu sgrub dgongs pa mchog /dgongs pa ngo 'phrod nga re skyid// gti mug ma rig gnyid rmugs 'di// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po 'od gsal gyis// gti mug chos sku nga re skyid// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i rtog pas g.yengs// mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran// rten 'brel gang gis 'byung ba'i tshul// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nga re skyid// nga dang ngar 'dzin nga rgyal las// gzung dang 'dzin pa skye ba'i tshul// rtsa ba gcig gi don rtogs pas// 'khor ba rang grol nga re skyid// byas pa med par nyon mongs pa dug lnga gnyen po rang grol du gyur pas/ skyid pa bskyed rdzogs kyi tshoms so//

༈ //e ma yang cig ngo mtshar che// cig car phyag rgya chen po'i don// rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma skyes pa// gdod nas sangs rgyas nga re skyid// de ltar yin yang ma shes pa// bla ma chos sku rin po che// nor bu chu dwangs ji bzhin tu// dwangs snyigs 'byed pas nga re skyid// dwangs dang snyigs ma'i khyad par las// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// shan phrag sha mong sul bzhin du// nor 'khrul med pas nga re skyid// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang*// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kun// chos skur gyur bas nga re skyid// gnas lugs cig car 'ba' zhig las bsam gyis mi khyab par go bas skyid pa'i tshoms so// ༈ //bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos// shes pa gcig gis rang grol ba// ji ltar byas kyang skyid pa yi// skyid skyid ring mo'i dam chos 'di// dad dang bsags dang shes rab kyis// bla ma mnyes par byas nas kyang*// shākya'i dge sbyong brtul zhugs can// gzhon nur grags pa'i rnal 'byor pas// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus/ dpal dga' dga' skyid skyid kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa'i gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba/ phan yul rgyal gyi gnas su byung ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong gzhon nu grags kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 73) ༄// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yid re mug zhes pa// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// kwa cis kyang mi phan 'chi na yang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bsam pa skye// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// yang dug gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras 'di// sdug bsngal du shes kyang sred pa che// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug

/'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// nang ting 'dzin zas su mi za bar// mi tshe 'tshol gsog gi las la 'byams// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// stong pa gshis su rtogs na yang*// bdag gzhan gnyis kyi chags sdang skye// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// sgom pa gzhan don yin bzhin du// spros pa'i 'du 'dzi ched du 'tshol// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// tshogs gnyis bla ma bkur rdzogs kyang*// gong ma khyad gsod kyi bsam pa skye// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// byams snying rje nye drung yin pa la// da rung 'brel pa'i zhen chags skye// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// stong pas bdud bzhi 'joms pa la// hūm̐ phaṭa lcim phud shing zhig kyi ber ka rdegs// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// yang bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// gzhan phan rang don yin pa la// gzhan la drin rtsi lan bgrang byed// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// byang chub sems kyi gshis yin kyang*// grangs med gsum gyis gzhan nas 'tshol// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// pha bla ma rin chen la gsol ba 'debs so// dam pa khyed kyi byin rlabs kyis// log pa'i shes pa rnam dag cing*// skyon med yang dag gi rtogs pa la// bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas// blo 'das dag pa gnyis ldan sku// rang gzhan thams cad grub par shog/

74) ༄// rang gi 'dug lugs brjod pa phag pa'i phreng ba// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma deng sang bdag gi rnam thar 'di// legs par bsams pas 'dug lugs gting nas go /rang nyid rang la yi mug chen po skyes// mi rjes slebs par 'dod na ri la song*// zhi bar gnas pa spros pa'i las la zhugs// bsod nams che bas bar dang bsdum la 'byams// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gcig kyang med// rje btsun bla ma smig rgyu'i rgya mtsho snyog /sangs rgyas bstan pa kha smra yin zhes zer// dam pa'i chos kyang zhang lcam rjes bzhin thal// nga bzang khyod bzang tshig la nyams rtogs re// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu zang zing yin par rlom// gser gyi bu chung bdar bas sol bar gyur// gcig pur gnas kyang dug gis khong pa gang*// legs spyod ltar 'chos gdug pa'i dug gis bzung*// mi rjes slebs par 'dod na dben par sdod// bcu chos gsum chos tshig la zab mo re// rgyal ba'i gshegs shul phyi shun spun par thal// mdze brtag snying por gyur pa'i 'bri gung pa// khyi sngags sgal sngags gang mang 'gran mo byed// dmu chu'i 'khrul 'khor shes pas sdug tu bcug /mkhar sel zhing sel shes na ci 'dra ang*// rang gzhan thams cad bslus pas ci la phan// bu smad gso rgyu med na ri la sdod// phag pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba// yi ge 'di yi ming lags so// // 75) ༄// stag lung thang pa dang nged spun gyi 'grogs lugs bsam grub ras chen la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ pha mnyam med dpal ldan chos kyi rje// mkhyen brtse'i sgrib pa mi mnga' ba// thogs med ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// nged spun la mnyes sam snyam pa lags// 'gran gyi do med gtsug gi rgyan// dpal ldan stag lung thang pa la// nga 'bus rin chen gser 'bum phul// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// stag lung thang pa yab sras kyis// nga 'bu shi ba dong nas bzlog

/ma bas byams shing bu bzhin skyong*// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// mkhas btsun grub thob ras chen gyis// rin chen zhun mas bzhengs pa yi// nga la gsang sngags rgyud 'bum gnang*// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// 'gran gyi zla med 'gro ba'i dpal// yab kyi gdung 'tshob smar pa yis// nga y-i bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// rin po che yi bu slob rnams// dma' la rngan chen mi mnga' bas// grwa sar nga 'bu bu bzhin bskyangs// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// bsten yun thung la yon tan chung*// rnam thar phra mo 'dzin tsam la// dga' bas nga la bla mar bkur// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// bdag nyid chen po seng ge stag /khams na bzhugs pa'i bu slob kyis// bstod pa pha 'bab bka' drin gnang*// nged spun 'grogs lugs ci tsam lags// mos gus can lta ma lags te// ngas kyang rin chen yab sras rnams// spyi bo gtsug dang 'bral ma myong*// brgyud pa rin chen mchog 'di bzung*// sbyangs sdom ri khrod dgon pa bsten// dgos pa'i go so stongs pa med// g.yog po go chod ma yin te// snabs bshal cig yin nam snyam pa lags// mtho la phrag dog mi mnga' zhing*// dma' la rngan chen mi mnga' ba// 'jig rten mgon po'i jo sras rnams// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// min kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// bcom ldan mgon po rin chen gyi// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun la// 'grogs lugs 'di 'dra shin tu 'os// byang chub gling na bzhugs pa yi// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams// khyed kyang gong ma'i rjes su slob// pha jo rje dang mjal nas mchi// dbus gtsang ru bzhi 'di rnams su// dka' ba 'bad pa sna tshogs kyis// btsal kyang ma rnyed rgyud sde rnams// byon pas dga' ba'i skyid skyid rnams// thugs kyis bas na bzod par gsol// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// bsam grub ras chen rje btsun la// mos gus gdung ba'i blo gros kyis// dad cing gus pa'i phyag rten du// zhal skyin gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams// zab chen me tog rgyal mtshan dang*// ngo mtshar che ba'i dar bcu 'bul// thugs kyis dgongs nas bzhes su gsol//

// 76) ༄// bkra shis sgo mang 'phro bzhag tu mi btub zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches// dge 'dun rnams kyi spyan sngar zhu ba// bla ma rin po ches bkra shis sgo mang 'di bzhengs su gsol bas/ yams nad dang rims nad kyi 'phro chad/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid par byung*/ lugs 'di brtsams pa tsam gyis than chen la char bab/ lugs tshar ba'i dus su char ha cang ches pa sbad kyis chad/ rten 'di bzhengs pa dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis sku'i rim gro chen po mdzad pa dang*/ phyi nang gi nye gnas rnams kyis/ mos gus kyi zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog rlabs po che mang po mdzad pas/ nga'i sku khams la yang bskyed byung*/ nga rang ni zhan ne tsam byung*/ gong rol du ni 'chi'am snyam pa'i bsam pas/ khyed rnams la bsdad na dga' bar byung*/ nga'i ngos nas phan tshun du gshegs bzhud mdzad par bzhed pa rnams/ tshur byin gyis rlobs la gshegs par zhu/ der yang bag dang ldan pa dang*/ nye zho med par mdzad par zhu/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams ri khrod du bzhugs nas sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad par zhu/ sgom pa rdo rje seng ge dang*/ khyed nye gnas pa rnams kyang*/ tshong byed pa sgom chen pa'i las min/ rin po che'i sku khams ma bde bar skyur mi phod/ ngas bya ba mi nus ma snyam/ ngas dad pa can rnams kyi g.yu rdog dang*/ rta bzang mig gis blta mi phod pa rnams phul ba/ rta la yo ma'i khyu btsugs/ g.yu phag tu sbas nas/ g.yu nyo ba dang mkhar brtsigs pa dang*/ srid gcod pa dang*/ 'gro ba mang po mar 'gro ba'i sdig rten ni mi byed par/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen sku phyogs dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun gyi phyogs su zhabs tog bya sa rnyed pa/ khyed rnams dga' bar soms la 'bad par zhu/ dge 'dun gzhi la bzhugs pa rnams// do cig kho na phyi tshul ni bzang zer na nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pas/

nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bdud kyi rgyal po choms sam ma choms/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i tshul khrims kyi phung po la/ chags pa'i yul rnam pa gnyis kyi chom rkun gyis bcom mam ma bcom/ tshe thog ma med pa nas phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa'i nyes pa'i 'bras bu/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa/ ngan song gsum gyi 'khor lo/ rnam par rtog pa'i phreng ba/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal gyis rtsad nas drung phyung ngam ma phyung*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ dran pa tsam gyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa'i phung po ri'i rgyal po ri rab lta bu 'jig par mdzad cing*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan rin po che ma lus shing*/ lus pa med pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma rin po che de gzhan gar yang ma lus pa/ rang nyid kho na yin par go'am ma go /de ltar go zhing rtogs na ni pha jo yang mnyes/ yi dam yang dgyes/ mkha' 'gro yang dga'/ glu chung so'i bar na len te/ len ma myong la ci cha yod bya ba yin no// gcig tu 'bul bas do cig nga na ba'i spyan rtsa ba bltas/ lhag lhog bag tsam yod pa bkra shis sgo mang gi 'phro bzhag tu ma btub/ zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog bya rgyu ma rnyed pas thugs mi chad par zhu/ da sang gnangs nga 'bu khams bde ba'i dus su/ 'bul ba ni sprin bzhin du 'thibs/ khyed rang rnal 'byor pa mi re la phyi bzhag gi ka ca mi 'tshal 'khur la shog /nged rang chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas skyid bya'o// nga yang khams cung zhig ma brtas kyi bar du snga ma bzhin du mtshams byed par zhu'o// dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang sku mtshams snga ma bzhin du mdzad par zhu// // 77) ༄// yid skyo'i smon lam rnam bcu dbang ldan zhes bya ba//

aṃ/ nyon mongs dbang song 'jig rten chos kyis g.yengs// bdag 'dzin lta ba zhen pa'i sgom pa can// 'du 'dzi spyod pas rang gzhan slu byed pa// glen pa rang la yi mug ga chad pas// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i rdo rje'i gsung*// bdag 'dra dman pas rtogs par mi 'gyur kyang*// zur tsam rjes su 'brangs nas smon lam 'debs// bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyis// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa mchog /gnyis med chos sku bde chen gnas thob shog /rang gzhan gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// gnyis med mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// dbyer med rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo rnams// nor 'khrul med cing chud zar mi 'gyur ba// mkhyen pa gnyis tshul dbyer med don ston pa// bla ma rin chen gsung bzhin grub par shog /aṃ/ gtong dang yongs su gtong ba che// tshad med gtong ba dam chos rin chen sogs// tshad med spyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa yis// sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog /aṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa yi// tshul khrims rnam dag dri ma bral ba yis// rang gzhan nyes pa'i skyon rnams dag gyur nas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi stobs bcu thob par shog /aṃ/ rang gzhan thams cad gdod nas chos kyi sku// sangs rgyas yon tan kun dang ldan gyur pa// thos nas mi skrag nyams su len gyur te// shin tu myur bas byang chub thob par shog /aṃ/ nyes tshogs lta bas rang gzhan thams cad kun// bya dang byed pa'i rtsol bas g.yengs pa rnams// byar med rtsol dang bral ba'i brtson 'grus kyis// lhun grub spros dang bral bar gnas gyur cig /aṃ/ thams cad mkhyen pa slu ba med pa'i chos// rigs can rnams la phan par gang gsungs pa// nyon mongs rnam rtog mtha' dag zhi byed pa'i// ting 'dzin mchog des 'gro kun rgyal gyur cig /aṃ/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams gang*// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes blo las 'das// chos kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa yis// rang gzhan spros pa'i mtha' dang 'bral bar shog

/aṃ/ thugs rje rmad byung shākya'i rgyal po yi// rdo rje theg pa bla med gsang sngags kyi// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs zab mo yis// skyon dag yon tan ma lus rdzogs par shog /aṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur ba// rgyal srid rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i// bsngo ba bla med zab cing rgya che bas// kun kyang kun tu bzang por reg par shog /aṃ/ thub pa'i dbang po stobs bcu mchog mnga' ba// rang byung 'od gsal sems nyid gcig pu yis// bdud dpung ma lus bcom nas sangs rgyas te// chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor gyur cig /aṃ/ yod 'dzin med 'dzin mtha' las rnam 'das pa// sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg pa'i ye shes ni// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan ma lus pa// sangs rgyas sras bcas 'gro kun nye bar 'tsho/ aṃ/ ye shes mchog 'dis 'khor 'das ma lus pa// rgyal zhing shin tu rgyal gyur bkra shis pa// dkon mchog gsum rgyun nam yang mi 'chad pas// 'gro ba thams cad rtag tu bde bar gnas/ aṃ/ zab cing shin tu rab zab theg pa'i mchog /nyon mongs rnam rtog ma spangs sangs rgyas pa// gdod nas ma skyes blo 'das chos kyi sku// kun bzang he ru ka 'di bcom ldan 'das/ aṃ/ rtogs ldan rnal 'byor rnams la sangs rgyas 'dis// rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlob mdzad cing*// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho gsol mdzad pa// rdo rje 'chang gis rtag tu bkra shis shog /yid skyo bar byung nas smon lam btab pa// rnam bcu dbang ldan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 78) ༄// bka' babs brgyud pa'i mos gus kyi dngos grub// mig med 'jig rten phal pa rnams// nged kyi bla ma 'dri lags na// tshu rol mthong dang blo bstun nas// dris pa'i lan tu 'di skad smra// mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rje btsun pa// kho bo'i bla ma rin chen de// dpal nā ro'i gdung las 'khrungs pa lags// grub thob brgyud pa'i bar ma chad// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal po yis// lnga brgya'i dus su lung bstan pa// mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu yi// sras kyi thu bor 'khrungs pa lags// nā ro chen po'i gdung rgyud 'dzin// khong rje btsun de yi bka' babs kyi// byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa// bla mas tshig gcig ma gsungs shing*// slob mas thun gcig ma bsgom kyang*// mos gus kyi dngos grub thob pa lags// bir+wa chen po'i rjes 'brangs nas// bla ma de yi bka' babs kyis// tshig don gyi brgyud pa ma chad pa// phyi nang gi rten 'brel zab mo yis// snang srid dbang du bsgyur mdzad pas// nus pa'i mthar thug chen po lags// dpal ldan pad+ma'i rjes 'brangs nas// brgyud pa de yi bka' babs kyis// byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad pas// tshad med thugs rje chen po yis// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// smin cing grol bar mdzad pa lags// rje btsun rgyal po'i rjes 'brangs nas// bla ma de yi bka' babs kyis// sgra don gyi brgyud pa ma chad pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'dod yon rnams// bde chen chos skur bsgyur mdzad cing*// lhan skyes ro la rol pa lags// 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rjes 'brangs nas// gong ma de yi bka' babs kyis// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// gdod nas ma skyes spros dang bral// dbu ma chen por thugs su chud// dpal chos kyi grags pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// mkhas pa de yi bka' babs kyis// ston pas mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis// rgol ba ngan pa'i wa tshogs rnams// skrag nas 'byer bar mdzad pa lags// mi pham mgon po'i rjes 'brangs nas// mnga' bdag de yi bka' babs kyis// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams// thogs pa med par bgrod pa lags// bhu su ku yi rjes 'brangs nas// khong rje btsun de yi bka' babs kyis// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// ting 'dzin rgyun chad mi mnga' bas// mnyam gzhag chen por bzhugs pa lags// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yi// shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pas// chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid rnams// chags thogs med par mkhyen pa lags// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul khrims la// nyes pa'i dri ma spangs pa yis// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa lags// chen po'i chen por gyur pa yi// thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs shing*// mkhas btsun chen po thams cad kyis// gtsug gi nor bur bkur ba lags// thugs 'od gsal nam mkha' 'dra ba la// dus gsum shes bya ma lus pa// nor 'khrul med par mkhyen pa yis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa lags// lar ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// sprul pa'i sku zhes grags par ni// rtsod pa kun dang bral ba lags//

lhu+un grub 'gyur ba med pa chos kyi sku// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos shing*// zag med bde ba chen po rgyas mdzad pa// rang byung bla ma rin po che dpal 'dud// de yi gsung sgros skyon rnams spang phyir 'bri bar bya// mi chos 'phrang dang lha chos 'brel ba'i 'phrang*// mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms na tsha sdug bsngal dang*// khros pa'i 'phrang dang nus pa yon tan 'phrang*// bdun dang bral na bde chen rnyed par 'gyur// de la mi chos dang 'brel ba'i 'phrang la zhen pa spang ba ni/ 'chi ba rjes su dran par bya ste/ ga re 'chi 'am mi 'chi/ 'chi na nye du gnyen 'brel/ rdzas dang longs spyod 'di rnams thams cad kyis stongs sam mi stongs/ de 'chi yang nges/ stongs kyang mi stongs par yang nges na/ dgos pa med pa'i bya ba la mi tshe stong skyel byas nas/ dgos pa'i nang bar gcer bu lag pa stong par 'gro na/ smyon pa'i nang na'ang smyon pa yin/ de yang*// mdza' ba rnams kyang med gyur cing*// mi 'dza' rnams kyang med gyur na// gang gi don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad bdag gi mdun na gnas// zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus kyang*// zhig ste so sor 'gyes 'gyur na// mdza' ba gzhan lta smos ci dgos// zhes pas so// yang*/ lha chos dang 'brel ba'i 'phrang la spros pa gcod pa ni// slob dpon dang grogs po nye du dang 'brel ba rnams/ tshe 'di dang 'dres pa'i sgo nas thabs sna tshogs kyis bsgom du mi ster na/ thos bsam rkyang pas 'jig rten las mi 'phags par/ sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis kyang gsungs/ 'dug kyang de tsug 'dug na 'khor ba las ni mi 'phags/ nyon mongs pa rgyas pa'i chos 'dis/ dgos pa ci yod snyam nas spros pa gcod pa gal che/ bdag dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang gis phan pa bskyed par byed pa'ang*/ dga' rab dbang phyug thub pa'i dgra// blo gros chen po phrag dog med pa'i bsam pa yis// dge la bskul na gnod pa ga la yin// mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'i 'phrang la sdug sran bskyed pa ni/

rang bla ma'i drung du rtsis che bar yang ma byung*/ skur ba yang med/ bza' rgyu yang chung*/ gang gi phyogs nas kyang rten 'brel ma 'dzoms na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob khar mthun rkyen mi 'dzoms pa rten 'brel yin/ de'i dus su lo gcig gnyis sran pas chog pa yin gsungs/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang*// grangs med gsum du dka' ba spyad// rje btsun dpal ldan nā ros kyang*// bcu gnyis bar du dka' ba spyad// dam pa gong ma thams cad kun// dka' ba spyad pa ma gtogs pa// don rnams 'grub pa mi srid na// bdag lta gong ma'i rnam thar la// ci yi phyir na bsten mi byed// 'bad pas byang chub ma bsgrub na// dmyal ba la sogs 'gro drug rnams// sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa// rtag tu bdag gis ga la nus// snyam du nges pa'i blo gros kyis// mi mthun phyogs rnams thams cad kun// lam du gtong ba'i man ngag gis// snying stobs chen po bskyed byas na// bskal pa mang po'i 'khor ba yang*// bsam pa gcig gis spong 'gyur ba// mdo sde rnams su rgyal bas gsungs// na tsha sdug bsngal gyi 'phrang la lam du gtang ba ni/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal byung ba'i dus su/ sdug bsngal bdag gcig pu la 'ong ngam/ 'on te gzhan la yang 'ong*/ yid kyis blta/ bltas pas 'gro ba rigs drug nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab cing thon pa'i dus med pa dran pas/ snying rje'i shugs chen po rang shugs kyis 'byung bas/ rang dbang med par smon lam 'debs pa ni// bdag gi nad dang gnod pa 'dis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams nga'i 'dis dag par gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ nad dang sdug bsngal du snang ba rnams rang gi blo 'khrul bas de ltar snang ba yin/

don la nad dang sdug bsngal med snyam pa dang*/ nad dang gnod pa de'i rang bzhin la bltas shing ngang la bzhag pas/ nad de skye 'gag gnas gsum dang gdod nas bral bar go nas// rang gzhan thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ro// kye/ nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kun// gdod nas yod dam glo bur ba// nam mkha' las byung sprin tshogs kun// nam mkha'i ngang du yal ba bzhin// kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di// sems nyid kyi dbyings su dag gyur nas// sku gnyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// 'gro drug gi mun pa sel bar nges// de snying gtam tshig gcig smras pa yin// khros pa'i 'phrang la gong ma blta ba ni/ rang la nyams dang rtogs pa bzang po zhig byung nas/ nga rang la sgom pa 'di gcig pus mchog /sangs rgyas la thob rgyu yang mi 'dug /'khor bar 'khyams rgyu yang mi 'dug /sangs rgyas byon kyang 'di las med/ ci tsug byas kyang btub snyam nas/ brtson 'grus dang dge sbyor gyi phyogs su bya ba chung na/ da lta me stong byas kyang tsha bar 'dug /de bzhin du bzang ngan gyi rgyu 'bras thams cad mngon sum du 'ong bar 'dug /nga rang bzang por 'dug snyam pa'i nga rgyal che yang*/ chos nyid spros bral bzang por 'dug pa min/ sdug bsngal gyi 'byung khungs nga bzang po rang gis phung*/ de yang slob dpon 'phags pas// bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha la 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel pa las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin// nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// zhes pa'o// bdag 'dzin ma spangs pas bzang po mi btub/ de bas na yod med spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i 'dzin pa'ang*/ grub mtha'i rtog pa blau yi yul/ blo byas kyi stong pa yin/ rang gi dge sbyor gyis 'dag rgyu yin na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du dran par byas la/ rang la phye mi gtor/

rang bzang sar mi bzhag par bdag 'dzin ci 'dag la 'bad par bya'o// mo sham bu yi mthu rtsal gyis// ri bong rwa yi skas 'dzegs nas// nam mkha'i nyi zla ltor zos pas// 'gro drug mun pa'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// de bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'dug tshul yin// nus pa'i 'phrang la ngo shes par bya ba ni/ rang dge sbyor la 'bad pas nus pa phra mo byung na/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gis gang yin ci tsug yin ngo shes pa gal che ste/ rang dge sbyor gi ngang la gnas pa ni med/ shes pa nga rgyal dang phrag dog ni skye/ bla ma'am grogs tshangs pa mtshungs pa bas/ nga che dang nga bzang gi rtog pa byung na bdud kyi phye gtor yin/ yang na bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus kyi rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel lam/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas nus pa phra phra'u byung ba yin/ de la dga' ba'i blo 'byung na tshe 'di'i rtog pa nyon mongs pa'i dug rgyas/ bdag 'dzin gyi mnga' thang skyes/ chos brgyad kyi chu bo 'brubs nas kha la nga nga rgyun chad med/ nga sems can gyi don byed pa yin zer nas/ snying rje dang stong pa byang chub rin po che'i byung khungs bor nas/ nad pa'i zas nor la mig ris kyis gcod/ tha ma dril bu yu chag khur nas grong khyer du mthu chen byed/ bre srang 'dzin cing srung skud la phul grangs kyi gong 'debs/ de bas ni shi ba rang dga'/ bla ma'i zhal snga nas/ mo bon gyi gzhan don zhe 'dod yin gsungs/ don gy-is de ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam mthu dang nus pa la btsongs pa yin pas// 'khor ba dang ngan song las nam yang thon mi srid pa yin no// des na rang cag skye shi la gnas pa yin/ dman pa'i sa bzung*/ hrul po'i gos gon/ rgya gag chu bzhin btung*/ tshe 'di pa rnams dang lta spyod mi mthun/ chags sdang rgyas pa'i sar mang po mi bsdad par ri dwags ltar bros/ rgyal 'gong lta bu'i nus pa la dgos pa med/ srid gsum 'gran zla med pa rgyal ba'i mthu bsgrub bo// kye ma 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la// ji ltar byas kyang skyid med pas// nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras las// bdag ni nam zhig thar bar 'gyur// 'jig rten chos brgyad sdug bsngal gzhi// bde dang thar pa'i srog gcod pa// mthu dang nus pa rtags rnams la// 'dod pa'i blo dang nam zhig 'bral// pha rol g.yang sa ma mthong ba// tshe 'di 'dod pa'i blo gros kyis// man ngag 'tshol bar 'dod rnams kyi// mar khrid ded dpon nam zhig spongs// phrag dog khong khro dug rgyas shing*// nyon mongs me yis rang gzhan sreg

/gshin rje'i skyes bu 'dra rnams kyi// 'khor rnams spangs nas dgon pa'i gnas// 'du 'dzi spros pas rnam dben pa// ri 'am gangs sam nags rnams su// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam mchog /byang sems nor bu rin po che// spros med sems nyid nam zhig bsgom// snyam du skyo shas bskyed pa dang*/ tshogs bsags bla ma la gsol ba btab nas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i shugs kyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi sdug bsngal dran pas sel bar 'dod pa'i blos/ gcig pu gnyis su med par dgon pa gsum du bsdad la byang chub sgrub par bya ste/ de yang stong nyid snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom/ dgon par gnas pa'i dgos pa shes pa gal che/ de'i dgos pa ni bslab pa rin po che gsum la bogs thon nas/ rang gzhan mtha' dag gi nyon mongs pa bcom pa ma gtogs pa/ nyon mongs pa spyod pa'i gol sa bsnyags pas thar pa mi thob/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis bsgoms pas/ rang la yon tan du mngon pa'i rtags rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi 'dren pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i zhal mthong ba la sogs pa'i cal col mang po byung nas/ yang gang nas bltas kyang a bo rang yin/ dang po thos pa byas/ bar du bsam pa byas/ tha mar sgom pa byas/ bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin/ rtags dang nus pa 'di rnams yod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i zhal yang mthong*/ bla ma gong ma la sogs pa gang gis kyang nga tsam mi chog snyam nas nga rgyal na/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs pa'i lha mthong na bdud yin gsung*/ 'di dga' rab dbang phyug gi dug mda' yin/ bsnyems pa'i dug gis thur du ltung*/ bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas/ 'di mtho sa che na g.yang sa che// rtog pa phra ba'i phra ba la// bdud chen po'i chen po 'jug pa yin// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// de la yid ches skyer mi rung*// de la yid ches skyes pa na// bar chad bdud kyi dbang du 'gro// de de yin te de nyid min/

gsungs// rdo rje gcod pa nyid las kyang*// gang zhig nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang zhig nga la sgrar shes pa// log pa mthong la zhugs pa ste// skye bo de dag nga mi mthong*// 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku// chos sku mthong bya ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas dgos pa'i rtsa ba rang gi sems bsgom pa gal che/ dgos pa med pa'i rtsab rtsub la g.yengs na chu bshig pa la 'bras bu mar mi 'ong ba dang 'dra ba yin pas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i dam chos rin po che// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub pa// 'gyur med rang byung sems kyi dkyil 'khor las// sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rgya che ba// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rin po che// bde chen byang chub mchog la 'dren par nges// rin po che yi gsung sgros 'di// ston pa blo gros seṅge yis// kun la phan pa'i don ched du// shākya'i ban dhe ldom bu pa// dge slong rin chen dpal la zhus// 'di bris bsod nams gang yod des// 'gro rnams chos sku thob par shog /'phrang rnam pa bdun bsal ba// bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa'o// rdzogs so// // 80) ༄// gnas lugs bzhi yis sems 'dul ba'i gdams pa// gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// brtse bas rang gi bu la springs// byang chub sems kyi bca' lugs dang*// bla ma dam pa bsten pa'i thabs// gegs dang bar chad sel lugs dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs bzhi/ zhus pa'i tshig gis lung bstan gyi// gdams ngag bstan gyis mnyan par gyis// 'di la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// ma 'dres so sor shes par bya/ spyir bstan pa'i gdams ngag ni/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas/

rang sems tha ba dul gyur na// sa bon gang yang rung ba skye// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// khyod kyi nyon mongs rnam rtog dang*// rgod dang 'gyod dang the tshom dang*// gnyid rmugs bsam gtan sgrib pa rnams// spongs la rang sems tha ba thul// nyes skyon bral ba'i rang sems 'di// ji ltar bsgyur yang btub pa yin// gong ma bzhi po smos ci dgos// thub pa chen po chos kyi rjes// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kun// bsam pa'i rnam 'gyur gcig pu yin// bu go 'am rtogs sam rnal 'byor pa// su yi kha la ji ltar mnyan// ku sā li yi rnal 'byor pas// rang sems gcig pu rang la 'dri// lha dang bla ma dkon mchog la// dri sa med do shes par gyis// snying gtam yin no sems la zhogs// bye brag so sor bstan pa ni// rin po che yi zhal snga nas// byams pa'i chu bo mi gcad cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brlan te// byang sems ljon shing rab rgyas nas// don gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad gsung*// de yi nyams len 'di ltar bya// dang po kho na rnal 'byor pas// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// bar gcod byed pa'i 'byung po la// rtsa ba'i ma yi 'du shes bskyed// drin can a mar yang yang bsam// de la byams pa'i brtse gdung skye// byams pa gsha' ma skyes pa dang*// snying rje bgrang ba'i man ngag bya// rgyu mtshan lnga la gnad du bsnun// tshad med snying rje chen po skye// gsha' mar rgyud la skyes pa dang*// byams dang snying rje tshad med pa// sems can thams cad kun la bsgom// de nyid rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe// khams gsum sems can ma lus kun// bde ba dag dang ldan pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang 'bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'di// 'ba' zhig dge la 'god pa dang*// sdig pa gtan du mi byed pa'i// dam bca' brtul zhugs drag po bya// lha dang bla ma gsang sngags dang*// skyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gdams ngag dang*// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba rnams// 'di yi gnad kyis ma zin pa'i// skad cig tsam yang ma byed cig

/sbyor ba byang chub sems kyi 'cha' thabs so// ༈ //bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gang gang ji ltar bltas pa yis// skyon dag yon tan 'byung ba las// gzhan du bsgyur ba mi srid de// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// rang sems yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen du// ltos dang bu gcig dgos se ba// rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du 'gyur// g.ya' dang bral ba'i me long la// byad kyi gzugs brnyan bstan pa 'dra// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma tshogs rnams// dpang por bzhag pa'i snying gtam yin// nyams su longs dang rnal 'byor pa// dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten thabs so// ༈ //'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i gnad dang rnam pa lnga// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar// skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral zhes// bka' stsal bka' rgya bka' nan mdzad// pha bka' drin che'o chos kyi rje// gsung bzhin bsgrub pa dam tshig lags// nyams su blangs pas nyams su myong*// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong ston pas gang gsungs dang*// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// mkhas pa'i rig pas 'thad pa dang*// ku sā li yi nyams myong rnams// dam chos 'di yi cha tsam dang*// bag tsam zur tsam yin par go /nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// gegs dang bar du gcod pa dang*// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum// mtho dman bzang ngan thams cad dang*// lnga pos gnad du bsnun la btang*// nyams su myong ba'i gdams ngag la// khyod kyi pa pha rje btsun gyis// sum chos bcu chos la sogs pa// thabs dang shes rab gnad rnams kun// 'di yis nyams su myong ba yin// bu 'ur ded chen pos nyams su longs// myong ba'i thog tu bor la thongs// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// sems nyid ngang du grol nas mchi// sdug bsngal sel byed lam gyi bdar sha'o//

༈ //dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal snga nas// mtho dman tshig phyir ma 'brangs shing*// gsung sgros mang pos ma bslad pa// da lta rang la skye ba yi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// skad cig tsam yang mi bskyed de// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog pa'i// ting nge 'dzin yang ma bsgom par// slob dpon chen po til+li pas// rdo rje tshig drug gang gsungs pa// sems nyid gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// spros dang bral ba rang sems yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// gnyis su med par ro gcig ste// sgom med lhun gyis grub pa 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// bstan du med pa rdo rje'i gsung*// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis// mthar thug dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// rang la rnyed pa ngo mtshar che// gzhan du 'tshol ba'i 'bad pa med// byar med chen po'i rnal 'byor bde// 'di las med do rnal 'byor pa// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying 'di// yi ger bri bar mi rigs kyang*// chos las skyes pa'i slob ma yis// gsol ba btab nas bris pa las// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// byin gyis rlob cing bzod par bzhes// 'di bris bsod nams gang yod des// khams gsum sems can ma lus kun// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i log rtog dang*// bral nas sems nyid don rtogs shog/ //

81) ༄// chos thams cad ro gcig tu gyur pa bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mchog gi rigs su 'khrungs// thub pa'i bstan la bslab gsum rgyal
