mtshan 'dzin// mchog gi bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas// gnyis med bde chen thugs kyi dbus su 'khrungs// dpag med dka' bas ri khrod dgon pa bsten// rang gzhan don grub rje btsun rin po che// lnga brgya'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas dngos su byon// thub pa'i bstan la bya ba rgya chen mdzad// don dam snying po sems nyid gnyug ma yi// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i ro bcud phun tshogs pas// skal ldan slob ma'i snod rnams 'gengs par mdzad// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab dpag med dang*// rtog ge rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin zhing*// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags pas mi mnyam pa// bla med theg pas gdul bya 'dul mdzad pa// sangs rgyas gnyis pa khyod la bdag 'dud kyis// gsol ba 'di btab 'bras bu don yod mdzod// skyob pa 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rjes// dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// mtha' yas bskal par dka' ba spyad nas kyang*// bdag cag don tu byang chub sangs rgyas pa'i// ston pa gcig tu gyur pas mthun pa dang*// des gsungs bla med mchog gyur dam pa'i chos// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi dag la// bstan pa'i nyams len gcig tu gyur pa dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje 'chang*// brgyud pa'i bla ma gcig tu gyur pa dang*// des gsungs nyams len chos dang lta ba dang*// sgom dang spyod pa gcig tu gyur pa dang*// sems kyi ngo bo dbyer med gcig pa yin// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa rje btsun la// bya byed gcig gyur brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad dang*// dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams gser dang dngul dang yang*// sna tshogs rin po che las bsgrubs gyur pa// 'gro ba'i don tu bzhengs par 'dod pa las// phrin las gcig tu gyur pas thugs la thogs// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mkhas pa'i lha bzo dang*// rgyu rkyen gzhan la thogs pa ma mchis te// mkha' lding dbang po thabs mkhas brtson 'grus can// pad+ma me tog rtsi thog thams cad las// bcud phyungs rgyal bas byin gyi rlabs pa yis// spra tshil

sbrang snyigs med pas khyod kyi thugs la thogs// snga ma thugs la btags ba de rnams kyis// shin tu thugs la btags pa lags mod kyis// da rung snga ma bzhin du thugs la thogs// // 82) ༄// 'dzin pa mkhas pa rnams kyis smod zhes pa// 'dzin pa mkhas pa rnams kyis smod// 'dzin pa med pa shin tu bsngags// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// gzung dang 'dzin pa spangs pa yis// sems can rnams dang mthun par 'jug /lteng rgyas 'od bsrungs ral pa can// ston pas dul bar byas pa yin// sems bskyed dbang bskur dam chos dang*// bka' drin drin lan thams cad kyi// drin lan gzhan la bgrangs na yang*// gang gi 'dod pa ma grub pa// de srid mthun par 'gyur mi srid// des na gzhan phan 'dod pa yis// 'dzin pa spangs la nan tan bya// // 83) ༄// bla ma dran pa'i gdung shugs la gces spras byed pa// 'khor ba'i 'dam las sgrol mdzad bla ma dang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la spyi bos 'dud// gcig pu gnyis su med par ri khrod du// lhag pa'i bsam pa des ni bsgrub pa byas// bsod nams mthu yis bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu sad// rtag tu ngu la rgyal bas lung bstan ltar// dge ba'i bshes las rin chen mtshan thos pas// keng shu'i 'dab ltar snying ni rab tu g.yos// gdong la mchi ma'i rgyun ni brub cing 'dzag /smyos pa'i mi ltar bla rdol sna tshogs smra// gdung ba'i sems la nam yang tshugs pa med// lus dang srog la blta ba ma byung ste// 'phongs pa'i dus su grogs po gnyis kyis bstangs phan btags pa // bla mas bcings pa'i yid can mtshan mo'i tshe// nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas song ba las// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal zhing mdzes pa mthong*// zla ba 'di yis skyes chen mthong gyur pas// re lta yun ring dga' ste bdag gis ma mthong snyam// mya ngan gyis gdungs bdud mo'i sgra skad shor// nor bzang yid 'phrog 'tshol ba'i rnam thar dran// yang yang zla ba bltas nas gdung shugs kyis// smre sngags 'don pa'i tshig gis 'di skad du// khyod kyis bdag gi bla ma mthong ngam zhes// rab tu ma bzod dri ba yang yang dris// ji ltar sha btson dong nas shor ba 'am// ri dwags rgya las shor ba ji bzhin du// phyin pas dgar gyur bsdad na dga' ba med// dbus kyi ri bo mthong ba'i dga' ba ni// dwa phrug pha dang phrad par gyur pa bzhin// dbus kyi sa la phyin par gyur pa'i tshe// bde ba can du phyin pa yin nam snyam// shin tu yid dga' mdangs dang ldan par gyur// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang skyong lta bu yi// bdag la brtse ba'i yid can grogs po rnams// da lta'i dus na phyogs bcu gang du song*// kun kyang bder gyur sdig par ma gyur cig

/bla ma'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab cing*// rang la re ba chen po yod pa dang*// snang ba sems las gzhan pa med pa'i phyir// mtho dman sna tshogs gang dang gang mthong ba// bla ma'i rnam thar sprul pa'i snang ba shar// sangs rgyas dad pa snang gsung 'di re mad// dus 'dir bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// khyod lta rang la re ba che mod kyi// 'di dag thams cad kho bo'i byin rlabs yin// khyod phyir sdug bsngal dpag med ngas mdzad gsungs// gsung 'di don la bltas par gyur pa'i tshe// dpag med 'o brgyal sna tshogs mdzad gyur kyang*// byas pa chud gson ma rabs bdag 'dra ba// byams mgon thugs rjes gzigs pa don re chung*// deng sang mi long mang pos mtha' bskor nas// chags sdang nyon mongs g.yeng bas rnam g.yengs shing*// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog ma dran pa// bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu 'di yin zhes// pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'jug pa ltar// bag med dga' bar gnas pa dgod re bro// // 84) ༄// sems nyid nor bu rin po che'i zhal gdams// gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// zhabs kyi pad+ma la btud de// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la// chags thogs med pa'i shes rab can// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyur pa// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi// bsags pa'i rgyab can skyes bu yi// blo yi pad mo kha 'byed cing*// zhal gyi bdud rtsis tshims mdzad pa// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yis// bka' stsal ji ltar gsungs ba'i don// rin chen srog gi dbang po la// so bya nya la sdod pa bzhin// 'chi bdag drung du bsdad gyur na// skye rga na 'chi spangs pa yi// sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// lhun gyis grub pa'i rang sems de// rgyun chad med par bsgom par zhu// dgos 'dod re ba spangs pa yi// sems nyid nor bu rin po che// bya yi khong du song gyur na// yul dang sems can gang dang yang*// yun ring mi 'grogs 'bral ba yi// nges pa'i shes pa bskyed byas nas// zhen pa bcad pa'i brtul zhugs bya// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// sems nyid nor bu rin po che// sbrul gyi khong du song gyur na// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun babs pas// gdug pa'i dug sbrul gsad par bya// yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rten// sems nyid nor bu rin po che// phag gi khong du song gyur na// stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi// ral gri me 'gal lta bu yis// gti mug phag pa gsad par bya// 'di la rnam pa gsum yod de// chu yi gnyer ma 'dra ba yi// tshig gi 'thad pa sna tshogs kyis// phag pa'i spu rtsa 'khru ba tsam// des kyang chog par mi dgongs 'tshal// 'thad pa'i don go bsam pa yis// spang bya gnyen pos bcom pa yi// nges pa'i shes pa bskyed na yang*// gti mug mun pa bcom pa yin// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas na// de yi rjes su 'jug par bya//

// 85) ༄// phyag chen gyi nyams len mkha' 'gro'i srog snying*// oṃ swasti/ nyes pa thams cad rab zad cing*// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// gsum ldan bla ma rin po che// mnyam med dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum bsdus pa'i snying po/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud/ tshe 'di'am brgyud nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya nges pa'i man ngag byang chub kyi sems yin/ byang chub kyi sems la rnam pa gnyis/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis so// de la dang por kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar blangs pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher gyur pa/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung ngam bka' thams cad skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par bsdus pa snying por gyur pa/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems ji ltar sbyong ba dang*/ rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa khyed rang nyid mkhas shing*/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa lags/ 'on kyang 'dir nga 'bu'i bla ma dam pa'i bzhed pa ltar bgyid na/ spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa'i chos gong ma ltar yin yang*/ kha snying don gsum phyogs gcig tu btsugs nas/ lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum la g.yo dang sgyu med pa'i shugs kyis/ gzhan gang yang mi bsam par rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs na/ myur du 'grub pa la tshegs med gsungs pas/ sems rtse gcig tu 'bad par mdzad pa gal che bar go /'di ltar nyams su blangs pas gang la yang sems pa med par/ lus ngag yid gsum byang chub kyi sems gcig tu gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po des/

theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ dben pa'i gnas su 'bol ba'i stan bting*/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas par byas nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ro myong tsam zhig bsam/ de nas snga ma'i byang chub kyi sems skyes pa gzhir bzhag tu gyur pa 'dir yun ring rab cig bsgom/ byang chub kyi sems des 'phangs nas lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ spyi bor bla ma dam pa bsgom zhing sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gsol ba gdab/ de nas 'khor ba'i phung khrol gyi rtsa ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa bde skyid kyi 'byung gnas/ sems rig pa rig rig tur tur po 'di yin te/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gzeb chen las/ skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces pa dang*/ tshad mar gyur pa bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan pa/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mkhan po dang bla ma slob dpon bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod dgu ma lus thams cad 'byung ba yi// rin chen byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa la sogs pa bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad du 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems 'di yin par gsungs pas// ༈ //ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// sems la sems nyid bzhag la bsgom// de ltar yun ring goms pa 'am// yang na sems kyi skad cig la// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba// gang la bstod cing gang gis bstod// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhin du// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// de ltar gsungs pa nyid kyi don// go zhing nges shes skye ba yin// de ltar go ba'i ting 'dzin la// rgyun chad med par goms gyur pas// mnyam gzhag je ring je ring 'gro// rjes thob je thung je thung 'gro// mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis med pa// 'od gsal chos sku bde chen yang*// ring por mi thogs thob gyur na// ting 'dzin gzhan lta smos ci dgos// de yi phyir na skyes chen khyod// rtag tu rang sems bsgom par zhu// rin po che yi thugs kyi gter// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying 'di// yi ger bris par gyur pa la// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// bzod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag rnams// brtse bas bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// rdzogs so//

// 86) ༄// sems babs la gnas na man ngag go zhes pa// sems babs la gnas na man ngag go /blo drang por zhogs la nga la nyon// pha 'jig rten mgon pos dbang bskur zhing*// skye 'gro mang po'i re gnas mchog /bla ma dam pa rje btsun de// la kha'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// mtho dman 'bring gsum rnam rtog gis// yar khyer mar khyer ga la rigs// yab cig rje yi pha phogs la// bstan pa ri rab lta bur mdzod// zab pa rgya mtsho lta bur mdzod// dkar ba gangs ri lta bur mdzod// dag pa shel sgong lta bur mdzod// gtsang ba gang gā lta bur mdzod// rang don gzhan don grub par mdzod// rang skyid gzhan skyid gnyis ka mdzod// 'di dag 'grub pa'i mthun pa'i rkyen// dang por go cha brtan po gon// bar du thabs la mkhas par spyad// zab pas srog snying sba bar bya// thabs la mkhas pa'i gdams ngag ni// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams// lus dang longs spyod dge ba rnams// sems can kun la gtang ba dang*// de bsrung dag pa spel ba zhes// ma bsrungs gtang rgyu mi rnyed pas// thams cad sgrol dang dus dpog che// zil gyis ma non la sogs pas// bsags nas gtong bar byed pa yin// des na 'jig rten mgon po yang*// zhi sgom la sogs mkhas pa rnams// nyo tshong dgos pa sgrub par byed// mod pa'i dus su tshol gsog byed// dkon pa'i dus su gtong bar byed// zil gyis mnan nas bsgrub pa byed// rang dang rang gi gnyen 'dun 'khor// lto gos gnyis la gyong bskur nas// thams cad sgrub pa byed la dgyes// rta dang thab ka kha smras gsum// rdzas dang dam pa'i sad du che// //

87) ༄// log pa'i brtul zhugs spong ba'i rang sems gros 'debs// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyi ni mir gyur ngan pa rgyags gyur cing*// kun gyis bkur zhing phye gtor char phab pas// nor ba'i lam zhugs rmongs pa bdag nyid la// bskul bar gyur gyis rang la brtse bas nyon// khyed sngon 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams gyur cing*// rigs drug sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs su rung ba yis// brlags par gyur pa cung zad ma bsams sam// skyid par gsol ba'i mi lus 'di thob kyang*// soms dang rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang*// dgra bos gtser zhing gnyen dang bral ba dang*// 'khyags shing ltogs pas rnam par ma rung sogs// ji 'dra yin pa sems la gzhig pa thong*// gang tshe khyod ni 'jig rten mgon po yis// thugs rje'i lcags kyur drangs par gyur nas kyang*// bde dang thar pa'i lam du bkod gyur cing*// dben pa ri bo'i sul na gnas bcas shing*// nyer len phyin ci log gi bag chags rnams// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po mi bzad pa// nyon mongs drag po'i stobs las byung rnams kyi// rkyen gyis sad par byas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// shin tu mnar zhing 'o dod cher 'bod de// rang nyid rnam par mnar ba'i sdug bsngal gyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dran nas dam bcas pa// lus 'di zhig kyang zhig par 'dra ba la// 'gro ba'i don du zhig kyang ci ma rung*// lus srog sems can don du gtang ngo zhes// bla ma dpang por bzhag nas dam bcas shing*// sngon tshe khyod la sdom pa gang blangs pa// de nas sangs rgyas thob par ma gyur tshe// cis kyang bdag gis spyad par bya 'o zhes// yid la brnag par gyur pa'i dus 'dir brjod// mdze can la sogs nad kyis mnar ba dang*// dbul zhing 'phongs pas shin du nyen gyur cing*// skye dgu skyabs dang mgon dang bral ba dang*// skyid sdug lhan cig spyod par dam bcas shing*// slong phor nang du dang por gang rnyed pas// phongs par gyur la dang por sbyin byas nas// de yi 'og tu rang gis bza' bar bsams// deng 'dir rgyal po'i dpal la longs spyod cing*// phun sum tshogs pas khyim rnams gang gyur kyang*// shākya'i dge slong drang srong chen po rnams// gus pas slong du phyin yang mi ster ba// kyi hud khyed kyi bu smad gang na yod// shākya'i rgyal pos byin gyis brlabs gyur cing*// ston pa'i bstan la phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// 'dzam bu'i gling gi bsod nams can rnams kyi// rdzas dang yo byad zad du dogs pa nges// 'phangs pa'i bu dang chung ma gnyen la yang*// chags par mi bya chos la gtong bsams kyang*// dad cing snying nas blo phugs gtod pa rnams// snying ni rje rje skad du ci bya zhes// gtan gyi gros mdun rang la 'dri ba rnams// dam pa'i chos phyir gtong bar mi byed cing*// sngon gyi drin chags yod pa'i dpung snyems shing*// khe dang tshong spogs rtsol sgrub sna tshogs dang*// tha mal las kyis snying nas mgu gyur pa// glen pa khyod kyi gtan srid 'di yin nam// gang tshe khyod kyis lus kyang gtong bsams nas// gtan gyi bde zhing skyid pa tshol gyur zhing*// sangs rgyas ye shes min pas mi ngoms pa'i// slob ma skal ldan drung du lhags gyur cing*// lus dang srog la ltos pa med rnams kyis// gsol ba 'debs shing drung du lhags gyur cing*// rdzun dus mang pos slob ma mgo bskor nas// gnyid dang bza' btung bre mo'i gtam rnams la// chags shing zhen par gyur pa'i blun po khyod// 'gro ba'i bde skyid bcad nas phung gyur pa'i// rul pa'i lus 'dis khyod la ci zhig bya// thugs gnyis dbyer med chos rje rin po che// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtha' yas pa// kun tu bzang po yangs pa nam mkha'i mdzod// rin chen dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i phyir// 'gro ba mtha' dag smin par dam bcas pa// bsdu ba rnam bzhis smin par mi byed pa'i// ri khrod pa khyod e ma a re bzang*// e ma sngon tshe khyod kyis dam bcas pa// rin chen shākya'i rgyal po'i rjes zhugs te// gtso mchog gong ma'i spyod pa rmad byung ba// lhar bcas 'jig rten gtsug gi nor bu mchog

/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'byung ba'i gnas// bsil ba'i dri yis 'jig rten tshim byed pa// bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog /thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba yi// tshul khrims rin chen dri ma med pa yi// rang rgyud shin tu rnam par dag gyur cing*// thub pa'i bstan pa bdag gis bzung ngo zhes// yid la cung zad bsam par gyur pa las// nga 'dir 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la// rnam par chags shing shin tu chags gyur pas// nyon mongs spyod pa mthar thug spyod gyur pa// khyod kyis tshe gcig snying por bsgrubs gyur pa'i// 'bras bu ngan song gsum po cang yin nam// gang tshe khyod ni zhed par gyur pa'i tshe// mi bzad sdug bsngal drag po 'di 'dra ba// gzhan gyi don du spyad kyang ci ma rung*// chos phyir shi yang nam yang shi la rag /chos phyir sdug bsngal chen po bya bsams kyang*// dus 'dir de yang byang chub mi 'grub cing*// lus ngag yid kyi mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// rang bzhin shes nas bzod par mi byed cing*// nga dang khyod ces dgra zun phyogs ris kyis// snang srid dgra bor byed pa'i brtul zhugs 'dis// rang la phan du re 'am gzhan skyid dam// kyi hud log pa'i brtul zhugs spong bar gyis// mnyam nyid ngang las bzang ngan thams cad kun// g.yo ba med par gang gis rtogs gyur pa// chags sdang ma skyes bzod pa'i go bgos nas// bslab pa gsum gyis legs par rgyud sbyangs shing*// kun kyang sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs mchog 'chang ba// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par 'dod rnams la// rgyu mtshan med par khro zhing 'khrugs pa ni// gti mug klu yi rgyal po rab 'khrugs te// chags sdang sprin gyi dkyil 'khor rab bsdus nas// tshig rtsub rdo rje'i ser ba phab nas ni// rang gzhan dge ba'i lo tog bcom pa ni// bsgrub bya ci zhig bsgrub pa soms dang kye// de tshe khyod kyi lta ba gang du song*// khyod kyi sgom pa des ko nam zhig stongs// nyes tshogs skyon rnams legs pa'i yon tan du// gser 'gyur rtsi ltar nam zhig 'gyur ba yin// tshe thung 'di la sangs rgyas bsgrub bo zhes// brtson 'grus drag pos 'bad par dam bcas pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyod pa rmad byung ba// pha rol phyin drug byas dang byed par bskul// rjes su yi rang dge ba rgya chen la// glen pa ci phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mi byed// gzhan dang rang la sbyin pa sbyin pa'i tshe// rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar ni nges byas shing*// dus gsum dkon mchog rang la bstims nas ni// shin tu chung bar gyur pa'i dngos po rnams// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa'i rjes 'gro bas// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams dang mnyam pa yi// mtha' yas rlabs chen rnams su bsgrubs nas kyang*// gus pas blangs shing dga' bas gzengs bstod do// byang chub sems kyi sa bon btab nas ni// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen sdom pa gang rung dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug bskyed rdzogs zab mo dang*// rang gzhan gdod nas yod dang byas pa yi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo ba yis// byang chub mchog tu smin par byed pa la// dga' zhing re nas drung du 'ongs pa rnams// bde gshegs byin gyis brlabs kyi khyim du ni// rin chen dpal dang 'dra bar byung ba la// dga' zhing smin par mi byed sdig can khyod// byas pa drin du mi bzo khyad gsod cing*// che chung nor la bzang ngan bsam pa yis// chags sdang dug stobs 'phel bar byed pa 'di// khyod la bsten pa bzang por nam zhig 'gyur// dam tshig 'dzin cing mgu bar gyur pa rnams// yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba brjod gyur pas// sprin la mtshan ma btsugs shing re ba yis// slong du 'ongs pa'i skye bo bzang ngan rnams// ji ltar 'tshams pa'i dngos pos tshims byas shing*// sngar dang 'dra bar smin par mi byed cing*// phangs pa'i dngos po lag pa brgyud nas byin// mi chen khyod ni gzim skyor nang du gzims// le lo can khyod gdul bya'i skye bo rnams// nam zhig grol zhing smin par 'gyur ba yin// gser gyi ri bo'i drung na lhags pa bzhin// sna tshogs 'dod pa'i drung du lhags gyur cing*// thub pa'i bstan la brtul zhugs sgrub 'dod pa// de la bsod nams dam par mi blta zhing*// rab tu 'byin pa phyi par mi blta zhing*// rgyu mtshan ci yod ka ca zad dogs sam// 'dzam gling 'di yi rdzas dang yo byad rnams// zad du dogs pa'i khyi rgan nam po khyod// dgod re bro na dgon pa'i wa mo 'dra// don med bla bos rtag tu dus 'da' zhing*// don med bya bas rnam par g.yengs gyur nas// gnyid rmugs bde ba snying por byed pa yis// khams 'khrugs sdug bsngal 'bras bu smin gyur pas// rang gzhan don la nyams par gyur pa yi// sku mtshams dam pos rang gzhan gnyis ka bslus// blun rmongs le lo can khyod nam zhig na// 'khor ba'i skyon rnams spangs shing yon tan gyis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par byed par 'gyur// dpal ldan bla ma de la ngo re tsha// ji ltar sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// dgon par gnas shing sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis// 'du 'dzi spros pa thams cad rab bcad de// zhi gnas lhag mthong brtson pas rnal 'byor rnams// ri khrod bsten pas mi yi la du rnams// khyi dang 'dra ba bdag gir byed lugs 'dis// dben pa'i gnas su zang zing 'du 'dzi sgrub// bsam gtan zas med dga' bde btung ba med// dad gus sems med rtogs pa'i pha nor med// sgrub pa don med 'di dang phyi ma med// 'di yi ming ni 'jig rten stong skyel yin// ngan par song ba da rung ma tshor ram// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab zab mo yis// dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes zab mo ni// dngos bsam brgyud pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa las// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par mi byed cing*// bsten par gyur kyang gus par byed mi 'dod// chos ldan skyes bu rnams la mi dga' bas// chos dang 'brel ba'i gtam rnams mi thos te// sngon du thos pa rnams kyang brjed par gyur// tshe 'di lhur len spros la dga' ba dang*// chos dang mi mthun grogs dang 'grogs gyur cing*// yang yang khyim dang 'dre bar gyur pa yis// chos la nam yang blo kha mi phyogs shing*// sdig pa'i grogs po'i lag tu song ba des// dge ba'i bshes dang phrad par mi 'gyur na// skyes bu dam pa ji ltar mnyes par byed// skyes bu dam pa mnyes par ma gyur na// tshegs chung don po che yi dam chos rnams// don rnams gang las rnyed par 'gyur ba soms// rab tu zhi ba'i ting 'dzin ma rnyed na// shin tu zab mo'i sangs rgyas ye shes kyi// gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par mi 'gyur te// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rnams kyang 'byung mi 'gyur// de ltar gyur na thos bsam sgom gsum gyi// shes rab 'byung gnas dam pa mi rnyed cing*// shes rab 'chal ba 'jig rten mi chos dang*// phyin ci log gi bstan bcos rnams dang ni// glu dang sgrung dang mtho dman sa phyogs kyi// lo rgyus sna tshogs shes rab 'chal ba'i rgyu// dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon gyis brlags gyur nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i mun khrod thar med du// 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba'i skyabs gnas su zhig yod// khyod lta bla ma dam pa mi dran cing*// zang zing 'du 'dzi rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan thams cad bslu bar byed pa 'di// rang la rang snying rje ba ma mchis sam// dus chen 'di la don chen bsgrub pa yi// phun sum 'di 'dra gzhan du mi rnyed pa// don chen bsgrub la nan tan mdzad par rigs// rang nyid rang skyon med pa gsang nas ni// 'khor gyis bzang por byed pa mi srid de// khyu mchog song ba'i rjes su 'brang ba'i gnag

/ya yo med par 'brang ba ji bzhin du// 'khor rnams kun kyang rjes su 'brang ba yin// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan gyis// 'phags pa dga' bo rab tu byung ba yis// myur du dgra bcom chen por 'gyur ba dang*// ston pa'i bka' bzhin tshul khrims bsrungs na yang*// 'jigs skyob legs smon bsam pas gnas pa'i tshe// dge slong khyed rnams khong du chud par gyis// 'di la mya ngan 'da' ba'i bsam pa med pas na// su yang 'di dang lhan cig gnas par mi bya zhes// ston pa thugs rje can gyis gsungs pa dang*// lta sgom spyod pa gcig par ma gyur dang*// dge slong rnams kyang dge tshul dge bsnyen dang*// ston pas nub brang bsrung bar gsungs pa la// gtan gyi skyabs gnas rtag tu bsgom pa yi// skyon dang sdig sgrib nyon mongs me chen gyis// rjes zhugs slob ma phung bar 'gyur bas na// slob dpon 'brel pa brtag pa mang po gsungs// nor bu chu 'dam rnyog gseb bcug pa bzhin// bdag ni mthong dang thos dang dran pas kyang*// 'gro ba'i nyes tshogs nyon mongs dag gyur cig /yon tan phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa'i rigs// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa rnams// thams cad pha rol phyin pa drug tu gcig /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// ji bzhin nyams su blangs pas so so yis// sgrubs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pas na// bdag nyid chen por 'gyur ba 'dod pa dang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yis// drug po 'di la snying por nyams su blang*// rang snying dpang du tshugs shig rje btsun pa// phan sems skyo ngal ma mdzad sems pa che// sos dal le lo ma mdzad re ltos pa// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong 'bar ba bzhin// 'gro ba'i re 'dod bskong bar byed pa yi// thabs la mkhas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du// rang gis rang nyid cis kyang mdzad du gsol// dbang che mthu che zil che zhing*// rnyed dang bkur sti che ba dang*// snyan dang grags pa che ba yi// chen por rlom pa'i rje btsun la// sus kyang zhu don gsol bar dka'// rang sems gros 'debs zhes bya ba'i// yi ge bris par gyur pa 'dis// rang gi nyes pa'i skyon tshor bas// yon tan snying por byed par shog/

// 88) ༄// khyod kyis 'di la myong ba ye ma skyes zhes pa'i gsung mgur// na mo rat+na gu ru dharmā ka ya ni/ kye kye rnal 'byor pa rnams nga la nyon// rang rig spros dang bral bar khyod kyis shes mod kyang*// lus dang snang ba'i dngos po khyod kyis shes pa med// kye kye rnal 'byor pa rnams brtson pas nga la nyon// sha khrag rus pa rtsa dang chu rgyus dang*// shin tu mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu gnyis// rin chen byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// dri med rgyal ba'i skur yang ma bsgyur zhing*// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor tshogs kyis gtams gyur zhing*// bde chen lhan cig skyes la longs spyod pa// 'di la cung zad khyed kyis mthong ba med// kye kye rnal 'byor pa rnams gus pas nga la nyon// rang byung byang chub sems dang dbyer med pa// snang dang mi snang brtan g.yo'i rang bzhin kun// nang gi rten 'brel gang gis gang bsgrub pa// sgyu ma'i rnam thar phra ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi// rten 'brel zab mo 'di la 'phrigs ma tshud// kye kye rnal 'byor pa rnams brtson pas nga la nyon// sdug bsngal phung po sa rdo 'dra 'di la// rtsa gsum 'dus mdo ye shes thab khung du// rlung lnga dbang du byed pa'i sbud pa yis// ma g.yengs brtson pa'i yid kyis gtsub gyur na// rang byung bde ba chen po'i gnas mchog nas// 'chi med bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgyun phab ste// sdug bsngal bde ba chen por bsgyur byed pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos 'di la// da rung khyed kyis khu 'phrig

dogs g.yeng zod pa med// dran dang 'dun pas rnal 'byor pa rnams nga la nyon// longs spyod 'khor lo shin tu nyams dga' bar// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// yod min med min yod med ma yin pa// zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i rdzu 'phrul la// dpa' bo rnams kyi spyod pa rmad byung ba// 'di la khyod kyis myong ba ye ma skyes// 'od gsal spros dang bral ba dri med pa// gti mug gnyid las gzhan du ma mchis shing*// de yang ma yin de las gzhan du yang*// rnyed par mi 'gyur spangs thob med pa yi// mi bskyod rdo rje dus gsum sangs rgyas pa// dug lnga'i thabs 'di khyed kyis ro ma myong*// rgyal ba rnams dang grub thob gong ma'i gsung*// stong par gsungs pa'i chos 'di thams cad la// nges pa'i shes pas ngo mtshar skye na yang*// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras rnams// rtog pa'i bye brag mtho dman sna tshogs las// 'di las 'di dag so sor nges 'byung zhes// rgyal ba'i dam chos zab mo 'di dag la// gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa can gyis shes pa med// kye kye rnal 'byor pa rnams dang bas nga la nyon// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chos skur bsgyur byed cing*// yon tan phrin las rgyun chad med pa yi// bla ma rin chen gtsug gis bkur gyur na// lus ngag yid gsum gnas gyur rten 'brel gyis// mthar thug sku gsum tshe 'dir thob par bu khyod mdzod// // 89) ༄// chos rnams kyi rkyen bzhi bshad pa zhes bya ba// zab dang rgya che dpag dka' ba// dus gsum mtha' med sems can ni// rgya dang tshad las 'das pa 'o// de yi rang bzhin zab pa ste// skye 'gag gnas gsum med pa 'o// de rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa// blo las 'das par dpag par dka'// ༈ //rgyu rkyen bdag rkyen dmigs pa'i rkyen// de ma thag pa'i rkyen dang bzhi// 'khor 'das blo yi chos rnams kun// rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'dis// cir yang snang du btub pas na// bdag rkyen gzhan gyis gar bstan pa// dmigs pa so sor skye ba ste// dmigs pa de yi 'bras bu ni// de ma thag pa'i rkyen yin no//

// 90) ༄// sgom pa rdo rje ye shes la bskur ba'i bka' brgyud chos 'byung snying bsdus// chos kun gdod nas skyon med mkha' ltar rnam dag gzigs// gnyis su med pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho ltar zab pas// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba 'chi ba med pa'i dbyings su 'god mdzad pa// bka' drin chen po gong ma rnams kyi zhabs pad 'dud// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho yis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad smin pa'i gzhir gyur pa// mtshan tsam thos na bsod nams dpag med gter gyur pa// dus rnams rtag tu bka' drin rjes su dran par bya/ spyir 'gro ba yongs la bka' drin che ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' lags tshul du gda'/ de yang ji ltar bka' drin che na/ dang po rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems skyed/ bar tu 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong kyi bar du sems can thams cad byang chub rin po che la 'god pa'i go cha chen po rab tu bgos nas/ bskal pa dpag tu med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu sku gsum dang ye shes rnam pa lngar shar nas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar tu sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyis/ 'gro ba ma lus pa byang chub rnam pa gsum la 'god pa'i bka' drin che ba lags tshul du gda'/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten khams la bka' drin che ba ni/ nged kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa lags tshul du gda'/ de yang ji ltar bka' drin che na/ snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos khyad par du byas nas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du brtson 'grus kyi shugs bcad du med pa'i stobs kyis/ bskal pa grangs med pa rnam pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tha mar rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du srod la bdud btul/

tho rangs ye shes kyi mes shes bya'i bud shing ma lus pa bsregs nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas/ rigs can rnam pa gsum gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo rin po che rnam pa gsum bskor/ 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin che ba lags tshul du gda'/ ston pa de dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas bka' drin che ba ni/ bka' bsdu ba po chen po rnams sam/ 'o skol lho'i 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la bka' drin che ba ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras sam/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med sku mched la sogs pa lags par gda'/ 'khor 'das thams cad la bka' drin che ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa sku gsum ye shes rnam pa lnga'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa de bka' drin che ba lags par gda'/ bcom ldan 'das des gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po de'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang sangs mi rgya bar dgongs shing*/ sbas pa'i gsang ba thams cad ston pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po til+li pa zhes bya ba'i skur sprul nas/ sprul pa bye ba dpag tu med pas rdo rje theg pa sbas pa'i gsang ba thams cad kha phye/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpag tu med pa gcig byung nas/ 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pas bka' drin che ba lags tshul du gda'/ de'i slob ma slob dpon chen po dpal ldan nā ro pa zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling yongs kyi rgyan/ lnga brgya pa rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'gran gyi do zla dang bral ba/ bi ka ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang du mkhas pa chen po lnga brgya'i sgo glegs pa chen po bzhi'i yang chen por gyur pa/

lo bcu gnyis su dka' ba chen po rnam pa bcu gnyis spyad nas/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas pa las/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa brnyes pa/ da lta nged kyi jo bo rje la sogs pa chen po'i chen por gyur pa thams cad kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs kyi bar du sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa de kun bka' drin che ba lags par gda'/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir bka' drin che ba ni/ rnam pa gsum tsam lags par gda'/ dang por bka' drin che ba ni/ rgyal po mes dbon rnam pa gsum/ bar du bka' drin che ba ni/ bla chen po mu 'dzu dgongs pa rab gsal/ de'i mkhan po dbus pa mi bzhi dang*/ gtsang pa mi gnyis kyis bstan pa'i me ro mdo smad kyi khams nas bslangs nas bka' drin che ba lags par gda'/ tha mar bka' drin che ba ni/ gleng lugs mi 'dra ba mang zhig gda' na yang*/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che jo bo rje lha gcig gis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa chos spyi dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid thos pa dang bsam pa'i yul du gyur pa thams cad la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lo tsā ba la sogs pa rnams bka' drin che ba lags par gda'/ de ltar lags mod kyi/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags sde snod rin po che gsum gyi bcud phyung ba/ don gyi snying po bla na med pa de/ bla ma mar pa lho brag pa/ bsod nams dang smon lam gyi shugs bsam gyis mi khyab pas lho brag tu skye ba bzhes nas/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po thugs la 'khrungs nas mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi snod dang ldan pa dpag tu med pa 'bras bu tshad med pa'i chos mang pos don mi 'grub par gzigs nas/

yul rgya gar gyi ma ga ta'i sa phyogs/ puṣa pa ha ri'i dgon par slob dpon chen po dpal ldan nā ro pa'i drung du/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos theg pa chen po gsang sngags la sogs pa sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum la rgyud sbyangs shing*/ 'pho ba dang grong 'jug la mnga' brnyes shing*/ 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa de/ mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir byon nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bshad brgyud dang sgrub brgyud rnam pa gnyis ni dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ brtson 'grus can bsgom pas sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ le lo can ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ snyoms las can rtogs pas sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag la sogs pa gsungs pas/ rgyud ma smin pa thams cad smin pa dang*/ smin pa grol ba dang*/ grol ba byang chub thob par mdzad pa'i bla ma nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu de bka' drin che ba lags tshul du gda'/ bla ma chen po de'i bshad brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gzhung pa dang*/ mes ston tshon po dang*/ dge bshes tshur ston dbang nge la sogs pa rnams kyis/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sbas pa'i gsang ba thams cad kha phye/ mi gsal ba thams cad ni gsal bar byas/ mi shes pa thams cad ni shes par byas shing*/ rnam par phye ste rgya cher 'grel par mdzad pas/ da ltar bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod pa byung*/ gong ma de rnams bka' drin che ba lags tshul du gda'/ sgrub brgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ rje mi la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po des/ dang por dka' ba dpag tu med pas mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i bla ma mnyes par mdzad nas/ tshig don gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gdams ngag /'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi lta bu'i mos gus tshad du phyin pas ljags kyi dbang po la bstar nas/

nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa bde ba chen po phul du phyin pa'i sku rgyas shing*/ dka' ba rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis don gyi snying po nyams su blangs pas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa/ nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de bka' drin che ba lags par gda'// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// chos rgyal 'gran zla med pa yi// sprul pa'i sku yi rnam par grags// mi nub rgyal mtshan chen po yi// yon tan brjod par ga la nus// dgos don zhe 'dod smras pa'o// de'i slob ma rje sgam po pa chen po/ sngon thub pa chen po nyid las lung bstan pa thob pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la sku rab tu gshegs nas/ thos pa dang bsam pas rgyud sbyangs shing*/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi bstan pa'i rim pa rgyud la skyes/ rje btsun chen po mi la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po las/ sems nyid 'od gsal mngon du mdzad nas/ phyag rgya chen po ngo sprod kyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po 'dzin par byed pa'i 'khor lnga brgya las mi nyung ba smin pa dang grol bar mdzad cing*/ snyan pa'i ba dan gyis sa chen po khyab pas/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad de/ des na bla ma rin po che bka' drin che ba lags tshul du gda'/ de'i sras rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa bka' rab 'byams la shes rab kyi snang ba phyogs med du rgyas pas/ lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ lung rig thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi gzhung dang man ngag thams cad la mkhyen pa mtha' yas/ rjai sa skya ba chen po'i sras rnams kyi nang nas rgyud tshod mthon por gyur pas/ dus rtag tu bde ba chen po'i ngang la rgyun chad pa med pa de/ rje sgam po pa'i spyan sngar byon nas/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i lta ba chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud de/

ston pa spyod pa'i tshul khrims rin po che mthar phyin pa'i mdzad pas/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag brgyad brgya lhag bskyangs shing*/ grub thob nam mkha'i skar ma tsam byung ste/ skye 'gro thams cad thar pa'i lam la bkod pas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po de bka' drin che ba lags par gda'/ dpon bsgom pa rdo rje seng ge khams na sdums mdzad kyin yod tsam na/ rje rin po ches mdzad nas bskur ba'o// // 91) ༄// sku rten gy-i bzo bkod rnams sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin bya dgos pa// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// bla med dkon mchog gsum po la// phyag 'tshal mchod dang byin gyis rlobs// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// tshogs chen yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir// mos gus can gyi yon bdag dang*// byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzo yis// sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams sgrub// de yang rang dga' gzu lum dang*// ras chod rtsal gyis mi 'jug ste// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang*// dus gsum 'phags pa thams cad las// sangs rgyas nyid las mkhas pa gzhan// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas// sangs rgyas gsungs pa bzhin du bya// rje btsun phyag na rdo rje dang*/ gnas brtan chen po shā ri'i bu// tshangs pas zhus pa la sogs kyi// rjes su 'brangs nas bsgrub par bya// shā ri'i bus zhus tshad kyi gzhung*// mkhas pa rnams kyis nor nas 'dug /gsang gnas gsus pa dkyil krung 'di// lugs ma rnams la gcig nas mchi// ras ris dkyil krung lhag nas mchi// sku stod thal gong rgyas pa yis// phyag ring chu zheng gab par 'ong*// chag tshad ring thung gshis las ma 'gal bar// dbu la sogs pa skyes pa yis// gzi brjid dpal dang ldan par 'ong*// sku sha'i rgyan dang sku rags rnams// skra byid yi dwags 'dra ba yis// ring thung tshad dang ma 'gal yang*// lha bzo yon bdag sprang por 'gyur// des na thub pa chen po'i gsung*// nan tan chen pos bsgrub par bya// dbu dang mgul la sogs pa yi// thig rnams legs par ma btab na// rang bzo'i rtsal la re na yang*// ya yo kyag kyog ring thung gis// tshar ba'i dus na chud nag bzos// spyan dang shangs dang snyan rtse dang*// phyag zhabs rnams kyi sen rtse'i sgros// mig rko byir bar mi bya ste// spu gri pad+ma'i so ltar bzhag

/spra bzo dus nas de ltar bsgrub// krung nge sing nge legs par mchi// spyan dang shangs dang dpral ba'i dbyes// mkhur ba og rko la sogs pa// sha sna ji lta yod pa bzhin// brko dang bdar dang phyi bar bya// sha srul ma log drang bar mchi// rgyan rnams dbus ma sbom pa dang*// mtha' na cung zad phra na dbyes// pad+ma gang byung gong rgyud la// ze'u 'bru mu tig che ba lags// mdor na 'di yi rgyan la sogs// mthon por bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// cung zad sbom na legs pa yin// mi 'tsham pa dang bug pa dang*// mtho dman ci bya cha med na// rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rgyan rnams kyis// bzo sna kun tu bsgyur ba yis// khyad chos lta bur mngon nas mchi// mdor na rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun// 'di ltar byas na mi 'ong zhes// shes pa'i 'og tu ma chud cing*// the tshom za ba thams cad la// spra tshil 'jim pa la sogs la// dben pa'i gnas su gang 'thad blta// 'thad pa rang gis bsgrub pa dang*// gzhan la kha ta bya ba gces// brko dang phyi bdar gang byed kyang*// dang por dma' sa gting nas bya// 'bur sa shugs kyis legs nas mchi// dpe dang dpe mdzer lhan ne kun// lcags la byed du mi btub ste// btsa' yis zos nas 'khrol bar 'ong*// zangs dang ra gan nyid la bya// de yang phal cher zangs la bya// bzo che legs par med pa yis// legs par 'dod kyang mi 'ong ste// lag rdum brag la 'dzegs pa 'dra// ji ltar dgos pa'i bzo cha rnams// legs par bsgrub pa gal che ste// mdung dang ral gri gri la sogs// bzo cha'i rgyu la ngan pa yin// mnye lcags sum lcags bzang po la// mgar ba mkhas pas bzhu btul bya// cha spyad gang la gang dgos pa// sna tshogs mang po mang po bya// sag brdar rigs pa mi gcig pa// rku bo chu sag 'dra ba yis// pad+ma'i rked par bcug la bdar// gug po bya mchu 'dra ba yis// pad lce'u bar du bcug la bdar// dgye leb dpral pa 'dra ba yis// ngos dang logs la bdar bar bya// mgar ba'i sag brdar lta bu yis// ci rigs phyogs su bdar bar bya// skyungs dang gug po thams cad la// gzhung shing 'khrang po yod par bya// ste'u kha ma sta re ltar// mthug po rno bar bsgrub pa gces// 'di rnams zin nas 'dag pa la// dpe yi rim pa sna tshogs pas// mgar ba dag la bstan pa bsgrub// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yis// 'di dang phyi ma bar do yi// don chen sgrub pa'i dus 'di yin// le lo ltem rkyang ma mdzad cig

/gdung rten thams cad grags phyug ma// lha bzo thams cad gser gzungs ma// lugs ma thams cad lda chog ma// shes rab brtson dang brtags las byung*// 'di ni 'di yi lugs yin zhes// blun po gzu lum smra ba kun// ma shes thug pa'i gab sa yin// bzo dang rig pa'i gnas rnams kun// thams cad rig pa 'ba' zhig yin// //

92) ༄// dpon lha bzo ba rnams la bzo bkod tshad ldan dgos par gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dpon lha bzo rnams la zhu na/ mig nyams na long ba/ sna nyams na mdze bo/ sgros nyams na rgad po/ sha nyams na sprang rgan du chas pa lags pas/ mdzub mo g.yon pas 'di rnams bskyab la/ g.yas pas hrad hrad bya'o// sangs rgyas kyi yin pa/ mi'i 'dug lugs ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrub pa yin/ thub pa chen po'i sku'i rnam par 'gyur pa/ ci mdzad pa gang yin pas lus kyi rnam par 'gyur ba ltar bya/ mtshan dang dpe byad ces bya ba de yang*/ sgros ma shor ba ris su thon pa la zer ba yin/ khyad par gyi chos su ro stod cung zad che ba dang*/ phyag ring ba ma gtogs pa gzhan med do// thub pa chen po de nyid kyang*/ gdul bya gang dang mthun pa'i sku// sgeg cing dpa' la yid du 'ong*// mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms pas// gdul bya kun gyi dang ba 'dren// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sku yin pas// nyes skyon kun dang bral ba'i phyir// de mthong 'gro ba don yod 'gyur// spyan dang shangs dang snyan shal dang*// dbu dang zhal gyi dkyil 'khor sogs// chag tshad gshis las ma 'gal zhing*// phyag zhabs sku yi bzhugs tshul rnams// sgros dang sha lhu ma log cing*// sdom pa 'byung ba'i tshad yig ltar// tshul dang ldan na bkra shis pas// khyed kyis de ltar bsgrub pa gces// ༈ //lha chung bzo yi mtshan nyid ni// snyan dang snyan shal phyag mgo dang*// zhabs mgo thal gong shin tu legs// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor cung zad thung*/ mgur gyi bum pa 'bring po tsam// dbu yi mdun ngos leb mor shor// brang zhom skra mtshams yo bar gda'// dpral ba'i dbyes chung rgu bor thal// g.yon pa'i zhabs 'phyang ma legs pa'i// rnam par bzhag pa 'di dag la// legs par dgongs pa gzigs par zhu// jo bo chen po a ti shas// rgya gar shar phyogs lha bzo ba// mkhas pa chen po spyan drangs nas// thugs dam gcig pu bzhengs pa la// lan grangs bcu gsum bar dag tu// yang dang yang du bshig pa yin// mkhas pa khyed la brnyas bcos min// bzo dang bya ba thams cad la// bdag po ci dga' byed pa de// 'jig rten yongs kyi 'dug lugs yin//

// 93) ༄// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gter chen la phyag 'tshal zhes pa// rje dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gter// lhun grub mnyam rjes mi mnga' bas// 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong mdzad pa// mgon po snang mdzad phyag 'tshal lo// chos rnams rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul// kun kyang bsam par ston mdzad cing*// sems nyid chos sku ngo sprod pa// mkhyen mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas ma skyes blo dang bral// rnam dag 'od gsal chen po'i ngang*// spros pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// mi bskyod rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor 'das yum gyur lhan cig skyes// bde chen bcud kyis gsol mdzad cing*// yon tan gter kun stsol ba po// rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rgyal po skye 'jig med// gtum chen bdud dpung mtha' dag 'joms// dpa' bo zhags pa ral gris rol// mi yi mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor 'das rtsa ba rang rig 'di// ma myong stong nyid thams cad kyis// nam yang ma phan bden gsung ba// rnam par grol mdzad phyag 'tshal lo// // 94) ༄// yon bdag mi chen la bka' mi skyon par bsu 'dren dgos pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// dbu zhu grub pa'i don ched du// mi chen spyan drangs bos pa de// dad pa can gyi yon bdag gis// 'bul ba zhabs tog byed pa'i tshe// bka' skyon rgya gad byed pa ltar// mi chen po 'di la byar mi btub// chab tshwa sun gcig 'dren par zhu// mos gus byed pa'i slob ma la// ji ltar gsungs kyang btub pa ltar// mi chen po 'di la byar mi btub// bka' skyon zhe skyon mi mdzad zhu// drung na gnas pa'i nye gnas kyis// gus 'dud tshogs gsaug byed pa ltar// mi chen po 'di la byar mi btub// 'di la rdung rdeg mi mdzad zhu// cis kyang mas kyang thugs la thogs// // 95) ༄// tshogs gsog dang bsngo ba byed par gdams pa// cang shes na re 'di skad ces// ngas ni rdza mkhan de la ni// gser srang 'bum byin zer ba las// srog chags gang rnams phul ba yis// de yi rin gyis dge 'dun la// dam chos bsgrub pa'i rgyur gyur pa// de yi bsod nams phung po 'di// ci yi phyir na bsngo mi byed// don 'dis shes pa ngal sos gyur// sha la sogs pa de yang ngo*// bcom ldan rgyal sras lam pa las// dam chos 'di yi dran pa rnyed// byang chub sems dpa' chen po yi// sha rnams gang gis zos gyur pa// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba'i// nad sogs skyon dang bral nas kyang*// yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur ba 'di// e ma ngo mtshar che ba'i rmad// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa byas sam byed na ci// snang ba zas su za ba dang*// ku sā li yi tshogs gsog gi

/rgyu las 'bras bu gang 'byung ba// don 'di go ba'i rnal 'byor pa// nyin mtshan rtag tu bsgom par rigs// sdug bsngal phung po de nyid dang*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung de nyid dang*// sdug bsngal 'gog pa de nyid ces// thub pa'i dbang po bcom ldan gsungs// thugs rje chen po mchog ldan pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu ma lus pa// lus ni tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor te// sems ni sku gsum gnas su spar// don gyi gshin po bsngo ba las// lhag pa med pa gzhung gis shes// /// 96) ༄// dpal phag mo gru pa la nyid kyi 'dug lugs zur tsam zhu ba// oṃ swasti/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur cig /'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// sbyangs sdom ri khrod brtul zhugs 'dzin// shākya'i sras kyi dge slong gis// yon tan dpag med rin chen gyis// sku dang gsung dang thugs brgyan cing*// mnyam med dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// thugs dgongs bdud rtsi'i bcud thungs pas// rang gzhan don grub rin po che// grub thob dge ba'i bshes gnyen la// nyid kyi 'dug lugs zur tsam zhu// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// mi chos lha dam thams cad kyi// gdung brgyud gong na med par 'khrungs// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// bslab gsum rin thod bzhin du bkur// bla ma sangs rgyas lta bu yi// zhabs kyi pad+mo dam pa la// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// khyed kyis yon tan dpag med blangs// ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// dbus gtsang sa yi phyogs su byon// bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs bsgrubs// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// dpal ldan rin po che nyid kyis// thugs dgongs yon tan rgya mtsho yis// thugs kyi pad+mo rab bkang nas// bla ma dam pa'i bka' nyid kyis// shar phyogs gdul bya thams cad la// thugs kyis dgongs nas btang ba yi// thugs dgongs mtha' dag bsgrubs pa de// bdag dang lhar bcas 'jig rten la// thugs la btags so rang gi bu// ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che// ston pa'i gsung bzhin byas pa las// ston pa nyid dang 'dra bar mchi// ston pa'i gsung las mi 'da' ba// dam pa rnams kyi dam tshig las// tshu rol mthong ba'i 'jig rten pas// dman pa log par blta ba rnams// 'jig rten pa yi byed stangs la// bltas pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams// 'jig rten pa dang mnyam pa 'am// yang na de bas zhan par mchi// ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// mun pa thams cad sel ba ltar// khyed kyis gdul bya thams cad kyi// ma rig mun pa rnams bsal nas// ye shes snang ba bskyed du gsol// ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po'i chu// mtha' med gting dpag dka' ba ltar// smra bsam shes brjod yul min pa// blo yis brtag tu ma nus pas// gdul bya skal ldan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// khyed kyis gdul bya smin mdzad gsol// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po ches// yon tan dpag med gzhi rten mchog

/bla na med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// skal ldan gdul bya dpag med rnams// smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi rdzas// ri dang rgya mtsho lta bu yis// pir dang chu srin lta bu yi// lto ba bkang zhing tshims byas kyang*// 'dod yon 'khor ba'i ro sred kyis// sems can tshims par ga la nus// gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin ro// reg bya spong ba'i bstan pa yis// dpag med sems can smin mdzad gsol// dpa' bo stobs ldan brtul bzhugs can// rdo rje'i sku ldan 'jigs med pas// snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can gyi// mi shes bdud dang 'thab pa'i tshe// dam chos rin chen go bgos nas// nyes tshogs nyon mongs bdud dpung gi /dgra las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin// skyes mchog khyed kyis mdzad par zhu// sngon yang shin tu thugs la btags// da rung thugs la gdags par zhu// zhu rten pad+ma stong ldan gyi// na bza' rin po che gcig 'bul// cis kyang sku la bsnab par zhu// // 97) ༄// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhan chen seng seng ba la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ mkhan po chen po seng seng ba'i spyan sngar springs pa/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ dal 'byor gyi lus phun sum tshogs pa thob nas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po seng seng bas/ khyed nga la nye gnas su phul/ zhabs kyi drung du phyin nas kyang*/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum 'gran gyi do zla thams cad dang bral bas mnyes par byas/ chos nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na yang*/ khyed rang gi dad pa dang shes rab kyis gzhi bzung*/ nga yang mi gtum po gzu lum can/ chos min pa gang gis kyang mi mnyes pa'i rigs can du ni thal/

brdung ba dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ mtshang tshigs pa nas 'bru ba dang*/ drung na yod pa rnams la yang*/ o to dang o nyo med pa yin la/ khyed rang la yang de kho na bzhin du bgyis pas/ yon tan rin po che dpag tu med pa dang ldan par zhugs pa lags mod kyi/ dgos pa'i dus la bab pa na/ rang gzhan gang la phan par dka' bar 'dug mod kyi/ khyed kyis bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ 'gro ba mang po la phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ mkhas pa dang btsun po'i dgos pa mkhan po'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa khyad du 'phags pa rgyud la mnga' ba'i dgos pa/ bu slob rnams la khrid mdzad nas nyams rtogs skyes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pas/ dpag tu med pa 'gro ba smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa de bdag la shin tu bka' drin che/ da yang de kho na bzhin du 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po 'bad pa chen pos mdzad par zhu/ de ltar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*// sems can thams cad rang gi a mar yin nges/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la/ mgon dang gnas dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen ni med/ khyed nyid kyis 'gro ba smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i nus pa'i mthu ni mnga'/ rang gzhan thams cad skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal gyi chu bo bzhi las ni ma 'das/ 'jig rten 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa ji yod kyang rtswa kha'i zil pa'am/ nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra bas glo gtad ni med/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas dam pa'i chos rin po che ma gtogs pa gzhan med la/ dam pa'i chos thams cad bsdus pa'i snying por bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum yin/ de yang dang por lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid yon tan rin po che thams cad skye ba'i gzhi rten yin pas/ mkhan po chen por gyur nas rab tu byung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/

bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ral po gcig nyin zhag phrugs zhig bsrungs pas/ lha'i bu gso sbyong ral lta bu thugs la mnga' ba lags na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ brtson 'grus dang 'bad pa chen po rgyun chad med par mdzad par zhu/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po mang po 'di na yar la bskur mi dgos/ bu slob brgya phrag mang po dang*/ stong phrag mang po dang*/ bye ba mang po dang*/ bye ba brgya stong phrag mang po ci thon ltos/ de rnams kyi za rgyu 'thung rgyu mdzad par zhu// // 98) ༄// lung rig dang man ngag myong ba bzhis chos bstan pa// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'das dang ma byon da lta dang*// phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// bla med dam chos rin po che// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs pa de// ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis de// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid yin// rtogs ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// glen gtam tshig tu smras pa la/ de yi dho har brjod na yang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// lung dang rigs pa man ngag dang*// nyams su myong ba'i tshad ma bzhis// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// gdul bya skal ldan thams cad la// ngo sprod mdzad cing gsungs pa yi// sbram po brling ba tshig gcig smras pas kyang*// rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyangs pa yis// rtogs shing khong du mi chud na// gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos// 'khyer khur zang zing ka ca'i tshogs// khur cig pang gang mi 'tshol te// lo gcig bdag gis bla mchod bgyi// gnas dang dus kyis ma bskal na// drung du byon nas zhu bar rigs// // 99) ༄// bu dam pa slob ma'i yang rab rje btsun ras pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ nga'i bu dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rje btsun ras pa la springs pa/ nga'i bu sha mi za ba dang chang mi 'thung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ khyo rang gis ji ltar dgongs pa de ltar lags/

chang ni nyes pa kun gyi gzhi// sha ni pha ma bu yi sha// mkhas pa su zhig za 'thung byed// ji ltar gsung ba bzhin du zhu// snga ma gtum mo bsgom pa yis// dmu chu la sogs sel ba yin// sum khrid snga ma bzhin du bsgom// rgyu dang 'bras bu go ba dang*// 'phrigs tshud ces pa gcig pa yin// mngon du gyur pa sangs rgyas te// mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid du 'dod// // 100) ༄// dpal phag mo grur 'bul ba dang bcas pa phul ba'i zhu yig/ oṃ swasti/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas/ dal 'byor gyi lus phun sum tshogs pa ni thob/ rigs rgyud khyad par can du ni sku 'khrungs/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag du ni gyur/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpag tu med pa spyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po che ni bzhugs/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas thugs gtams par gyur kyang*/ sngon gyi smon lam dang 'brel ba zab mos nga la mos gus kyi shugs bcad du med pas drung du byon nas/ nga rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dge sbyor gyi thugs legs par gtams pa lags/ de la khyed kyis spyi dang bye brag thams cad du/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis dpag tu med cing phar la lus pa med par mnyes par bgyis/ da res kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ rlabs po che'i 'bul ba rgya chen po de ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du khong rnam pas phyag len legs par thengs/ thugs la shin tu btags/ yig rten na bza' gos chen yug gcig chab tsha rtse mo zho gsum dang bzhi/ rgun 'brum phul gang dang sna lnga 'bul zhing mchis/ dge 'dun gyi mang skol te khong rnams bzhugs pa'i bar der skol 'dod pa yin pa la ma khol/ da sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo'i dus kyi mchod pa la bskol bar zhu//

101) ༄// phag gru'i slob ma 'ba' brom pa chen po dang gdan sa ba rnams la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che/ dpal sgam po pa chen po'i sras kyi dam par gyur cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/ ri khrod dang gangs khrod dang nags khrod thams cad du ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge ltar/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzad pa'i bla ma yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ba' 'brom pa chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg cing*/ bu dang slob mar gyur pa/ shākya'i sras kyi dge slong rin chen dpal gyis/ bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyi gdan sa na bzhugs pa slob dpon bla ma dang*/ slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbon dang*/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa thams cad la zhu ba/ spyir thub pa chen po'i bstan pa rin po che ni dar zhing rgyas/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i bu slob rnams ni bzang la mang*/ gong ma'i gdan sa dam pa nyams dga' la byin che/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi mthun rkyen ni 'dzoms shing lhun gyis grub/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dgon pa bkra shis shing gong na med pa'i gdan sa rin po che der/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'i spyi rje dang gung kab tu bzhugs pa/ slob dpon chen po de nyid dang zhal mi gnyis pa/ sras kyi thu bo slob dpon bla ma lags pas/ spyi rje dang gung kab tu bzhugs nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bu bskyang bar zhu 'tshal/ zhu rten du lwa nyi ma ris kyi sku phyam cig 'bul zhing mchis/ slob dpon gyi dbon po yon tan rin po che dpag tu med pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bur gyur nas/ 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol ba'i mthu mnga' ba/

gong ma'i gdan sa rin po che'i bdag po/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos/ spyir 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin dang grol bar mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par du gdan sa rin po che bskyangs pa dang*/ sems can dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad par zhu/ zhu rten du gos chen gyi sku thang gcig 'bul zhing mchis/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyang sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad cing gdan sa chen por bzhugs par zhu/ zhu rten du nang dar dmar po yug gcig 'bul zhing mchis// // 102) ༄// dge bshes chen po bra ston rdo rje skyabs la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ nga'i bu dam pa slob ma'i yang rab/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bra ston rdo rje skyabs la springs pa/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas mi'i lus rin po che thob cing*/ rigs rgyud khyad par can du sku ni 'khrungs/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la mkhan slob mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las rab tu byung nas/ brtul zhugs kyi khur chen po ni 'dzin/ bod dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas su byon nas/ mkhas pa chen po lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams las/ thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis ni thugs kyi pad+mo rab tu gtams/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i bla ma rnams kyi gdams ngag gi bcud rin po che ni blangs/ bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang lta bu'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa lhun gyis grub pa/ 'gyur ba med pa thugs su chud pas/ 'khaur ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byaur gyi dbang phyug chen po khyed/ thub pa chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis/

'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad ces gsungs/ de phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ nga 'bu shin tu thugs la btags/ slad kyi don du zhu ba/ khyed kyi 'bul ba dang zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag sgro ba kha ma phye/ sle'u 'bog rgya ma ral/ dpag tu blta rtogs ma byas par dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtse brom ston pas nga'i phyag tu thams cad btang*/ yi ge dang mthun par phyag tu legs par thengs/ yig rten dbu zhu gsol 'phro ngo mtshar can gnyis dang*/ bzhed pa'i maṇ+ḍal phyag byung gcig dam gsum bskur nas mchis// // 103) ༄// slob ma'i yang rab rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rdo rje rgyal mtshan la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ nga'i bu dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun rdo rje rgyal mtshan la springs pa/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas mi lus rin po che thob cing*/ rigs rgyud khyad par can du sku ni 'khrungs/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la rab tu byung nas/ lhag pa'i bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag pas/ tshul khrims rin po che shin tu rnam par dag pa'i spos kyi ngad ldang bas/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi yid tshim par ni mdzad/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab/ snying por gyur pa phyin ci ma log pa'i yang snying*/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gtams shing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/ ri khrod gyi dgon par sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzad ces khums/ de la bdag glo ba dga' zhing mchis/ thugs la shin tu btags/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ khyed kyi 'bul ba dang zhabs 'bring zhabs tog rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pa/

nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang bcas pa zhabs tog bgyis pa de rnams thams cad yi ge dang mthun par phyag tu legs par thengs/ yi ge mi 'khyams pa'i rten du dbu zhu gsol 'phro zhig bskur nas mchis// //ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba da ta/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ
